      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.6">
        <title>Dynamic Privilege Management</title>
        <param id="ac-02.06_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.6_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(06)_ODP"/>
          <label>dynamic privilege management capabilities</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>dynamic privilege management capabilities are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(06)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(6)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(06)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.06"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.6_smt">
          <p>Implement <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.06_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.6_gdn">
          <p>In contrast to access control approaches that employ static accounts and predefined user privileges, dynamic access control approaches rely on runtime access control decisions facilitated by dynamic privilege management, such as attribute-based access control. While user identities remain relatively constant over time, user privileges typically change more frequently based on ongoing mission or business requirements and the operational needs of organizations. An example of dynamic privilege management is the immediate revocation of privileges from users as opposed to requiring that users terminate and restart their sessions to reflect changes in privileges. Dynamic privilege management can also include mechanisms that change user privileges based on dynamic rules as opposed to editing specific user profiles. Examples include automatic adjustments of user privileges if they are operating out of their normal work times, if their job function or assignment changes, or if systems are under duress or in emergency situations. Dynamic privilege management includes the effects of privilege changes, for example, when there are changes to encryption keys used for communications.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(06)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.06_odp"/> are implemented.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.6_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(06)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of dynamic privilege management capabilities</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(06)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(06)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>system or mechanisms implementing dynamic privilege management capabilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.7">
        <title>Privileged User Accounts</title>
        <param id="ac-02.07_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.7_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)_ODP"/>
          <select>
            <choice>a role-based access scheme</choice>
            <choice>an attribute-based access scheme</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(07)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(7)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.07"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.7_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ac-2.7_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Establish and administer privileged user accounts in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.07_odp"/>;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ac-2.7_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Monitor privileged role or attribute assignments;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ac-2.7_smt.c">
            <prop name="label" value="(c)"/>
            <p>Monitor changes to roles or attributes; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ac-2.7_smt.d">
            <prop name="label" value="(d)"/>
            <p>Revoke access when privileged role or attribute assignments are no longer appropriate.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.7_gdn">
          <p>Privileged roles are organization-defined roles assigned to individuals that allow those individuals to perform certain security-relevant functions that ordinary users are not authorized to perform. Privileged roles include key management, account management, database administration, system and network administration, and web administration. A role-based access scheme organizes permitted system access and privileges into roles. In contrast, an attribute-based access scheme specifies allowed system access and privileges based on attributes.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)"/>
          <part id="ac-2.7_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)(a)"/>
            <p>privileged user accounts are established and administered in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.07_odp"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.7_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.7_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)(b)"/>
            <p>privileged role or attribute assignments are monitored;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.7_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.7_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)(c)"/>
            <p>changes to roles or attributes are monitored;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.7_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.7_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)(d)"/>
            <p>access is revoked when privileged role or attribute assignments are no longer appropriate.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.7_smt.d"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.7_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of privileged user accounts and associated roles</p>
            <p>records of actions taken when privileged role assignments are no longer appropriate</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>audit tracking and monitoring reports</p>
            <p>system monitoring records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(07)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing account management functions</p>
            <p>mechanisms monitoring privileged role assignments</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.8">
        <title>Dynamic Account Management</title>
        <param id="ac-02.08_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.8_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)_ODP"/>
          <label>system accounts</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system accounts that are dynamically created, activated, managed, and deactivated are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(08)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(8)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.08"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.8_smt">
          <p>Create, activate, manage, and deactivate <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.08_odp"/> dynamically.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.8_gdn">
          <p>Approaches for dynamically creating, activating, managing, and deactivating system accounts rely on automatically provisioning the accounts at runtime for entities that were previously unknown. Organizations plan for the dynamic management, creation, activation, and deactivation of system accounts by establishing trust relationships, business rules, and mechanisms with appropriate authorities to validate related authorizations and privileges.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)"/>
          <part id="ac-2.8_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)[01]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.08_odp"/> are created dynamically;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.8_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.8_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)[02]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.08_odp"/> are activated dynamically;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.8_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.8_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)[03]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.08_odp"/> are managed dynamically;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.8_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.8_obj-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)[04]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.08_odp"/> are deactivated dynamically.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.8_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.8_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of system accounts</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(08)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Automated mechanisms implementing account management functions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.9">
        <title>Restrictions on Use of Shared and Group Accounts</title>
        <param id="ac-02.09_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.9_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="conditions for establishing shared and group accounts"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(09)_ODP"/>
          <label>conditions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>conditions for establishing shared and group accounts are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(09)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(9)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(09)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.09"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.9_smt">
          <p>Only permit the use of shared and group accounts that meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.09_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.9_gdn">
          <p>Before permitting the use of shared or group accounts, organizations consider the increased risk due to the lack of accountability with such accounts.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(09)"/>
          <p>the use of shared and group accounts is only permitted if <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.09_odp"/> are met.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.9_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.9_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(09)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of shared/group accounts and associated roles</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(09)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.9_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(09)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing management of shared/group accounts</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.10">
        <title>Shared and Group Account Credential Change</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(10)"/>

        <prop name="status" value="withdrawn"/>
        <link rel="incorporated-into" href="#ac-2_smt.k"/>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.11">
        <title>Usage Conditions</title>
        <param id="ac-02.11_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.11_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>circumstances and/or usage conditions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>circumstances and/or usage conditions to be enforced for system accounts are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-02.11_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.11_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>system accounts</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system accounts subject to enforcement of circumstances and/or usage conditions are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(11)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(11)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.11"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.11_smt">
          <p>Enforce <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.11_odp.01"/> for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.11_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.11_gdn">
          <p>Specifying and enforcing usage conditions helps to enforce the principle of least privilege, increase user accountability, and enable effective account monitoring. Account monitoring includes alerts generated if the account is used in violation of organizational parameters. Organizations can describe specific conditions or circumstances under which system accounts can be used, such as by restricting usage to certain days of the week, time of day, or specific durations of time.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.11_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.11_odp.01"/> for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.11_odp.02"/> are enforced.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.11_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.11_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of system accounts and associated assignments of usage circumstances and/or usage conditions</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.11_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.11_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(11)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing account management functions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.12">
        <title>Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage</title>
        <param id="ac-02.12_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.12_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>atypical usage</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>atypical usage for which to monitor system accounts is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-02.12_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.12_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>personnel or roles</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>personnel or roles to report atypical usage is/are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(12)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(12)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.12"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ca-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ir-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.12_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ac-2.12_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Monitor system accounts for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.12_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ac-2.12_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Report atypical usage of system accounts to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.12_odp.02"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.12_gdn">
          <p>Atypical usage includes accessing systems at certain times of the day or from locations that are not consistent with the normal usage patterns of individuals. Monitoring for atypical usage may reveal rogue behavior by individuals or an attack in progress. Account monitoring may inadvertently create privacy risks since data collected to identify atypical usage may reveal previously unknown information about the behavior of individuals. Organizations assess and document privacy risks from monitoring accounts for atypical usage in their privacy impact assessment and make determinations that are in alignment with their privacy program plan.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.12_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)"/>
          <part id="ac-2.12_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)(a)"/>
            <p>system accounts are monitored for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.12_odp.01"/>; </p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.12_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-2.12_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)(b)"/>
            <p>atypical usage of system accounts is reported to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.12_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.12_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.12_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.12_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system monitoring records</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>audit tracking and monitoring reports</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.12_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.12_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(12)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing account management functions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-2.13">
        <title>Disable Accounts for High-risk Individuals</title>
        <param id="ac-02.13_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.13_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>time period</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>time period within which to disable accounts of individuals who are discovered to pose significant risk is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-02.13_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-2.13_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>significant risks</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>significant risks leading to disabling accounts are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-02(13)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-2(13)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-02.13"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-2.13_smt">
          <p>Disable accounts of individuals within <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.13_odp.01"/> of discovery of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.13_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-2.13_gdn">
          <p>Users who pose a significant security and/or privacy risk include individuals for whom reliable evidence indicates either the intention to use authorized access to systems to cause harm or through whom adversaries will cause harm. Such harm includes adverse impacts to organizational operations, organizational assets, individuals, other organizations, or the Nation. Close coordination among system administrators, legal staff, human resource managers, and authorizing officials is essential when disabling system accounts for high-risk individuals.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.13_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)"/>
          <p>accounts of individuals are disabled within <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.13_odp.01"/> of discovery of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-02.13_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-2.13_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.13_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing account management</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of disabled accounts</p>
            <p>list of user activities posing significant organizational risk</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.13_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-2.13_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-02(13)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing account management functions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
