    <control class="SP800-53" id="ac-4">
      <title>Information Flow Enforcement</title>
      <param id="ac-04_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04_ODP"/>
        <label>information flow control policies</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>information flow control policies within the system and between connected systems are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e3cc0520-a366-4fc9-abc2-5272db7e3564"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#2956e175-f674-43f4-b1b9-e074ad9fc39c"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#388a3aa2-5d85-4bad-b8a3-77db80d63c4f"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a2590922-82f3-4277-83c0-ca5bee06dba4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-17"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-19"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-21"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-10"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ca-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ca-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pl-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-24"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-17"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-31"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ac-4_smt">
        <p>Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ac-4_gdn">
        <p>Information flow control regulates where information can travel within a system and between systems (in contrast to who is allowed to access the information) and without regard to subsequent accesses to that information. Flow control restrictions include blocking external traffic that claims to be from within the organization, keeping export-controlled information from being transmitted in the clear to the Internet, restricting web requests that are not from the internal web proxy server, and limiting information transfers between organizations based on data structures and content. Transferring information between organizations may require an agreement specifying how the information flow is enforced (see <a href="#ca-3">CA-3</a> ). Transferring information between systems in different security or privacy domains with different security or privacy policies introduces the risk that such transfers violate one or more domain security or privacy policies. In such situations, information owners/stewards provide guidance at designated policy enforcement points between connected systems. Organizations consider mandating specific architectural solutions to enforce specific security and privacy policies. Enforcement includes prohibiting information transfers between connected systems (i.e., allowing access only), verifying write permissions before accepting information from another security or privacy domain or connected system, employing hardware mechanisms to enforce one-way information flows, and implementing trustworthy regrading mechanisms to reassign security or privacy attributes and labels.</p>
        <p>Organizations commonly employ information flow control policies and enforcement mechanisms to control the flow of information between designated sources and destinations within systems and between connected systems. Flow control is based on the characteristics of the information and/or the information path. Enforcement occurs, for example, in boundary protection devices that employ rule sets or establish configuration settings that restrict system services, provide a packet-filtering capability based on header information, or provide a message-filtering capability based on message content. Organizations also consider the trustworthiness of filtering and/or inspection mechanisms (i.e., hardware, firmware, and software components) that are critical to information flow enforcement. Control enhancements 3 through 32 primarily address cross-domain solution needs that focus on more advanced filtering techniques, in-depth analysis, and stronger flow enforcement mechanisms implemented in cross-domain products, such as high-assurance guards. Such capabilities are generally not available in commercial off-the-shelf products. Information flow enforcement also applies to control plane traffic (e.g., routing and DNS).</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04"/>
        <p>approved authorizations are enforced for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04_odp"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Access control policy</p>
          <p>information flow control policies</p>
          <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
          <p>security architecture documentation</p>
          <p>privacy architecture documentation</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system baseline configuration</p>
          <p>list of information flow authorizations</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy architecture development responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
        </part>
      </part>

          </guideline>

        <param id="ac-04.01_odp.04">

          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.01_odp.06">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(01)_ODP[06]"/>

          <guideline>
            <p>source objects to be associated with privacy attributes are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.01_odp.07">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(01)_ODP[07]"/>

          <label>destination objects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>destination objects to be associated with privacy attributes are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.01_odp.09">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.1_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(01)_ODP[09]"/>
          <label>information flow control policies</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information flow control policies as a basis for enforcement of flow control decisions are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.1_smt">
          <p>Use <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.1_prm_1"/> associated with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.1_prm_2"/> to enforce <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.01_odp.09"/> as a basis for flow control decisions.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.1_gdn">
          <p>Information flow enforcement mechanisms compare security and privacy attributes associated with information (i.e., data content and structure) and source and destination objects and respond appropriately when the enforcement mechanisms encounter information flows not explicitly allowed by information flow policies. For example, an information object labeled Secret would be allowed to flow to a destination object labeled Secret, but an information object labeled Top Secret would not be allowed to flow to a destination object labeled Secret. A dataset of personally identifiable information may be tagged with restrictions against combining with other types of datasets and, thus, would not be allowed to flow to the restricted dataset. Security and privacy attributes can also include source and destination addresses employed in traffic filter firewalls. Flow enforcement using explicit security or privacy attributes can be used, for example, to control the release of certain types of information.</p>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(01)"/>

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.1_smt"/>

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.1_smt"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.2">
        <title>Processing Domains</title>
        <param id="ac-04.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(02)_ODP"/>

            <p>information flow control policies to be enforced by use of protected processing domains are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-39"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.2_smt">
          <p>Use protected processing domains to enforce <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.02_odp"/> as a basis for flow control decisions.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.2_gdn">
          <p>Protected processing domains within systems are processing spaces that have controlled interactions with other processing spaces, enabling control of information flows between these spaces and to/from information objects. A protected processing domain can be provided, for example, by implementing domain and type enforcement. In domain and type enforcement, system processes are assigned to domains, information is identified by types, and information flows are controlled based on allowed information accesses (i.e., determined by domain and type), allowed signaling among domains, and allowed process transitions to other domains.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(02)"/>
          <p>protected processing domains are used to enforce <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.02_odp"/> as a basis for flow control decisions.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.2_smt"/>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(02)-Examine"/>

            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system security architecture and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>

        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">

          </part>
        </part>

        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.3_smt">
          <p>Enforce <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.03_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.3_gdn">
          <p>Organizational policies regarding dynamic information flow control include allowing or disallowing information flows based on changing conditions or mission or operational considerations. Changing conditions include changes in risk tolerance due to changes in the immediacy of mission or business needs, changes in the threat environment, and detection of potentially harmful or adverse events.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(03)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.03_odp"/> are enforced.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system security architecture and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.4">
        <title>Flow Control of Encrypted Information</title>
        <param id="ac-04.04_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>information flow control mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information flow control mechanisms that encrypted information is prevented from bypassing are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.04_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.4_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)_ODP[02]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>decrypting the information</choice>
            <choice>blocking the flow of the encrypted information</choice>
            <choice>terminating communications sessions attempting to pass encrypted information</choice>
            <choice><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.04_odp.03"/> </choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.04_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.4_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="procedure or method"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>organization-defined procedure or method</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the organization-defined procedure or method used to prevent encrypted information from bypassing information flow control mechanisms is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.4_smt">
          <p>Prevent encrypted information from bypassing <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.04_odp.01"/> by <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.04_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.4_gdn">
          <p>Flow control mechanisms include content checking, security policy filters, and data type identifiers. The term encryption is extended to cover encoded data not recognized by filtering mechanisms.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)"/>
          <p>encrypted information is prevented from bypassing <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.04_odp.01"/> by <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.04_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.5">
        <title>Embedded Data Types</title>
        <param id="ac-04.05_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(05)_ODP"/>
          <label>limitations</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>limitations on embedding data types within other data types are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.5_smt">
          <p>Enforce <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.05_odp"/> on embedding data types within other data types.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.5_gdn">
          <p>Embedding data types within other data types may result in reduced flow control effectiveness. Data type embedding includes inserting files as objects within other files and using compressed or archived data types that may include multiple embedded data types. Limitations on data type embedding consider the levels of embedding and prohibit levels of data type embedding that are beyond the capability of the inspection tools.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(05)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.05_odp"/> are enforced on embedding data types within other data types.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of limitations to be enforced on embedding data types within other data types</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(05)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.6">
        <title>Metadata</title>
        <param id="ac-04.06_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.6_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(06)_ODP"/>
          <label>metadata</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>metadata on which to base enforcement of information flow control is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(06)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(6)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(06)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.06"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.6_smt">
          <p>Enforce information flow control based on <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.06_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.6_gdn">
          <p>Metadata is information that describes the characteristics of data. Metadata can include structural metadata describing data structures or descriptive metadata describing data content. Enforcement of allowed information flows based on metadata enables simpler and more effective flow control. Organizations consider the trustworthiness of metadata regarding data accuracy (i.e., knowledge that the metadata values are correct with respect to the data), data integrity (i.e., protecting against unauthorized changes to metadata tags), and the binding of metadata to the data payload (i.e., employing sufficiently strong binding techniques with appropriate assurance).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(06)"/>
          <p>information flow control enforcement is based on <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.06_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.6_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(06)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>types of metadata used to enforce information flow control decisions</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(06)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(06)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.7">
        <title>One-way Flow Mechanisms</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(07)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(7)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(07)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.07"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.7_smt">
          <p>Enforce one-way information flows through hardware-based flow control mechanisms.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.7_gdn">
          <p>One-way flow mechanisms may also be referred to as a unidirectional network, unidirectional security gateway, or data diode. One-way flow mechanisms can be used to prevent data from being exported from a higher impact or classified domain or system while permitting data from a lower impact or unclassified domain or system to be imported.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(07)"/>
          <p>one-way information flows are enforced through hardware-based flow control mechanisms.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.7_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(07)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware mechanisms and associated configurations</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(07)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(07)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Hardware mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.8">
        <title>Security and Privacy Policy Filters</title>
        <param id="ac-4.8_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.08_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.08_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined security or privacy policy filters</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-4.8_prm_2">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.08_odp.03"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.08_odp.04"/>
          <label>organization-defined information flows</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-4.8_prm_4">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.08_odp.06"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.08_odp.07"/>
          <label>organization-defined security or privacy policy</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>security policy filter</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policy filters to be used as a basis for enforcing information flow control are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>privacy policy filter</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policy filters to be used as a basis for enforcing information flow control are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.03">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>information flows</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information flows for which information flow control is enforced by security filters are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.04">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[04]"/>
          <label>information flows</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information flows for which information flow control is enforced by privacy filters are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.05">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.8_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[05]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>block</choice>
            <choice>strip</choice>
            <choice>modify</choice>
            <choice>quarantine</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.06">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[06]"/>
          <label>security policy</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policy identifying actions to be taken after a filter processing failure are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.08_odp.07">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)_ODP[07]"/>
          <label>privacy policy</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policy identifying actions to be taken after a filter processing failure are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(08)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(8)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.08"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.8_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ac-4.8_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Enforce information flow control using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.8_prm_1"/> as a basis for flow control decisions for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.8_prm_2"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ac-4.8_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.05"/> data after a filter processing failure in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.8_prm_4"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.8_gdn">
          <p>Organization-defined security or privacy policy filters can address data structures and content. For example, security or privacy policy filters for data structures can check for maximum file lengths, maximum field sizes, and data/file types (for structured and unstructured data). Security or privacy policy filters for data content can check for specific words, enumerated values or data value ranges, and hidden content. Structured data permits the interpretation of data content by applications. Unstructured data refers to digital information without a data structure or with a data structure that does not facilitate the development of rule sets to address the impact or classification level of the information conveyed by the data or the flow enforcement decisions. Unstructured data consists of bitmap objects that are inherently non-language-based (i.e., image, video, or audio files) and textual objects that are based on written or printed languages. Organizations can implement more than one security or privacy policy filter to meet information flow control objectives.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)"/>
          <part id="ac-4.8_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)(a)"/>
            <part id="ac-4.8_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)(a)[01]"/>
              <p>information flow control is enforced using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.01"/> as a basis for flow control decisions for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.03"/>;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.8_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <part id="ac-4.8_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)(a)[02]"/>
              <p>information flow control is enforced using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.02"/> as a basis for flow control decisions for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.04"/>;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.8_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.8_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.8_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)(b)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.05"/> data after a filter processing failure in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.06"/>;</p>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.05"/> data after a filter processing failure in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.08_odp.07"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.8_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.8_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of security policy filters regulating flow control decisions</p>
            <p>list of privacy policy filters regulating flow control decisions</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(08)-Test"/>

          </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.9">
        <title>Human Reviews</title>
        <param id="ac-04.09_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.9_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>information flows</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information flows requiring the use of human reviews are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.09_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.9_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>conditions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>conditions under which the use of human reviews for information flows are to be enforced are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(09)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(9)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.09"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.9_smt">
          <p>Enforce the use of human reviews for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.09_odp.01"/> under the following conditions: <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.09_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.9_gdn">
          <p>Organizations define security or privacy policy filters for all situations where automated flow control decisions are possible. When a fully automated flow control decision is not possible, then a human review may be employed in lieu of or as a complement to automated security or privacy policy filtering. Human reviews may also be employed as deemed necessary by organizations.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)"/>
          <p>human reviews are used for <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.09_odp.01"/> under <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.09_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.9_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.9_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>records of human reviews regarding information flows</p>
            <p>list of information flows requiring the use of human reviews</p>
            <p>list of conditions requiring human reviews for information flows</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information flow enforcement responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.9_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(09)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms enforcing the use of human reviews</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.10">
        <title>Enable and Disable Security or Privacy Policy Filters</title>
        <param id="ac-4.10_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.10_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.10_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined security or privacy policy filters</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-4.10_prm_2">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.10_odp.03"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.10_odp.04"/>
          <label>organization-defined conditions</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.10_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>security filters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policy filters that privileged administrators have the capability to enable and disable are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.10_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>privacy filters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policy filters that privileged administrators have the capability to enable and disable are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.10_odp.03">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>conditions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>conditions under which privileged administrators have the capability to enable and disable security policy filters are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.10_odp.04">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)_ODP[04]"/>
          <label>conditions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>conditions under which privileged administrators have the capability to enable and disable privacy policy filters are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.10"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.10_smt">
          <p>Provide the capability for privileged administrators to enable and disable <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.10_prm_1"/> under the following conditions: <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.10_prm_2"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.10_gdn">
          <p>For example, as allowed by the system authorization, administrators can enable security or privacy policy filters to accommodate approved data types. Administrators also have the capability to select the filters that are executed on a specific data flow based on the type of data that is being transferred, the source and destination security domains, and other security or privacy relevant features, as needed.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.10_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)"/>
          <part id="ac-4.10_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)[01]"/>
            <p>capability is provided for privileged administrators to enable and disable <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.10_odp.01"/> under <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.10_odp.03"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.10_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.10_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)[02]"/>
            <p>capability is provided for privileged administrators to enable and disable <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.10_odp.02"/> under <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.10_odp.04"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.10_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.10_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.10_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow information policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of security policy filters enabled/disabled by privileged administrators</p>
            <p>list of privacy policy filters enabled/disabled by privileged administrators</p>
            <p>list of approved data types for enabling/disabling by privileged administrators</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.10_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for enabling/disabling security and privacy policy filters</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.10_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(10)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
            <p>security and privacy policy filters</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.11">
        <title>Configuration of Security or Privacy Policy Filters</title>
        <param id="ac-4.11_prm_1">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(11)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>security policy filters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policy filters that privileged administrators have the capability to configure to support different security and privacy policies are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.11_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(11)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>privacy policy filters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policy filters that privileged administrators have the capability to configure to support different security and privacy policies are defined;</p>

          <p>Provide the capability for privileged administrators to configure <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.11_prm_1"/> to support different security or privacy policies.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.11_gdn">
          <p>Documentation contains detailed information for configuring security or privacy policy filters. For example, administrators can configure security or privacy policy filters to include the list of inappropriate words that security or privacy policy mechanisms check in accordance with the definitions provided by organizations.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.11_obj" name="assessment-objective">

          <part id="ac-4.11_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.11_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.11_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.11_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.11_smt"/>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(11)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of security policy filters</p>
            <p>list of privacy policy filters</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.11_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.12">
        <title>Data Type Identifiers</title>
        <param id="ac-04.12_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.12_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(12)_ODP"/>
          <label>data type identifiers</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>data type identifiers to be used to validate data essential for information flow decisions are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(12)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(12)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(12)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.12"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.12_smt">
          <p>When transferring information between different security domains, use <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.12_odp"/> to validate data essential for information flow decisions.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.12_gdn">
          <p>Data type identifiers include filenames, file types, file signatures or tokens, and multiple internal file signatures or tokens. Systems only allow transfer of data that is compliant with data type format specifications. Identification and validation of data types is based on defined specifications associated with each allowed data format. The filename and number alone are not used for data type identification. Content is validated syntactically and semantically against its specification to ensure that it is the proper data type.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.12_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(12)"/>
          <p>when transferring information between different security domains, <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.12_odp"/> are used to validate data essential for information flow decisions.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.12_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.12_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(12)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of data type identifiers</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.12_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(12)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.12_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(12)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.13">
        <title>Decomposition into Policy-relevant Subcomponents</title>
        <param id="ac-04.13_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.13_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(13)_ODP"/>
          <label>policy-relevant subcomponents</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>policy-relevant subcomponents into which to decompose information for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(13)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(13)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(13)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.13"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.13_smt">
          <p>When transferring information between different security domains, decompose information into <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.13_odp"/> for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.13_gdn">
          <p>Decomposing information into policy-relevant subcomponents prior to information transfer facilitates policy decisions on source, destination, certificates, classification, attachments, and other security- or privacy-related component differentiators. Policy enforcement mechanisms apply filtering, inspection, and/or sanitization rules to the policy-relevant subcomponents of information to facilitate flow enforcement prior to transferring such information to different security domains.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.13_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(13)"/>
          <p>when transferring information between different security domains, information is decomposed into <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.13_odp"/> for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.13_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.13_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(13)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.13_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(13)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.13_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(13)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.14">
        <title>Security or Privacy Policy Filter Constraints</title>
        <param id="ac-4.14_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.14_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.14_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined security or privacy policy filters</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.14_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(14)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>security policy filters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policy filters to be implemented that require fully enumerated formats restricting data structure and content have been defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.14_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(14)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>privacy policy filters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policy filters to be implemented that require fully enumerated formats restricting data structure and content are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(14)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(14)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(14)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.14"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.14_smt">
          <p>When transferring information between different security domains, implement <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.14_prm_1"/> requiring fully enumerated formats that restrict data structure and content.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.14_gdn">
          <p>Data structure and content restrictions reduce the range of potential malicious or unsanctioned content in cross-domain transactions. Security or privacy policy filters that restrict data structures include restricting file sizes and field lengths. Data content policy filters include encoding formats for character sets, restricting character data fields to only contain alpha-numeric characters, prohibiting special characters, and validating schema structures.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.14_obj" name="assessment-objective">

          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.14_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.15">
        <title>Detection of Unsanctioned Information</title>
        <param id="ac-4.15_prm_2">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.15_odp.02"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.15_odp.03"/>

        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.15_odp.01">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(15)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>unsanctioned information</label>

            <p>unsanctioned information to be detected is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.15_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(15)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>security policy</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policy that requires the transfer of unsanctioned information between different security domains to be prohibited is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.15_odp.03">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(15)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>privacy policy</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policy that requires the transfer of organization-defined unsanctioned information between different security domains to be prohibited is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(15)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(15)"/>

        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.15_smt">
          <p>When transferring information between different security domains, examine the information for the presence of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.15_odp.01"/> and prohibit the transfer of such information in accordance with the <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.15_prm_2"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.15_gdn">
          <p>Unsanctioned information includes malicious code, information that is inappropriate for release from the source network, or executable code that could disrupt or harm the services or systems on the destination network.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.15_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(15)"/>

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.15_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.15_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(15)[02]"/>
            <p>when transferring information between different security domains, transfer of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.15_odp.01"/> is prohibited in accordance with the <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.15_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.15_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.15_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.17">
        <title>Domain Authentication</title>
        <param id="ac-04.17_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.17_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(17)_ODP"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>organization, system, application, service, individual</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(17)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(17)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(17)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.17"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-9"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.17_smt">
          <p>Uniquely identify and authenticate source and destination points by <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.17_odp"/> for information transfer.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.17_gdn">
          <p>Attribution is a critical component of a security and privacy concept of operations. The ability to identify source and destination points for information flowing within systems allows the forensic reconstruction of events and encourages policy compliance by attributing policy violations to specific organizations or individuals. Successful domain authentication requires that system labels distinguish among systems, organizations, and individuals involved in preparing, sending, receiving, or disseminating information. Attribution also allows organizations to better maintain the lineage of personally identifiable information processing as it flows through systems and can facilitate consent tracking, as well as correction, deletion, or access requests from individuals.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.17_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(17)"/>
          <p>source and destination points are uniquely identified and authenticated by <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.17_odp"/> for information transfer.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.17_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.17_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(17)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>information flow control policies</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>procedures addressing source and destination domain identification and authentication</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>list of system labels</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.17_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(17)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.17_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(17)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing information flow enforcement policy</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(19)_ODP[01]"/>

        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.19_smt">
          <p>When transferring information between different security domains, implement <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.19_prm_1"/> on metadata.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.19_gdn">
          <p>All information (including metadata and the data to which the metadata applies) is subject to filtering and inspection. Some organizations distinguish between metadata and data payloads (i.e., only the data to which the metadata is bound). Other organizations do not make such distinctions and consider metadata and the data to which the metadata applies to be part of the payload.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.19_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(19)"/>

          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.19_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">

            <p>system design documentation</p>

            <p>list of security policy filtering criteria applied to metadata and data payloads</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.19_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">

Contact <a href="mailto:ncdsmo@nsa.gov">ncdsmo@nsa.gov</a> for more information.</p>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-4.21">
        <title>Physical or Logical Separation of Information Flows</title>
        <param id="ac-4.21_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.21_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-04.21_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined mechanisms and/or techniques</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.21_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(21)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>mechanisms and/or techniques</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>mechanisms and/or techniques used to logically separate information flows are defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.21_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(21)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>mechanisms and/or techniques</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>mechanisms and/or techniques used to physically separate information flows are defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-04.21_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-4.21_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="required separations by types of information"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(21)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>required separations</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>required separations by types of information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-04(21)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-4(21)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(21)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-04.21"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-32"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-4.21_smt">
          <p>Separate information flows logically or physically using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-4.21_prm_1"/> to accomplish <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.21_odp.03"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-4.21_gdn">
          <p>Enforcing the separation of information flows associated with defined types of data can enhance protection by ensuring that information is not commingled while in transit and by enabling flow control by transmission paths that are not otherwise achievable. Types of separable information include inbound and outbound communications traffic, service requests and responses, and information of differing security impact or classification levels.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-4.21_obj" name="assessment-objective">

            <p>information flows are separated logically using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.21_odp.01"/> to accomplish <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.21_odp.03"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.21_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-4.21_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-04(21)[02]"/>
            <p>information flows are separated physically using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.21_odp.02"/> to accomplish <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-04.21_odp.03"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-4.21_smt"/>
