            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.1_obj-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(01)[04]"/>
            <p>privacy attributes are dynamically associated with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.01_odp.04"/> in accordance with the following privacy policies as information is created and combined: <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.01_odp.06"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.1_smt"/>
        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.2">

        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(2)"/>

        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.2_gdn">

          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-16.03_odp.04"/>

        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.03_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)_ODP[01]"/>

          <guideline>
            <p>security attributes that require association and integrity maintenance are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.03_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>privacy attributes</label>

            <p>privacy attributes that require association and integrity maintenance are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.03_odp.03">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>subjects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>subjects requiring the association and integrity of security attributes to such subjects to be maintained are defined;</p>
          </guideline>

        <param id="ac-16.03_odp.04">

          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.03_odp.05">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)_ODP[05]"/>
          <label>subjects</label>

            <p>subjects requiring the association and integrity of privacy attributes to such subjects to be maintained are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.03_odp.06">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)_ODP[06]"/>
          <label>objects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>objects requiring the association and integrity of privacy attributes to such objects to be maintained are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.3_smt">
          <p>Maintain the association and integrity of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.3_prm_1"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.3_prm_2"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.3_gdn">
          <p>Maintaining the association and integrity of security and privacy attributes to subjects and objects with sufficient assurance helps to ensure that the attribute associations can be used as the basis of automated policy actions. The integrity of specific items, such as security configuration files, may be maintained through the use of an integrity monitoring mechanism that detects anomalies and changes that deviate from <q>known good</q> baselines. Automated policy actions include retention date expirations, access control decisions, information flow control decisions, and information disclosure decisions.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.3_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)[01]"/>
            <p>the association and integrity of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.03"/> is maintained;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.3_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)[02]"/>
            <p>the association and integrity of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.04"/> is maintained.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.3_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)[03]"/>
            <p>the association and integrity of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.02"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.05"/> is maintained;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.3_obj-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)[04]"/>
            <p>the association and integrity of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.02"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.03_odp.06"/> is maintained.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(03)-Examine"/>

            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the association of security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>procedures addressing labeling or marking</p>

            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>

            <p>system developers</p>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.4">

          <label>organization-defined security and privacy attributes</label>
        </param>

          <label>organization-defined subjects and objects</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.01">

          <label>security attributes</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security attributes to be associated with subjects by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>security attributes</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security attributes to be associated with objects by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.03">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>privacy attributes</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy attributes to be associated with subjects by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.04">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[04]"/>
          <label>privacy attributes</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy attributes to be associated with objects by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.05">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[05]"/>
          <label>subjects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>subjects requiring the association of security attributes by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.06">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[06]"/>

          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.07">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[07]"/>
          <label>subjects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>subjects requiring the association of privacy attributes by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.04_odp.08">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)_ODP[08]"/>
          <label>objects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>objects requiring the association of privacy attributes by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.4_smt">
          <p>Provide the capability to associate <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.4_prm_1"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.4_prm_2"/> by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals).</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.4_gdn">
          <p>Systems, in general, provide the capability for privileged users to assign security and privacy attributes to system-defined subjects (e.g., users) and objects (e.g., directories, files, and ports). Some systems provide additional capability for general users to assign security and privacy attributes to additional objects (e.g., files, emails). The association of attributes by authorized individuals is described in the design documentation. The support provided by systems can include prompting users to select security and privacy attributes to be associated with information objects, employing automated mechanisms to categorize information with attributes based on defined policies, or ensuring that the combination of the security or privacy attributes selected is valid. Organizations consider the creation, deletion, or modification of attributes when defining auditable events.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.4_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)[01]"/>
            <p>authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are provided with the capability to associate <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.01"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.05"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.4_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.4_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)[02]"/>
            <p>authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are provided with the capability to associate <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.02"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.06"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.4_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.4_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)[03]"/>
            <p>authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are provided with the capability to associate <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.03"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.07"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.4_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.4_obj-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)[04]"/>
            <p>authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) are provided with the capability to associate <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.04"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.04_odp.08"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.4_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the association of security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of users authorized to associate security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>system prompts for privileged users to select security and privacy attributes to be associated with information objects</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for associating security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting user associations of security and privacy attributes to information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.5">
        <title>Attribute Displays on Objects to Be Output</title>
        <param id="ac-16.05_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-16.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="special dissemination, handling, or distribution instructions"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>instructions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>special dissemination, handling, or distribution instructions to be used for each object that the system transmits to output devices are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.05_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ac-16.5_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="human-readable, standard naming conventions"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>naming conventions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>human-readable, standard naming conventions for the security and privacy attributes to be displayed in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.5_smt">
          <p>Display security and privacy attributes in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices to identify <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.05_odp.01"/> using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.05_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.5_gdn">
          <p>System outputs include printed pages, screens, or equivalent items. System output devices include printers, notebook computers, video displays, smart phones, and tablets. To mitigate the risk of unauthorized exposure of information (e.g., shoulder surfing), the outputs display full attribute values when unmasked by the subscriber.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.5_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)[01]"/>
            <p>security attributes are displayed in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices to identify <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.05_odp.01"/> using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.05_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.5_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.5_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)[02]"/>
            <p>privacy attributes are displayed in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices to identify <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.05_odp.01"/> using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.05_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.5_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing display of security and privacy attributes in human-readable form</p>
            <p>special dissemination, handling, or distribution instructions</p>
            <p>types of human-readable, standard naming conventions</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(05)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System output devices displaying security and privacy attributes in human-readable form on each object</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.06_odp.08">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)_ODP[08]"/>
          <label>objects</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>objects to be associated with privacy attributes are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.06_odp.09">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)_ODP[09]"/>
          <label>security policies</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>security policies that require personnel to associate and maintain the association of security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.06_odp.10">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)_ODP[10]"/>
          <label>privacy policies</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>privacy policies that require personnel to associate and maintain the association of security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(06)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(6)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.06"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.6_smt">
          <p>Require personnel to associate and maintain the association of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.6_prm_1"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.6_prm_2"/> in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.6_prm_3"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.6_gdn">
          <p>Maintaining attribute association requires individual users (as opposed to the system) to maintain associations of defined security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.6_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)[01]"/>
            <p>personnel are required to associate and maintain the association of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.01"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.05"/> in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.09"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.6_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.6_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)[02]"/>
            <p>personnel are required to associate and maintain the association of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.02"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.06"/> in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.09"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.6_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.6_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)[03]"/>
            <p>personnel are required to associate and maintain the association of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.03"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.07"/> in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.10"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.6_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.6_obj-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)[04]"/>
            <p>personnel are required to associate and maintain the association of <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.04"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.08"/> in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.06_odp.10"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.6_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.6_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)-Examine"/>

            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing association of security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for associating and maintaining association of security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(06)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting associations of security and privacy attributes to subjects and objects</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.7">
        <title>Consistent Attribute Interpretation</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(07)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(7)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.07"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.7_smt">
          <p>Provide a consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes transmitted between distributed system components.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.7_gdn">
          <p>To enforce security and privacy policies across multiple system components in distributed systems, organizations provide a consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes employed in access enforcement and flow enforcement decisions. Organizations can establish agreements and processes to help ensure that distributed system components implement attributes with consistent interpretations in automated access enforcement and flow enforcement actions.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.7_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)[01]"/>
            <p>a consistent interpretation of security attributes transmitted between distributed system components is provided;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.7_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.7_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)[02]"/>
            <p>a consistent interpretation of privacy attributes transmitted between distributed system components is provided.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.7_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.7_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policies and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes transmitted between distributed system components</p>
            <p>procedures addressing access enforcement</p>
            <p>procedures addressing information flow enforcement</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy access control policy</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for providing consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes used in access enforcement and information flow enforcement actions</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(07)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing access enforcement and information flow enforcement functions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.8">
        <title>Association Techniques and Technologies</title>
        <param id="ac-16.8_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-16.08_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-16.08_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined techniques and technologies</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.08_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>techniques and technologies</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>techniques and technologies to be implemented in associating security attributes to information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.08_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>techniques and technologies</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>techniques and technologies to be implemented in associating privacy attributes to information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(08)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(8)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.08"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.8_smt">
          <p>Implement <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.8_prm_1"/> in associating security and privacy attributes to information.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.8_gdn">
          <p>The association of security and privacy attributes to information within systems is important for conducting automated access enforcement and flow enforcement actions. The association of such attributes to information (i.e., binding) can be accomplished with technologies and techniques that provide different levels of assurance. For example, systems can cryptographically bind attributes to information using digital signatures that support cryptographic keys protected by hardware devices (sometimes known as hardware roots of trust).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.8_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)[01]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.08_odp.01"/> are implemented in associating security attributes to information;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.8_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.8_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)[02]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.08_odp.02"/> are implemented in associating privacy attributes to information.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.8_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.8_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing association of security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for associating security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(08)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing techniques or technologies associating security and privacy attributes to information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.9">
        <title>Attribute Reassignment — Regrading Mechanisms</title>
        <param id="ac-16.9_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-16.09_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-16.09_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined techniques or procedures</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.09_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>techniques or procedures</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>techniques or procedures used to validate regrading mechanisms for security attributes are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-16.09_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>techniques or procedures</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>techniques or procedures used to validate regrading mechanisms for privacy attributes are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(09)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(9)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.09"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.9_smt">
          <p>Change security and privacy attributes associated with information only via regrading mechanisms validated using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.9_prm_1"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.9_gdn">
          <p>A regrading mechanism is a trusted process authorized to re-classify and re-label data in accordance with a defined policy exception. Validated regrading mechanisms are used by organizations to provide the requisite levels of assurance for attribute reassignment activities. The validation is facilitated by ensuring that regrading mechanisms are single purpose and of limited function. Since security and privacy attribute changes can directly affect policy enforcement actions, implementing trustworthy regrading mechanisms is necessary to help ensure that such mechanisms perform in a consistent and correct mode of operation.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.9_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)[01]"/>
            <p>security attributes associated with information are changed only via regrading mechanisms validated using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.09_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.9_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.9_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)[02]"/>
            <p>privacy attributes associated with information are changed only via regrading mechanisms validated using <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-16.09_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.9_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.9_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.9_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing reassignment of security attributes to information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for reassigning association of security and privacy attributes to information</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.9_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(09)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing techniques or procedures for reassigning association of security and privacy attributes to information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-16.10">
        <title>Attribute Configuration by Authorized Individuals</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-16(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-16(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-16.10"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-16.10_smt">
          <p>Provide authorized individuals the capability to define or change the type and value of security and privacy attributes available for association with subjects and objects.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-16.10_gdn">
          <p>The content or assigned values of security and privacy attributes can directly affect the ability of individuals to access organizational information. Thus, it is important for systems to be able to limit the ability to create or modify the type and value of attributes available for association with subjects and objects to authorized individuals only.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.10_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)"/>
          <part id="ac-16.10_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)[01]"/>
            <p>authorized individuals are provided with the capability to define or change the type and value of security attributes available for association with subjects and objects;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.10_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-16.10_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)[02]"/>
            <p>authorized individuals are provided with the capability to define or change the type and value of privacy attributes available for association with subjects and objects.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.10_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-16.10_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.10_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing configuration of security and privacy attributes by authorized individuals</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.10_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for defining or changing security and privacy attributes associated with information</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-16.10_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-16(10)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing capability for defining or changing security and privacy attributes</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ac-17">
      <title>Remote Access</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-17"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-17"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#83b9d63b-66b1-467c-9f3b-3a0b108771e9"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#d4d7c760-2907-403b-8b2a-767ca5370ecd"/>

      <part name="statement" id="ac-17_smt">
        <part name="item" id="ac-17_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ac-17_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Authorize each type of remote access to the system prior to allowing such connections.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ac-17_gdn">
        <p>Remote access is access to organizational systems (or processes acting on behalf of users) that communicate through external networks such as the Internet. Types of remote access include dial-up, broadband, and wireless. Organizations use encrypted virtual private networks (VPNs) to enhance confidentiality and integrity for remote connections. The use of encrypted VPNs provides sufficient assurance to the organization that it can effectively treat such connections as internal networks if the cryptographic mechanisms used are implemented in accordance with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. Still, VPN connections traverse external networks, and the encrypted VPN does not enhance the availability of remote connections. VPNs with encrypted tunnels can also affect the ability to adequately monitor network communications traffic for malicious code. Remote access controls apply to systems other than public web servers or systems designed for public access. Authorization of each remote access type addresses authorization prior to allowing remote access without specifying the specific formats for such authorization. While organizations may use information exchange and system connection security agreements to manage remote access connections to other systems, such agreements are addressed as part of <a href="#ca-3">CA-3</a> . Enforcing access restrictions for remote access is addressed via <a href="#ac-3">AC-3</a>.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-17_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17"/>
        <part id="ac-17_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17a."/>
          <part id="ac-17_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17a.[01]"/>
            <p>usage restrictions are established and documented for each type of remote access allowed;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-17_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17a.[02]"/>
            <p>configuration/connection requirements are established and documented for each type of remote access allowed;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-17_obj.a-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17a.[03]"/>
            <p>implementation guidance is established and documented for each type of remote access allowed;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17b."/>
          <p>each type of remote access to the system is authorized prior to allowing such connections.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-17_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Access control policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing remote access implementation and usage (including restrictions)</p>
          <p>configuration management plan</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>remote access authorizations</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-17_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with responsibilities for managing remote access connections</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ac-17_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Remote access management capability for the system</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-17.1">
        <title>Monitoring and Control</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-17(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-17.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-17"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-14"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-17.1_smt">
          <p>Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-17.1_gdn">
          <p>Monitoring and control of remote access methods allows organizations to detect attacks and help ensure compliance with remote access policies by auditing the connection activities of remote users on a variety of system components, including servers, notebook computers, workstations, smart phones, and tablets. Audit logging for remote access is enforced by <a href="#au-2">AU-2</a> . Audit events are defined in <a href="#au-2_smt.a">AU-2a</a>.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)"/>
          <part id="ac-17.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)[01]"/>
            <p>automated mechanisms are employed to monitor remote access methods;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-17.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)[02]"/>
            <p>automated mechanisms are employed to control remote access methods.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing remote access to the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system monitoring records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(01)-Test"/>

            <p>Automated mechanisms monitoring and controlling remote access methods</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-17.2">
        <title>Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-17(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-17.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-17"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-17.2_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-17.2_gdn">
          <p>Virtual private networks can be used to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions. Transport Layer Security (TLS) is an example of a cryptographic protocol that provides end-to-end communications security over networks and is used for Internet communications and online transactions.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(02)"/>
          <p>cryptographic mechanisms are implemented to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing remote access to the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>cryptographic mechanisms and associated configuration documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Cryptographic mechanisms protecting confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-17.3">
        <title>Managed Access Control Points</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-17(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-17.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-17"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-17.3_smt">
          <p>Route remote accesses through authorized and managed network access control points.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-17.3_gdn">
          <p>Organizations consider the Trusted Internet Connections (TIC) initiative <a href="#4f42ee6e-86cc-403b-a51f-76c2b4f81b54">DHS TIC</a> requirements for external network connections since limiting the number of access control points for remote access reduces attack surfaces.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(03)"/>
          <p>remote accesses are routed through authorized and managed network access control points.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing remote access to the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>list of all managed network access control points</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms routing all remote accesses through managed network access control points</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-17.4">
        <title>Privileged Commands and Access</title>
        <param id="ac-17.4_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-17.04_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ac-17.04_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined needs</label>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-17.04_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>needs requiring remote access</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>needs requiring execution of privileged commands via remote access are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ac-17.04_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>needs requiring remote access</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>needs requiring access to security-relevant information via remote access are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-17(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-17.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-17"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-17.4_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ac-17.4_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Authorize the execution of privileged commands and access to security-relevant information via remote access only in a format that provides assessable evidence and for the following needs: <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-17.4_prm_1"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ac-17.4_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Document the rationale for remote access in the security plan for the system.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-17.4_gdn">
          <p>Remote access to systems represents a significant potential vulnerability that can be exploited by adversaries. As such, restricting the execution of privileged commands and access to security-relevant information via remote access reduces the exposure of the organization and the susceptibility to threats by adversaries to the remote access capability.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)"/>
          <part id="ac-17.4_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)(a)"/>
            <part id="ac-17.4_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)(a)[01]"/>
              <p>the execution of privileged commands via remote access is authorized only in a format that provides assessable evidence;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <part id="ac-17.4_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)(a)[02]"/>
              <p>access to security-relevant information via remote access is authorized only in a format that provides assessable evidence;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <part id="ac-17.4_obj.a-3" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)(a)[03]"/>
              <p>the execution of privileged commands via remote access is authorized only for the following needs: <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-17.04_odp.01"/>;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <part id="ac-17.4_obj.a-4" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)(a)[04]"/>
              <p>access to security-relevant information via remote access is authorized only for the following needs: <insert type="param" id-ref="ac-17.04_odp.02"/>;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ac-17.4_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)(b)"/>
            <p>the rationale for remote access is documented in the security plan for the system.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing remote access to the system</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>security plan</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing remote access management</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17(05)"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ac-17.6">
        <title>Protection of Mechanism Information</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AC-17(06)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AC-17(6)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(06)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ac-17.06"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ac-17"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#at-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#at-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ps-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ac-17.6_smt">
          <p>Protect information about remote access mechanisms from unauthorized use and disclosure.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ac-17.6_gdn">
          <p>Remote access to organizational information by non-organizational entities can increase the risk of unauthorized use and disclosure about remote access mechanisms. The organization considers including remote access requirements in the information exchange agreements with other organizations, as applicable. Remote access requirements can also be included in rules of behavior (see <a href="#pl-4">PL-4</a> ) and access agreements (see <a href="#ps-6">PS-6</a>).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(06)"/>
          <p>information about remote access mechanisms is protected from unauthorized use and disclosure.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ac-17.6_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(06)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Access control policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing remote access to the system</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ac-17.6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AC-17(06)-Interview"/>

            <p>system users with knowledge of information about remote access mechanisms</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

        <prop name="label" value="AC-17(9)"/>
