        <title>Audit Level Adjustment</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-06(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-6(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-06(10)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-06.10"/>
        <prop name="status" value="withdrawn"/>
        <link rel="incorporated-into" href="#au-6"/>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="au-7">
      <title>Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-07"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-7"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="au-07"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ir-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <part name="statement" id="au-7_smt">
        <p>Provide and implement an audit record reduction and report generation capability that:</p>
        <part name="item" id="au-7_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Supports on-demand audit record review, analysis, and reporting requirements and after-the-fact investigations of incidents; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="au-7_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Does not alter the original content or time ordering of audit records.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="au-7_gdn">
        <p>Audit record reduction is a process that manipulates collected audit log information and organizes it into a summary format that is more meaningful to analysts. Audit record reduction and report generation capabilities do not always emanate from the same system or from the same organizational entities that conduct audit logging activities. The audit record reduction capability includes modern data mining techniques with advanced data filters to identify anomalous behavior in audit records. The report generation capability provided by the system can generate customizable reports. Time ordering of audit records can be an issue if the granularity of the timestamp in the record is insufficient.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="au-7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07"/>
        <part id="au-7_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07a."/>
          <part id="au-7_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07a.[01]"/>
            <p>an audit record reduction and report generation capability is provided that supports on-demand audit record review, analysis, and reporting requirements and after-the-fact investigations of incidents;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="au-7_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07a.[02]"/>
            <p>an audit record reduction and report generation capability is implemented that supports on-demand audit record review, analysis, and reporting requirements and after-the-fact investigations of incidents;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-7_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07b."/>
          <part id="au-7_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07b.[01]"/>
            <p>an audit record reduction and report generation capability is provided that does not alter the original content or time ordering of audit records;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="au-7_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07b.[02]"/>
            <p>an audit record reduction and report generation capability is implemented that does not alter the original content or time ordering of audit records.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="au-7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>procedures addressing audit reduction and report generation</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-7.1">
        <title>Automatic Processing</title>
        <param id="au-07.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-7.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-07(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>fields within audit records</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>fields within audit records that can be processed, sorted, or searched are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-07(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-7(1)"/>

        <link rel="required" href="#au-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-7.1_smt">
          <p>Provide and implement the capability to process, sort, and search audit records for events of interest based on the following content: <insert type="param" id-ref="au-07.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-7.1_gdn">
          <p>Events of interest can be identified by the content of audit records, including system resources involved, information objects accessed, identities of individuals, event types, event locations, event dates and times, Internet Protocol addresses involved, or event success or failure. Organizations may define event criteria to any degree of granularity required, such as locations selectable by a general networking location or by specific system component.</p>
        </part>

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-7.1_smt"/>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="au-8">
      <title>Time Stamps</title>
      <param id="au-08_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-8_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08_ODP"/>
        <label>granularity of time measurement</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>granularity of time measurement for audit record timestamps is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-08"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-8"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="au-08"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-14"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-45"/>
      <part name="statement" id="au-8_smt">
        <part name="item" id="au-8_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="au-8_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Record time stamps for audit records that meet <insert type="param" id-ref="au-08_odp"/> and that use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or that include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="au-8_gdn">
        <p>Time stamps generated by the system include date and time. Time is commonly expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), a modern continuation of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), or local time with an offset from UTC. Granularity of time measurements refers to the degree of synchronization between system clocks and reference clocks (e.g., clocks synchronizing within hundreds of milliseconds or tens of milliseconds). Organizations may define different time granularities for different system components. Time service can be critical to other security capabilities such as access control and identification and authentication, depending on the nature of the mechanisms used to support those capabilities.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="au-8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08"/>
        <part id="au-8_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08a."/>
          <p>internal system clocks are used to generate timestamps for audit records;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-8_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-8_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08b."/>
          <p>timestamps are recorded for audit records that meet <insert type="param" id-ref="au-08_odp"/> and that use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or include the local time offset as part of the timestamp.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-8_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-8_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="au-8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>procedures addressing timestamp generation</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08-Interview"/>

          <p>Organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-08-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms implementing timestamp generation</p>
        </part>
      </part>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="au-9">
      <title>Protection of Audit Information</title>
      <param id="au-09_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-9_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09_ODP"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to be alerted upon detection of unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of audit information is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#678e3d6c-150b-4393-aec5-6e3481eb1e00"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#eea3c092-42ed-4382-a6f4-1adadef01b9d"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a295ca19-8c75-4b4c-8800-98024732e181"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-11"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-14"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-15"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <part name="statement" id="au-9_smt">
        <part name="item" id="au-9_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="au-9_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Alert <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09_odp"/> upon detection of unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of audit information.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="au-9_gdn">
        <p>Audit information includes all information needed to successfully audit system activity, such as audit records, audit log settings, audit reports, and personally identifiable information. Audit logging tools are those programs and devices used to conduct system audit and logging activities. Protection of audit information focuses on technical protection and limits the ability to access and execute audit logging tools to authorized individuals. Physical protection of audit information is addressed by both media protection controls and physical and environmental protection controls.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="au-9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09"/>
        <part id="au-9_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09a."/>
          <p>audit information and audit logging tools are protected from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09b."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="au-09_odp"/> are alerted upon detection of unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of audit information.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="au-9_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>audit tools</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="au-9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="au-9_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms implementing audit information protection</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.1">
        <title>Hardware Write-once Media</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-5"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.1_smt">
          <p>Write audit trails to hardware-enforced, write-once media.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.1_gdn">
          <p>Writing audit trails to hardware-enforced, write-once media applies to the initial generation of audit trails (i.e., the collection of audit records that represents the information to be used for detection, analysis, and reporting purposes) and to the backup of those audit trails. Writing audit trails to hardware-enforced, write-once media does not apply to the initial generation of audit records prior to being written to an audit trail. Write-once, read-many (WORM) media includes Compact Disc-Recordable (CD-R), Blu-Ray Disc Recordable (BD-R), and Digital Versatile Disc-Recordable (DVD-R). In contrast, the use of switchable write-protection media, such as tape cartridges, Universal Serial Bus (USB) drives, Compact Disc Re-Writeable (CD-RW), and Digital Versatile Disc-Read Write (DVD-RW) results in write-protected but not write-once media.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(01)"/>
          <p>audit trails are written to hardware-enforced, write-once media.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware settings</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system storage media</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System media storing audit trails</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.2">
        <title>Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components</title>
        <param id="au-09.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-9.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency of storing audit records in a repository is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-5"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.2_smt">
          <p>Store audit records <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.02_odp"/> in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.2_gdn">
          <p>Storing audit records in a repository separate from the audited system or system component helps to ensure that a compromise of the system being audited does not also result in a compromise of the audit records. Storing audit records on separate physical systems or components also preserves the confidentiality and integrity of audit records and facilitates the management of audit records as an organization-wide activity. Storing audit records on separate systems or components applies to initial generation as well as backup or long-term storage of audit records.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(02)"/>
          <p>audit records are stored <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.02_odp"/> in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system or media storing backups of system audit records</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing the backing up of audit records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.3">
        <title>Cryptographic Protection</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-10"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.3_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit information and audit tools.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.3_gdn">
          <p>Cryptographic mechanisms used for protecting the integrity of audit information include signed hash functions using asymmetric cryptography. This enables the distribution of the public key to verify the hash information while maintaining the confidentiality of the secret key used to generate the hash.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(03)"/>
          <p>cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit information and audit tools are implemented.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware settings</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Cryptographic mechanisms protecting the integrity of audit information and tools</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.4">
        <title>Access by Subset of Privileged Users</title>
        <param id="au-09.04_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-9.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(04)_ODP"/>
          <label>subset of privileged users or roles</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>a subset of privileged users or roles authorized to access management of audit logging functionality is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-5"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.4_smt">
          <p>Authorize access to management of audit logging functionality to only <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.04_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.4_gdn">
          <p>Individuals or roles with privileged access to a system and who are also the subject of an audit by that system may affect the reliability of the audit information by inhibiting audit activities or modifying audit records. Requiring privileged access to be further defined between audit-related privileges and other privileges limits the number of users or roles with audit-related privileges.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(04)"/>
          <p>access to management of audit logging functionality is authorized only to <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.04_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of privileged users with access to management of audit functionality</p>
            <p>access authorizations</p>
            <p>access control list</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms managing access to audit functionality</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.5">
        <title>Dual Authorization</title>
        <param id="au-09.05_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-9.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)_ODP[01]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>movement</choice>
            <choice>deletion</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="au-09.05_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-9.5_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>audit information</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>audit information for which dual authorization is to be enforced is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.5_smt">
          <p>Enforce dual authorization for <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.05_odp.01"/> of <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.05_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.5_gdn">
          <p>Organizations may choose different selection options for different types of audit information. Dual authorization mechanisms (also known as two-person control) require the approval of two authorized individuals to execute audit functions. To reduce the risk of collusion, organizations consider rotating dual authorization duties to other individuals. Organizations do not require dual authorization mechanisms when immediate responses are necessary to ensure public and environmental safety.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)"/>
          <p>dual authorization is enforced for the <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.05_odp.01"/> of <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.05_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>access authorizations</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(05)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing the enforcement of dual authorization</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.6">
        <title>Read-only Access</title>
        <param id="au-09.06_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-9.6_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(06)_ODP"/>
          <label>subset of privileged users or roles</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>a subset of privileged users or roles with authorized read-only access to audit information is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(06)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(6)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(06)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.06"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.6_smt">
          <p>Authorize read-only access to audit information to <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.06_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.6_gdn">
          <p>Restricting privileged user or role authorizations to read-only helps to limit the potential damage to organizations that could be initiated by such users or roles, such as deleting audit records to cover up malicious activity.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(06)"/>
          <p>read-only access to audit information is authorized to <insert type="param" id-ref="au-09.06_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.6_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(06)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system-generated list of privileged users with read-only access to audit information</p>
            <p>access authorizations</p>
            <p>access control list</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(06)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(06)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms managing access to audit information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-9.7">
        <title>Store on Component with Different Operating System</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-09(07)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-9(7)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(07)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-09.07"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-11"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-29"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-9.7_smt">
          <p>Store audit information on a component running a different operating system than the system or component being audited.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-9.7_gdn">
          <p>Storing auditing information on a system component running a different operating system reduces the risk of a vulnerability specific to the system, resulting in a compromise of the audit records.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(07)"/>
          <p>audit information is stored on a component running a different operating system than the system or component being audited.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-9.7_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(07)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing protection of audit information</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(07)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit and accountability responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-9.7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-09(07)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing operating system verification capability</p>
            <p>mechanisms verifying audit information storage location</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="au-10">
      <title>Non-repudiation</title>
      <param id="au-10_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-10_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="actions to be covered by non-repudiation"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10_ODP"/>
        <label>actions</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>actions to be covered by non-repudiation are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-10"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-10"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="au-10"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#678e3d6c-150b-4393-aec5-6e3481eb1e00"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#eea3c092-42ed-4382-a6f4-1adadef01b9d"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#7c37a38d-21d7-40d8-bc3d-b5e27eac17e1"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a295ca19-8c75-4b4c-8800-98024732e181"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#1c71b420-2bd9-4e52-9fc8-390f58b85b59"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-17"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-23"/>
      <part name="statement" id="au-10_smt">
        <p>Provide irrefutable evidence that an individual (or process acting on behalf of an individual) has performed <insert type="param" id-ref="au-10_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="au-10_gdn">
        <p>Types of individual actions covered by non-repudiation include creating information, sending and receiving messages, and approving information. Non-repudiation protects against claims by authors of not having authored certain documents, senders of not having transmitted messages, receivers of not having received messages, and signatories of not having signed documents. Non-repudiation services can be used to determine if information originated from an individual or if an individual took specific actions (e.g., sending an email, signing a contract, approving a procurement request, or receiving specific information). Organizations obtain non-repudiation services by employing various techniques or mechanisms, including digital signatures and digital message receipts.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="au-10_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10"/>
        <p>irrefutable evidence is provided that an individual (or process acting on behalf of an individual) has performed <insert type="param" id-ref="au-10_odp"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-10_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="au-10_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>procedures addressing non-repudiation</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="au-10_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="au-10_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms implementing non-repudiation capability</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-10.1">
        <title>Association of Identities</title>
        <param id="au-10.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-10.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>strength of binding</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the strength of binding between the identity of the information producer and the information is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-10(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-10(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-10.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-10"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-10.1_smt">
          <part name="item" id="au-10.1_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Bind the identity of the information producer with the information to <insert type="param" id-ref="au-10.01_odp"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="au-10.1_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Provide the means for authorized individuals to determine the identity of the producer of the information.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-10.1_gdn">
          <p>Binding identities to the information supports audit requirements that provide organizational personnel with the means to identify who produced specific information in the event of an information transfer. Organizations determine and approve the strength of attribute binding between the information producer and the information based on the security category of the information and other relevant risk factors.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)"/>
          <part id="au-10.1_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)(a)"/>
            <p>the identity of the information producer is bound with the information to <insert type="param" id-ref="au-10.01_odp"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-10.1_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="au-10.1_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)(b)"/>
            <p>the means for authorized individuals to determine the identity of the producer of the information is provided.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-10.1_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-10.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-repudiation</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>

          </part>
          <part name="item" id="au-10.2_smt.b">

        <part name="guidance" id="au-10.2_gdn">
          <p>Validating the binding of the information producer identity to the information prevents the modification of information between production and review. The validation of bindings can be achieved by, for example, using cryptographic checksums. Organizations determine if validations are in response to user requests or generated automatically.</p>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-10.3">
        <title>Chain of Custody</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-10(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-10(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-10.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-10"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-10.3_smt">
          <p>Maintain reviewer or releaser credentials within the established chain of custody for information reviewed or released.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-10.3_gdn">
          <p>Chain of custody is a process that tracks the movement of evidence through its collection, safeguarding, and analysis life cycle by documenting each individual who handled the evidence, the date and time the evidence was collected or transferred, and the purpose for the transfer. If the reviewer is a human or if the review function is automated but separate from the release or transfer function, the system associates the identity of the reviewer of the information to be released with the information and the information label. In the case of human reviews, maintaining the credentials of reviewers or releasers provides the organization with the means to identify who reviewed and released the information. In the case of automated reviews, it ensures that only approved review functions are used.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(03)"/>
          <p>reviewer or releaser credentials are maintained within the established chain of custody for information reviewed or released.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-10.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-repudiation</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>records of information reviews and releases</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-10.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-10(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Automated mechanisms implementing non-repudiation capability</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-10.4">

        <param id="au-10.04_odp.01">

        <prop name="label" value="AU-10(4)"/>

        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-10.4_smt">
          <part name="item" id="au-10.4_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Validate the binding of the information reviewer identity to the information at the transfer or release points prior to release or transfer between <insert type="param" id-ref="au-10.04_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="au-10.4_smt.b">

        <part name="guidance" id="au-10.4_gdn">
          <p>Validating the binding of the information reviewer identity to the information at transfer or release points prevents the unauthorized modification of information between review and the transfer or release. The validation of bindings can be achieved by using cryptographic checksums. Organizations determine if validations are in response to user requests or generated automatically.</p>
        </part>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="au-11">
      <title>Audit Record Retention</title>
      <param id="au-11_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-11_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="time period consistent with records retention policy"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11_ODP"/>
        <label>time period</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>a time period to retain audit records that is consistent with the records retention policy is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-11"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-11"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="au-11"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-14"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-12"/>
      <part name="statement" id="au-11_smt">
        <p>Retain audit records for <insert type="param" id-ref="au-11_odp"/> to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of incidents and to meet regulatory and organizational information retention requirements.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="au-11_gdn">
        <p>Organizations retain audit records until it is determined that the records are no longer needed for administrative, legal, audit, or other operational purposes. This includes the retention and availability of audit records relative to Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests, subpoenas, and law enforcement actions. Organizations develop standard categories of audit records relative to such types of actions and standard response processes for each type of action. The National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) General Records Schedules provide federal policy on records retention.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="au-11_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11"/>
        <p>audit records are retained for <insert type="param" id-ref="au-11_odp"/> to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of incidents and to meet regulatory and organizational information retention requirements.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-11_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="au-11_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>audit record retention policy and procedures</p>
          <p>security plan</p>
          <p>organization-defined retention period for audit records</p>
          <p>audit record archives</p>
          <p>audit logs</p>
          <p>audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="au-11_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with audit record retention responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="au-11.1">
        <title>Long-term Retrieval Capability</title>
        <param id="au-11.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-11.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>measures</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>measures to be employed to ensure that long-term audit records generated by the system can be retrieved are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-11(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-11(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="au-11.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#au-11"/>
        <part name="statement" id="au-11.1_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="au-11.01_odp"/> to ensure that long-term audit records generated by the system can be retrieved.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="au-11.1_gdn">
          <p>Organizations need to access and read audit records requiring long-term storage (on the order of years). Measures employed to help facilitate the retrieval of audit records include converting records to newer formats, retaining equipment capable of reading the records, and retaining the necessary documentation to help personnel understand how to interpret the records.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="au-11.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="au-11.01_odp"/> are employed to ensure that long-term audit records generated by the system can be retrieved.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-11.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-11.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>audit record retention policy and procedures</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>audit record archives</p>
            <p>audit logs</p>
            <p>audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-11.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with audit record retention responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="au-11.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-11(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing audit record retention capability</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="au-12">
      <title>Audit Record Generation</title>
      <param id="au-12_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-12_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>system components</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>system components that provide an audit record generation capability for the events types (defined in AU-02_ODP[02]) are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="au-12_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="au-12_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles allowed to select the event types that are to be logged by specific components of the system is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="AU-12"/>
        <prop name="label" value="AU-12"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="au-12"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-17"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-14"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-18"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-10"/>
      <part name="statement" id="au-12_smt">
        <part name="item" id="au-12_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Provide audit record generation capability for the event types the system is capable of auditing as defined in <a href="#au-2_smt.a">AU-2a</a> on <insert type="param" id-ref="au-12_odp.01"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="au-12_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Allow <insert type="param" id-ref="au-12_odp.02"/> to select the event types that are to be logged by specific components of the system; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="au-12_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Generate audit records for the event types defined in <a href="#au-2_smt.c">AU-2c</a> that include the audit record content defined in <a href="#au-3">AU-3</a>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="au-12_gdn">
        <p>Audit records can be generated from many different system components. The event types specified in <a href="#au-2_smt.d">AU-2d</a> are the event types for which audit logs are to be generated and are a subset of all event types for which the system can generate audit records.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="au-12_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12"/>
        <part id="au-12_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12a."/>
          <p>audit record generation capability for the event types the system is capable of auditing (defined in AU-02_ODP[01]) is provided by <insert type="param" id-ref="au-12_odp.01"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-12_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-12_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12b."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="au-12_odp.02"/> is/are allowed to select the event types that are to be logged by specific components of the system;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-12_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="au-12_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12c."/>
          <p>audit records for the event types defined in AU-02_ODP[02] that include the audit record content defined in AU-03 are generated.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-12_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#au-12_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="au-12_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Audit and accountability policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing audit record generation</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>list of auditable events</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="au-12_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12-Interview"/>

        </part>

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="AU-12-Test"/>
