      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-5.17">
        <title>Presentation Attack Detection for Biometric Authenticators</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-05(17)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-5(17)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(17)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-05.17"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-5.17_smt">
          <p>Employ presentation attack detection mechanisms for biometric-based authentication.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-5.17_gdn">
          <p>Biometric characteristics do not constitute secrets. Such characteristics can be obtained by online web accesses, taking a picture of someone with a camera phone to obtain facial images with or without their knowledge, lifting from objects that someone has touched (e.g., a latent fingerprint), or capturing a high-resolution image (e.g., an iris pattern). Presentation attack detection technologies including liveness detection, can mitigate the risk of these types of attacks by making it difficult to produce artifacts intended to defeat the biometric sensor.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.17_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(17)"/>
          <p>presentation attack detection mechanisms are employed for biometric-based authentication.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-5.17_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.17_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(17)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Identification and authentication policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing identifier management</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>mechanisms providing dynamic binding of identifiers and authenticators</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.17_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(17)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with identification and authentication management responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.17_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(17)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing account management capability</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication management capabilities for the system</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-5.18">
        <title>Password Managers</title>
        <param id="ia-05.18_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ia-5.18_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>password managers</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>password managers employed for generating and managing passwords are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ia-05.18_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ia-5.18_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls for protecting passwords are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-05(18)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-5(18)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-05.18"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-5"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-5.18_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ia-5.18_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-05.18_odp.01"/> to generate and manage passwords; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ia-5.18_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Protect the passwords using <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-05.18_odp.02"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-5.18_gdn">
          <p>For systems where static passwords are employed, it is often a challenge to ensure that the passwords are suitably complex and that the same passwords are not employed on multiple systems. A password manager is a solution to this problem as it automatically generates and stores strong and different passwords for various accounts. A potential risk of using password managers is that adversaries can target the collection of passwords generated by the password manager. Therefore, the collection of passwords requires protection including encrypting the passwords (see <a href="#ia-5.1_smt.d">IA-5(1)(d)</a> ) and storing the collection offline in a token.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.18_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)"/>
          <part id="ia-5.18_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)(a)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ia-05.18_odp.01"/> are employed to generate and manage passwords;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-5.18_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ia-5.18_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)(b)"/>
            <p>the passwords are protected using <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-05.18_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-5.18_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-5.18_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.18_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Identification and authentication policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing identifier management</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>mechanisms providing dynamic binding of identifiers and authenticators</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.18_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with identification and authentication management responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-5.18_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-05(18)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing account management capability</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication management capabilities for the system</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ia-6">
      <title>Authentication Feedback</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-06"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-6"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-06"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-06"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ia-6_smt">
        <p>Obscure feedback of authentication information during the authentication process to protect the information from possible exploitation and use by unauthorized individuals.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ia-6_gdn">
        <p>Authentication feedback from systems does not provide information that would allow unauthorized individuals to compromise authentication mechanisms. For some types of systems, such as desktops or notebooks with relatively large monitors, the threat (referred to as shoulder surfing) may be significant. For other types of systems, such as mobile devices with small displays, the threat may be less significant and is balanced against the increased likelihood of typographic input errors due to small keyboards. Thus, the means for obscuring authentication feedback is selected accordingly. Obscuring authentication feedback includes displaying asterisks when users type passwords into input devices or displaying feedback for a very limited time before obscuring it.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-06"/>
        <p>the feedback of authentication information is obscured during the authentication process to protect the information from possible exploitation and use by unauthorized individuals.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-6_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-06-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Identification and authentication policy</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>procedures addressing authenticator feedback</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-06-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-06-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the obscuring of feedback of authentication information during authentication</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>

      <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-07"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>

      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ia-7_smt">
        <p>Implement mechanisms for authentication to a cryptographic module that meet the requirements of applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines for such authentication.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ia-7_gdn">
        <p>Authentication mechanisms may be required within a cryptographic module to authenticate an operator accessing the module and to verify that the operator is authorized to assume the requested role and perform services within that role.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-7_obj" name="assessment-objective">

        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-7_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-07-Examine"/>

          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>procedures addressing cryptographic module authentication</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-07-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with responsibility for cryptographic module authentication</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-07-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing cryptographic module authentication</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ia-8">
      <title>Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users)</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-08"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-8"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-08"/>

      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a1555677-2b9d-4868-a97b-a1363aff32f5"/>

      <link rel="reference" href="#10963761-58fc-4b20-b3d6-b44a54daba03"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#2100332a-16a5-4598-bacf-7261baea9711"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#98d415ca-7281-4064-9931-0c366637e324"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>

      <link rel="related" href="#ac-14"/>

      <link rel="related" href="#ia-11"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-13"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ia-8_smt">
        <p>Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ia-8_gdn">
        <p>Non-organizational users include system users other than organizational users explicitly covered by <a href="#ia-2">IA-2</a> . Non-organizational users are uniquely identified and authenticated for accesses other than those explicitly identified and documented in <a href="#ac-14">AC-14</a> . Identification and authentication of non-organizational users accessing federal systems may be required to protect federal, proprietary, or privacy-related information (with exceptions noted for national security systems). Organizations consider many factors—including security, privacy, scalability, and practicality—when balancing the need to ensure ease of use for access to federal information and systems with the need to protect and adequately mitigate risk.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08"/>
        <p>non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users are uniquely identified and authenticated.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-8.1">
        <title>Acceptance of PIV Credentials from Other Agencies</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-08(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-8(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-08.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-8.1_smt">
          <p>Accept and electronically verify Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials from other federal agencies.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-8.1_gdn">
          <p>Acceptance of Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credentials from other federal agencies applies to both logical and physical access control systems. PIV credentials are those credentials issued by federal agencies that conform to FIPS Publication 201 and supporting guidelines. The adequacy and reliability of PIV card issuers are addressed and authorized using <a href="#10963761-58fc-4b20-b3d6-b44a54daba03">SP 800-79-2</a>.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(01)"/>
          <part id="ia-8.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(01)[01]"/>
            <p>Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials from other federal agencies are accepted;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ia-8.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(01)[02]"/>
            <p>Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials from other federal agencies are electronically verified.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(01)-Examine"/>

            <p>evidence of PIV credentials</p>

            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-8.2">
        <title>Acceptance of External Authenticators</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-08(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-8(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-08.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-8"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-8.2_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ia-8.2_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Accept only external authenticators that are NIST-compliant; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ia-8.2_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Document and maintain a list of accepted external authenticators.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-8.2_gdn">
          <p>Acceptance of only NIST-compliant external authenticators applies to organizational systems that are accessible to the public (e.g., public-facing websites). External authenticators are issued by nonfederal government entities and are compliant with <a href="#e59c5a7c-8b1f-49ca-8de0-6ee0882180ce">SP 800-63B</a> . Approved external authenticators meet or exceed the minimum Federal Government-wide technical, security, privacy, and organizational maturity requirements. Meeting or exceeding Federal requirements allows Federal Government relying parties to trust external authenticators in connection with an authentication transaction at a specified authenticator assurance level.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)"/>
          <part id="ia-8.2_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)(a)"/>
            <p>only external authenticators that are NIST-compliant are accepted;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.2_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ia-8.2_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)(b)"/>
            <part id="ia-8.2_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)(b)[01]"/>
              <p>a list of accepted external authenticators is documented;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.2_smt.b"/>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.2_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)(b)[02]"/>
              <p>a list of accepted external authenticators is maintained.</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.2_smt.b"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>

            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>list of third-party credentialing products, components, or services procured and implemented by organization</p>
            <p>third-party credential verification records</p>
            <p>evidence of third-party credentials</p>
            <p>third-party credential authorizations</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)-Interview"/>

          </part>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(02)-Test"/>

            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication capabilities</p>
            <p>mechanisms that accept external credentials</p>
          </part>
        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-8.4">
        <title>Use of Defined Profiles</title>
        <param id="ia-08.04_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ia-8.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(04)_ODP"/>
          <label>identity management profiles</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>identity management profiles are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-08(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-8(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-08.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-8"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-8.4_smt">
          <p>Conform to the following profiles for identity management <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.04_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-8.4_gdn">
          <p>Organizations define profiles for identity management based on open identity management standards. To ensure that open identity management standards are viable, robust, reliable, sustainable, and interoperable as documented, the Federal Government assesses and scopes the standards and technology implementations against applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(04)"/>
          <p>there is conformance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.04_odp"/> for identity management.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(04)-Examine"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-8.5">
        <title>Acceptance of PIV-I Credentials</title>
        <param id="ia-08.05_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ia-8.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)_ODP"/>
          <label>policy</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>a policy for using federated or PKI credentials is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-08(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-8(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-08.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-8"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-8.5_smt">
          <p>Accept and verify federated or PKI credentials that meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.05_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-8.5_gdn">
          <p>Acceptance of PIV-I credentials can be implemented by PIV, PIV-I, and other commercial or external identity providers. The acceptance and verification of PIV-I-compliant credentials apply to both logical and physical access control systems. The acceptance and verification of PIV-I credentials address nonfederal issuers of identity cards that desire to interoperate with United States Government PIV systems and that can be trusted by Federal Government-relying parties. The X.509 certificate policy for the Federal Bridge Certification Authority (FBCA) addresses PIV-I requirements. The PIV-I card is commensurate with the PIV credentials as defined in cited references. PIV-I credentials are the credentials issued by a PIV-I provider whose PIV-I certificate policy maps to the Federal Bridge PIV-I Certificate Policy. A PIV-I provider is cross-certified with the FBCA (directly or through another PKI bridge) with policies that have been mapped and approved as meeting the requirements of the PIV-I policies defined in the FBCA certificate policy.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)"/>
          <part id="ia-8.5_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)[01]"/>
            <p>federated or PKI credentials that meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.05_odp"/> are accepted;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.5_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ia-8.5_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)[02]"/>
            <p>federated or PKI credentials that meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.05_odp"/> are verified.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.5_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Identification and authentication policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>procedures addressing user identification and authentication</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>PIV-I verification records</p>
            <p>evidence of PIV-I credentials</p>
            <p>PIV-I credential authorizations</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system operations responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(05)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication capabilities</p>
            <p>mechanisms that accept and verify PIV-I credentials</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ia-8.6">
        <title>Disassociability</title>
        <param id="ia-08.06_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ia-8.6_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(06)_ODP"/>
          <label>measures</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>disassociability measures are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-08(06)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-8(6)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(06)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-08.06"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ia-8"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ia-8.6_smt">
          <p>Implement the following measures to disassociate user attributes or identifier assertion relationships among individuals, credential service providers, and relying parties: <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.06_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ia-8.6_gdn">
          <p>Federated identity solutions can create increased privacy risks due to the tracking and profiling of individuals. Using identifier mapping tables or cryptographic techniques to blind credential service providers and relying parties from each other or to make identity attributes less visible to transmitting parties can reduce these privacy risks.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(06)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ia-08.06_odp"/> to disassociate user attributes or identifier assertion relationships among individuals, credential service providers, and relying parties are implemented.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-8.6_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(06)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Identification and authentication policy</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>procedures addressing user identification and authentication</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(06)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system operations responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>system developers</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ia-8.6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-08(06)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication capabilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ia-9">
      <title>Service Identification and Authentication</title>
      <param id="ia-09_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ia-9_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-09_ODP"/>
        <label>system services and applications</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>system services and applications to be uniquely identified and authenticated are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="IA-09"/>
        <prop name="label" value="IA-9"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-09"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ia-09"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-13"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ia-9_smt">
        <p>Uniquely identify and authenticate <insert type="param" id-ref="ia-09_odp"/> before establishing communications with devices, users, or other services or applications.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ia-9_gdn">
        <p>Services that may require identification and authentication include web applications using digital certificates or services or applications that query a database. Identification and authentication methods for system services and applications include information or code signing, provenance graphs, and electronic signatures that indicate the sources of services. Decisions regarding the validity of identification and authentication claims can be made by services separate from the services acting on those decisions. This can occur in distributed system architectures. In such situations, the identification and authentication decisions (instead of actual identifiers and authentication data) are provided to the services that need to act on those decisions.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-09"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ia-09_odp"/> are uniquely identified and authenticated before establishing communications with devices, users, or other services or applications.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ia-9_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-9_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-09-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Identification and authentication policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing service identification and authentication</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>security safeguards used to identify and authenticate system services</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-09-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with system operations responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with identification and authentication responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ia-9_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="IA-09-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Security safeguards implementing service identification and authentication capabilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
