      <part name="statement" id="pe-2_smt">
        <part name="item" id="pe-2_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Develop, approve, and maintain a list of individuals with authorized access to the facility where the system resides;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-2_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Issue authorization credentials for facility access;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-2_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Review the access list detailing authorized facility access by individuals <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-02_odp"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-2_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Remove individuals from the facility access list when access is no longer required.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pe-2_gdn">
        <p>Physical access authorizations apply to employees and visitors. Individuals with permanent physical access authorization credentials are not considered visitors. Authorization credentials include ID badges, identification cards, and smart cards. Organizations determine the strength of authorization credentials needed consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. Physical access authorizations may not be necessary to access certain areas within facilities that are designated as publicly accessible.</p>
      </part>

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-2_smt.a"/>

          <part id="pe-2_obj.a-3" name="assessment-objective">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-2.1">

        <part name="guidance" id="pe-2.1_gdn">

        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-2.2">

        <param id="pe-02.02_odp">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-02(02)_ODP"/>

          <guideline>
            <p>a list of acceptable forms of identification for visitor access to the facility where the system resides is defined;</p>

        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-02(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-2(2)"/>

        <link rel="related" href="#ia-5"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-2.2_smt">
          <p>Require two forms of identification from the following forms of identification for visitor access to the facility where the system resides: <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-02.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-2.2_gdn">
          <p>Acceptable forms of identification include passports, REAL ID-compliant drivers’ licenses, and Personal Identity Verification (PIV) cards. For gaining access to facilities using automated mechanisms, organizations may use PIV cards, key cards, PINs, and biometrics.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-2.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-02(02)"/>

          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-2.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-2.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-02(02)-Examine"/>

        <part name="guidance" id="pe-2.3_gdn">

      <part name="statement" id="pe-3_smt">
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Enforce physical access authorizations at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.01"/> by:</p>
          <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.a.1">
            <prop name="label" value="1."/>
            <p>Verifying individual access authorizations before granting access to the facility; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.a.2">
            <prop name="label" value="2."/>
            <p>Controlling ingress and egress to the facility using <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.02"/>;</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Maintain physical access audit logs for <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.04"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Control access to areas within the facility designated as publicly accessible by implementing the following controls: <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.05"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Escort visitors and control visitor activity <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.06"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.e">
          <prop name="label" value="e."/>
          <p>Secure keys, combinations, and other physical access devices;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.f">
          <prop name="label" value="f."/>
          <p>Inventory <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.07"/> every <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03_odp.08"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-3_smt.g">
          <prop name="label" value="g."/>
          <p>Change combinations and keys <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-3_prm_9"/> and/or when keys are lost, combinations are compromised, or when individuals possessing the keys or combinations are transferred or terminated.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pe-3_gdn">
        <p>Physical access control applies to employees and visitors. Individuals with permanent physical access authorizations are not considered visitors. Physical access controls for publicly accessible areas may include physical access control logs/records, guards, or physical access devices and barriers to prevent movement from publicly accessible areas to non-public areas. Organizations determine the types of guards needed, including professional security staff, system users, or administrative staff. Physical access devices include keys, locks, combinations, biometric readers, and card readers. Physical access control systems comply with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines. Organizations have flexibility in the types of audit logs employed. Audit logs can be procedural, automated, or some combination thereof. Physical access points can include facility access points, interior access points to systems that require supplemental access controls, or both. Components of systems may be in areas designated as publicly accessible with organizations controlling access to the components.</p>
      </part>

          <p>Organizational processes for physical access control</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access control</p>
          <p>physical access control devices</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.1">
        <title>System Access</title>
        <param id="pe-03.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="physical spaces containing one or more components of the system"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>physical spaces</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>physical spaces containing one or more components of the system are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.1_smt">
          <p>Enforce physical access authorizations to the system in addition to the physical access controls for the facility at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.1_gdn">
          <p>Control of physical access to the system provides additional physical security for those areas within facilities where there is a concentration of system components.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)"/>
          <part id="pe-3.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)[01]"/>
            <p>physical access authorizations to the system are enforced;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-3.1_obj.2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)[02]"/>
            <p>physical access controls are enforced for the facility at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.01_odp"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>physical access control logs or records</p>
            <p>physical access control devices</p>
            <p>access authorizations</p>
            <p>access credentials</p>
            <p>system entry and exit points</p>
            <p>list of areas within the facility containing concentrations of system components or system components requiring additional physical protection</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access authorization responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for physical access control to the information system/components</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access control for facility areas containing system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.2">
        <title>Facility and Systems</title>
        <param id="pe-03.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to perform security checks at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.2_smt">
          <p>Perform security checks <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.02_odp"/> at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.2_gdn">
          <p>Organizations determine the extent, frequency, and/or randomness of security checks to adequately mitigate risk associated with exfiltration.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(02)"/>
          <p>security checks are performed <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.02_odp"/> at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>physical access control logs or records</p>
            <p>records of security checks</p>

            <p>security inspection reports</p>

        <part id="pe-3.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">

            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for physical access control to the facility and/or system</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access control for the facility or system</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing security checks for the unauthorized exfiltration of information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.3">
        <title>Continuous Guards</title>
        <param id="pe-03.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(03)_ODP"/>
          <label>physical access points</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>physical access points to the facility where the system resides are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cp-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cp-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.3_smt">
          <p>Employ guards to control <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.03_odp"/> to the facility where the system resides 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.3_gdn">
          <p>Employing guards at selected physical access points to the facility provides a more rapid response capability for organizations. Guards also provide the opportunity for human surveillance in areas of the facility not covered by video surveillance.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(03)"/>
          <p>guards are employed to control <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.03_odp"/> to the facility where the system resides 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>physical access control logs or records</p>
            <p>physical access control devices</p>
            <p>facility surveillance records</p>
            <p>facility layout documentation</p>
            <p>system entry and exit points</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for physical access control to the facility where the system resides</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access control for the facility where the system resides</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.4">
        <title>Lockable Casings</title>
        <param id="pe-03.04_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(04)_ODP"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components to be protected from unauthorized physical access are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.4_smt">
          <p>Use lockable physical casings to protect <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.04_odp"/> from unauthorized physical access.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.4_gdn">
          <p>The greatest risk from the use of portable devices—such as smart phones, tablets, and notebook computers—is theft. Organizations can employ lockable, physical casings to reduce or eliminate the risk of equipment theft. Such casings come in a variety of sizes, from units that protect a single notebook computer to full cabinets that can protect multiple servers, computers, and peripherals. Lockable physical casings can be used in conjunction with cable locks or lockdown plates to prevent the theft of the locked casing containing the computer equipment.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(04)"/>
          <p>lockable physical casings are used to protect <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.04_odp"/> from unauthorized access.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>list of system components requiring protection through lockable physical casings</p>
            <p>lockable physical casings</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Lockable physical casings</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.5">
        <title>Tamper Protection</title>
        <param id="pe-03.05_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>anti-tamper technologies</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>anti-tamper technologies to be employed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pe-03.05_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.5_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)_ODP[02]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>detect</choice>
            <choice>prevent</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="pe-03.05_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.5_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>hardware components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>hardware components to be protected from physical tampering or alteration are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sa-16"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-11"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.5_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.05_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.05_odp.02"/> physical tampering or alteration of <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.05_odp.03"/> within the system.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.5_gdn">
          <p>Organizations can implement tamper detection and prevention at selected hardware components or implement tamper detection at some components and tamper prevention at other components. Detection and prevention activities can employ many types of anti-tamper technologies, including tamper-detection seals and anti-tamper coatings. Anti-tamper programs help to detect hardware alterations through counterfeiting and other supply chain-related risks.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.05_odp.01"/> are employed to <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.05_odp.02"/> physical tampering or alteration of <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.05_odp.03"/> within the system.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>list of security safeguards to detect/prevent physical tampering or alteration of system hardware components</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(05)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes to detect/prevent physical tampering or alteration of system hardware components</p>
            <p>mechanisms/security safeguards supporting and/or implementing the detection/prevention of physical tampering/alternation of system hardware components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.7">
        <title>Physical Barriers</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(07)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(7)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(07)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.07"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.7_smt">
          <p>Limit access using physical barriers.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.7_gdn">
          <p>Physical barriers include bollards, concrete slabs, jersey walls, and hydraulic active vehicle barriers.</p>
        </part>

        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(07)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>list of physical barriers to limit access to the system</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(07)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-3.8">
        <title>Access Control Vestibules</title>
        <param id="pe-03.08_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-3.8_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="locations within the facility"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(08)_ODP"/>
          <label>locations</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>locations within the facility where access control vestibules are to be employed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-03(08)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-3(8)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(08)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-03.08"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-3.8_smt">
          <p>Employ access control vestibules at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.08_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-3.8_gdn">
          <p>An access control vestibule is part of a physical access control system that typically provides a space between two sets of interlocking doors. Vestibules are designed to prevent unauthorized individuals from following authorized individuals into facilities with controlled access. This activity, also known as piggybacking or tailgating, results in unauthorized access to the facility. Interlocking door controllers can be used to limit the number of individuals who enter controlled access points and to provide containment areas while authorization for physical access is verified. Interlocking door controllers can be fully automated (i.e., controlling the opening and closing of the doors) or partially automated (i.e., using security guards to control the number of individuals entering the containment area).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(08)"/>
          <p>access control vestibules are employed at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-03.08_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-3.8_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(08)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access control</p>
            <p>list of access control vestibules and locations</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(08)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-3.8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-03(08)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for vestibules to prevent unauthorized access.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pe-4">
      <title>Access Control for Transmission</title>
      <param id="pe-04_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-4_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>system distribution and transmission lines</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>system distribution and transmission lines requiring physical access controls are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pe-04_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-4_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>security controls</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>security controls to be implemented to control physical access to system distribution and transmission lines within the organizational facility are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-04"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-4"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-04"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#at-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pe-4_smt">
        <p>Control physical access to <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-04_odp.01"/> within organizational facilities using <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-04_odp.02"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pe-4_gdn">
        <p>Security controls applied to system distribution and transmission lines prevent accidental damage, disruption, and physical tampering. Such controls may also be necessary to prevent eavesdropping or modification of unencrypted transmissions. Security controls used to control physical access to system distribution and transmission lines include disconnected or locked spare jacks, locked wiring closets, protection of cabling by conduit or cable trays, and wiretapping sensors.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04"/>
        <p>physical access to <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-04_odp.01"/> within organizational facilities is controlled using <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-04_odp.02"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-4_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing access control for transmission mediums</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>facility communications and wiring diagrams</p>
          <p>list of physical security safeguards applied to system distribution and transmission lines</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-04-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for access control to distribution and transmission lines</p>
          <p>mechanisms/security safeguards supporting and/or implementing access control to distribution and transmission lines</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pe-5">
      <title>Access Control for Output Devices</title>
      <param id="pe-05_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-5_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-05_ODP"/>
        <label>output devices</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>output devices that require physical access control to output are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-05"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-5"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-05"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-05"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#4c501da5-9d79-4cb6-ba80-97260e1ce327"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-18"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pe-5_smt">
        <p>Control physical access to output from <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-05_odp"/> to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pe-5_gdn">
        <p>Controlling physical access to output devices includes placing output devices in locked rooms or other secured areas with keypad or card reader access controls and allowing access to authorized individuals only, placing output devices in locations that can be monitored by personnel, installing monitor or screen filters, and using headphones. Examples of output devices include monitors, printers, scanners, audio devices, facsimile machines, and copiers.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-05"/>
        <p>physical access to output from <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-05_odp"/> is controlled to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-5_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-05-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing access control for display medium</p>
          <p>facility layout of system components</p>
          <p>actual displays from system components</p>
          <p>list of output devices and associated outputs requiring physical access controls</p>
          <p>physical access control logs or records for areas containing output devices and related outputs</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-05-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with physical access control responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-05-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for access control to output devices</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing access control to output devices</p>
        </part>
      </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-5.2">

        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-05(02)"/>

          <p>Methods for linking individual identity to the receipt of output from output devices include installing security functionality on facsimile machines, copiers, and printers. Such functionality allows organizations to implement authentication on output devices prior to the release of output to individuals.</p>
        </part>

          </part>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="pe-6">
      <title>Monitoring Physical Access</title>
      <param id="pe-06_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to review physical access logs is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pe-06_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="events or potential indications of events"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>events</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>events or potential indication of events requiring physical access logs to be reviewed are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-06"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-6"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-06"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ca-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cp-10"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ir-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ir-8"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pe-6_smt">
        <part name="item" id="pe-6_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides to detect and respond to physical security incidents;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-6_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Review physical access logs <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06_odp.01"/> and upon occurrence of <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06_odp.02"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-6_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Coordinate results of reviews and investigations with the organizational incident response capability.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pe-6_gdn">
        <p>Physical access monitoring includes publicly accessible areas within organizational facilities. Examples of physical access monitoring include the employment of guards, video surveillance equipment (i.e., cameras), and sensor devices. Reviewing physical access logs can help identify suspicious activity, anomalous events, or potential threats. The reviews can be supported by audit logging controls, such as <a href="#au-2">AU-2</a> , if the access logs are part of an automated system. Organizational incident response capabilities include investigations of physical security incidents and responses to the incidents. Incidents include security violations or suspicious physical access activities. Suspicious physical access activities include accesses outside of normal work hours, repeated accesses to areas not normally accessed, accesses for unusual lengths of time, and out-of-sequence accesses.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06"/>
        <part id="pe-6_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06a."/>
          <p>physical access to the facility where the system resides is monitored to detect and respond to physical security incidents;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06b."/>
          <part id="pe-6_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06b.[01]"/>
            <p>physical access logs are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-6_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06b.[02]"/>
            <p>physical access logs are reviewed upon occurrence of <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06c."/>
          <part id="pe-6_obj.c-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06c.[01]"/>
            <p>results of reviews are coordinated with organizational incident response capabilities;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-6_obj.c-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06c.[02]"/>
            <p>results of investigations are coordinated with organizational incident response capabilities.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing physical access monitoring</p>
          <p>physical access logs or records</p>
          <p>physical access monitoring records</p>
          <p>physical access log reviews</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with physical access monitoring responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with incident response responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for monitoring physical access</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access monitoring</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the review of physical access logs</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-6.1">
        <title>Intrusion Alarms and Surveillance Equipment</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-6(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-06.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-6.1_smt">
          <p>Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides using physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-6.1_gdn">
          <p>Physical intrusion alarms can be employed to alert security personnel when unauthorized access to the facility is attempted. Alarm systems work in conjunction with physical barriers, physical access control systems, and security guards by triggering a response when these other forms of security have been compromised or breached. Physical intrusion alarms can include different types of sensor devices, such as motion sensors, contact sensors, and broken glass sensors. Surveillance equipment includes video cameras installed at strategic locations throughout the facility.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)"/>
          <part id="pe-6.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)[01]"/>
            <p>physical access to the facility where the system resides is monitored using physical intrusion alarms;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-6.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)[02]"/>
            <p>physical access to the facility where the system resides is monitored using physical surveillance equipment.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>physical access logs or records</p>
            <p>physical access monitoring records</p>
            <p>physical access log reviews</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access monitoring responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with incident response responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for monitoring physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-6.2">
        <title>Automated Intrusion Recognition and Responses</title>
        <param id="pe-06.02_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>classes or types of intrusions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>classes or types of intrusions to be recognized by automated mechanisms are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pe-06.02_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.2_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>response actions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>response actions to be initiated by automated mechanisms when organization-defined classes or types of intrusions are recognized are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pe-06.02_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.2_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>automated mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>automated mechanisms used to recognize classes or types of intrusions and initiate response actions (defined in <a href="#pe-06.02_odp.02">PE-06(02)_ODP</a>) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-06(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-6(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-06.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-6.2_smt">
          <p>Recognize <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.02_odp.01"/> and initiate <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.02_odp.02"/> using <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.02_odp.03"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-6.2_gdn">
          <p>Response actions can include notifying selected organizational personnel or law enforcement personnel. Automated mechanisms implemented to initiate response actions include system alert notifications, email and text messages, and activating door locking mechanisms. Physical access monitoring can be coordinated with intrusion detection systems and system monitoring capabilities to provide integrated threat coverage for the organization.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)"/>
          <part id="pe-6.2_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)[01]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.02_odp.01"/> are recognized;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-6.2_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)[02]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.02_odp.02"/> are initiated using <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.02_odp.03"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>list of response actions to be initiated when specific classes/types of intrusions are recognized</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access monitoring responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for monitoring physical access</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing recognition of classes/types of intrusions and initiation of a response</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-6.3">
        <title>Video Surveillance</title>
        <param id="pe-06.03_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>operational areas</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>operational areas where video surveillance is to be employed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pe-06.03_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.3_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>frequency at which to review video recordings is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pe-06.03_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.3_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>time period</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>time period for which to retain video recordings is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-06(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-6(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-06.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-6.3_smt">
          <part name="item" id="pe-6.3_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Employ video surveillance of <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.03_odp.01"/>;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="pe-6.3_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Review video recordings <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.03_odp.02"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="pe-6.3_smt.c">
            <prop name="label" value="(c)"/>
            <p>Retain video recordings for <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.03_odp.03"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-6.3_gdn">
          <p>Video surveillance focuses on recording activity in specified areas for the purposes of subsequent review, if circumstances so warrant. Video recordings are typically reviewed to detect anomalous events or incidents. Monitoring the surveillance video is not required, although organizations may choose to do so. There may be legal considerations when performing and retaining video surveillance, especially if such surveillance is in a public location.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)"/>
          <part id="pe-6.3_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)(a)"/>
            <p>video surveillance of <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.03_odp.01"/> is employed;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.3_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-6.3_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)(b)"/>
            <p>video recordings are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.03_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.3_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pe-6.3_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)(c)"/>
            <p>video recordings are retained for <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.03_odp.03"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.3_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>video surveillance equipment used to monitor operational areas</p>
            <p>video recordings of operational areas where video surveillance is employed</p>
            <p>video surveillance equipment logs or records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access monitoring responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for monitoring physical access</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing video surveillance</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pe-6.4">
        <title>Monitoring Physical Access to Systems</title>
        <param id="pe-06.04_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pe-6.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="physical spaces containing one or more components of the system"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(04)_ODP"/>
          <label>physical spaces</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>physical spaces containing one or more components of the system are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PE-06(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PE-6(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pe-06.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pe-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pe-6.4_smt">
          <p>Monitor physical access to the system in addition to the physical access monitoring of the facility at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.04_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pe-6.4_gdn">
          <p>Monitoring physical access to systems provides additional monitoring for those areas within facilities where there is a concentration of system components, including server rooms, media storage areas, and communications centers. Physical access monitoring can be coordinated with intrusion detection systems and system monitoring capabilities to provide comprehensive and integrated threat coverage for the organization.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(04)"/>
          <p>physical access to the system is monitored in addition to the physical access monitoring of the facility at <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-06.04_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-6.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Physical and environmental protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>physical access control logs or records</p>
            <p>physical access control devices</p>
            <p>access authorizations</p>
            <p>access credentials</p>
            <p>list of areas within the facility containing concentrations of system components or system components requiring additional physical access monitoring</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with physical access monitoring responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-6.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-06(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for monitoring physical access to the system</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access monitoring for facility areas containing system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

      <param id="pe-08_odp.01">

        <guideline>
          <p>personnel to whom visitor access records anomalies are reported to is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>

        <prop name="label" value="PE-8"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08"/>

      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-6"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pe-8_smt">
        <part name="item" id="pe-8_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Maintain visitor access records to the facility where the system resides for <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-08_odp.01"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-8_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Review visitor access records <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-08_odp.02"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pe-8_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Report anomalies in visitor access records to <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-08_odp.03"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pe-8_gdn">
        <p>Visitor access records include the names and organizations of individuals visiting, visitor signatures, forms of identification, dates of access, entry and departure times, purpose of visits, and the names and organizations of individuals visited. Access record reviews determine if access authorizations are current and are still required to support organizational mission and business functions. Access records are not required for publicly accessible areas.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08"/>
        <part id="pe-8_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08a."/>
          <p>visitor access records for the facility where the system resides are maintained for <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-08_odp.01"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-8_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-8_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08b."/>
          <p>visitor access records are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-08_odp.02"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-8_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pe-8_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08c."/>
          <p>visitor access records anomalies are reported to <insert type="param" id-ref="pe-08_odp.03"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-8_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pe-8_smt"/>
      </part>

        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08-Examine"/>

          <p>procedures addressing visitor access records</p>

          <p>visitor access record or log reviews</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
          <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pe-8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">

          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PE-08-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for maintaining and reviewing visitor access records</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the maintenance and review of visitor access records</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        </part>
