      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-21"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-3_smt">
        <part name="item" id="ps-3_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the system; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-3_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Rescreen individuals in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-3_prm_1"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-3_gdn">
        <p>Personnel screening and rescreening activities reflect applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, guidelines, and specific criteria established for the risk designations of assigned positions. Examples of personnel screening include background investigations and agency checks. Organizations may define different rescreening conditions and frequencies for personnel accessing systems based on types of information processed, stored, or transmitted by the systems.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03"/>
        <part id="ps-3_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03a."/>
          <p>individuals are screened prior to authorizing access to the system;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03b."/>
          <part id="ps-3_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03b.[01]"/>
            <p>individuals are rescreened in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-3_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03b.[02]"/>
            <p>where rescreening is so indicated, individuals are rescreened <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing personnel screening</p>
          <p>records of screened personnel</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for personnel screening</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-3.1">
        <title>Classified Information</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-03(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-3(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-03.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-3.1_smt">
          <p>Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are cleared and indoctrinated to the highest classification level of the information to which they have access on the system.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-3.1_gdn">
          <p>Classified information is the most sensitive information that the Federal Government processes, stores, or transmits. It is imperative that individuals have the requisite security clearances and system access authorizations prior to gaining access to such information. Access authorizations are enforced by system access controls (see <a href="#ac-3">AC-3</a> ) and flow controls (see <a href="#ac-4">AC-4</a>).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)"/>
          <part id="ps-3.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)[01]"/>
            <p>individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are cleared;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-3.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)[02]"/>
            <p>individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are indoctrinated to the highest classification level of the information to which they have access on the system.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing personnel screening</p>
            <p>records of screened personnel</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for clearing and indoctrinating personnel for access to classified information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-3.2">
        <title>Formal Indoctrination</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-03(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-3(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-03.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-3.2_smt">
          <p>Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting types of classified information that require formal indoctrination, are formally indoctrinated for all the relevant types of information to which they have access on the system.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-3.2_gdn">
          <p>Types of classified information that require formal indoctrination include Special Access Program (SAP), Restricted Data (RD), and Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(02)"/>
          <p>individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting types of classified information that require formal indoctrination are formally indoctrinated for all of the relevant types of information to which they have access on the system.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing personnel screening</p>
            <p>indoctrination documents</p>
            <p>records of screened personnel</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for formal indoctrination for all relevant types of information to which personnel have access</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-3.3">
        <title>Information Requiring Special Protective Measures</title>
        <param id="ps-03.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-3.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)_ODP"/>
          <label>additional personnel screening criteria</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>additional personnel screening criteria to be satisfied for individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-03(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-3(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-03.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-3.3_smt">
          <p>Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection:</p>
          <part name="item" id="ps-3.3_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Have valid access authorizations that are demonstrated by assigned official government duties; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ps-3.3_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Satisfy <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.03_odp"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-3.3_gdn">
          <p>Organizational information that requires special protection includes controlled unclassified information. Personnel security criteria include position sensitivity background screening requirements.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)"/>
          <part id="ps-3.3_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)(a)"/>
            <p>individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection have valid access authorizations that are demonstrated by assigned official government duties;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.3_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-3.3_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)(b)"/>
            <p>individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection satisfy <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.03_odp"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.3_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>access control policy, procedures addressing personnel screening</p>
            <p>records of screened personnel</p>
            <p>screening criteria</p>
            <p>records of access authorizations</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for ensuring valid access authorizations for information requiring special protection</p>
            <p>organizational process for additional personnel screening for information requiring special protection</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-3.4">
        <title>Citizenship Requirements</title>
        <param id="ps-03.04_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-3.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>information types</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information types that are processed, stored, or transmitted by a system that require individuals accessing the system to meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.04_odp.02"/> are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ps-03.04_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-3.4_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>citizenship requirements</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>citizenship requirements to be met by individuals to access a system processing, storing, or transmitting information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-03(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-3(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-03.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-3.4_smt">
          <p>Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.04_odp.01"/> meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.04_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-3.4_gdn">
          <p>None.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)"/>
          <p>individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.04_odp.01"/> meet <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-03.04_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-3.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>access control policy, procedures addressing personnel screening</p>
            <p>records of screened personnel</p>
            <p>screening criteria</p>
            <p>records of access authorizations</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-3.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-03(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for ensuring valid access authorizations for information requiring citizenship</p>
            <p>organizational process for additional personnel screening for information requiring citizenship</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ps-4">
      <title>Personnel Termination</title>
      <param id="ps-04_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-4_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>time period</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>a time period within which to disable system access is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-04_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-4_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>information security topics</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>information security topics to be discussed when conducting exit interviews are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-04"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-4"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-04"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-4_smt">
        <p>Upon termination of individual employment:</p>
        <part name="item" id="ps-4_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Disable system access within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04_odp.01"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-4_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Terminate or revoke any authenticators and credentials associated with the individual;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-4_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Conduct exit interviews that include a discussion of <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04_odp.02"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-4_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Retrieve all security-related organizational system-related property; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-4_smt.e">
          <prop name="label" value="e."/>
          <p>Retain access to organizational information and systems formerly controlled by terminated individual.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-4_gdn">
        <p>System property includes hardware authentication tokens, system administration technical manuals, keys, identification cards, and building passes. Exit interviews ensure that terminated individuals understand the security constraints imposed by being former employees and that proper accountability is achieved for system-related property. Security topics at exit interviews include reminding individuals of nondisclosure agreements and potential limitations on future employment. Exit interviews may not always be possible for some individuals, including in cases related to the unavailability of supervisors, illnesses, or job abandonment. Exit interviews are important for individuals with security clearances. The timely execution of termination actions is essential for individuals who have been terminated for cause. In certain situations, organizations consider disabling the system accounts of individuals who are being terminated prior to the individuals being notified.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04"/>
        <part id="ps-4_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04a."/>
          <p>upon termination of individual employment, system access is disabled within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04_odp.01"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04b."/>
          <p>upon termination of individual employment, any authenticators and credentials are terminated or revoked;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04c."/>
          <p>upon termination of individual employment, exit interviews that include a discussion of <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04_odp.02"/> are conducted;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04d."/>
          <p>upon termination of individual employment, all security-related organizational system-related property is retrieved;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4_smt.d"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4_obj.e" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04e."/>
          <p>upon termination of individual employment, access to organizational information and systems formerly controlled by the terminated individual are retained.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4_smt.e"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing personnel termination</p>
          <p>records of personnel termination actions</p>
          <p>list of system accounts</p>
          <p>records of terminated or revoked authenticators/credentials</p>
          <p>records of exit interviews</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for personnel termination</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing personnel termination notifications</p>
          <p>mechanisms for disabling system access/revoking authenticators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-4.1">
        <title>Post-employment Requirements</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-4(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-04.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-4.1_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ps-4.1_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Notify terminated individuals of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for the protection of organizational information; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ps-4.1_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Require terminated individuals to sign an acknowledgment of post-employment requirements as part of the organizational termination process.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-4.1_gdn">
          <p>Organizations consult with the Office of the General Counsel regarding matters of post-employment requirements on terminated individuals.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)"/>
          <part id="ps-4.1_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)(a)"/>
            <p>terminated individuals are notified of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for the protection of organizational information;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4.1_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-4.1_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)(b)"/>
            <p>terminated individuals are required to sign an acknowledgement of post-employment requirements as part of the organizational termination process.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4.1_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing personnel termination</p>
            <p>signed post-employment acknowledgement forms</p>
            <p>list of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for post-employment requirements</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-4.2">
        <title>Automated Actions</title>
        <param id="ps-04.02_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-4.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>automated mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>automated mechanisms to notify personnel or roles of individual termination actions and/or to disable access to system resources are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="ps-04.02_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-4.2_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)_ODP[02]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>notify <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04.02_odp.03"/> of individual termination actions</choice>
            <choice>disable access to system resources</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="ps-04.02_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-4.2_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>personnel or roles</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>personnel or roles to be notified upon termination of an individual is/are defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-4(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-04.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-4.2_smt">
          <p>Use <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04.02_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04.02_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-4.2_gdn">
          <p>In organizations with many employees, not all personnel who need to know about termination actions receive the appropriate notifications, or if such notifications are received, they may not occur in a timely manner. Automated mechanisms can be used to send automatic alerts or notifications to organizational personnel or roles when individuals are terminated. Such automatic alerts or notifications can be conveyed in a variety of ways, including via telephone, electronic mail, text message, or websites. Automated mechanisms can also be employed to quickly and thoroughly disable access to system resources after an employee is terminated.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04.02_odp.01"/> are used to <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-04.02_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-4.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing personnel termination</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>records of personnel termination actions</p>
            <p>automated notifications of employee terminations</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-4.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-04(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for personnel termination</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing personnel termination notifications</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ps-5">
      <title>Personnel Transfer</title>
      <param id="ps-05_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-5_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>transfer or reassignment actions</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>transfer or reassignment actions to be initiated following transfer or reassignment are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-05_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-5_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>time period following the formal transfer action</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the time period within which transfer or reassignment actions must occur following transfer or reassignment is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-05_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-5_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to be notified when individuals are reassigned or transferred to other positions within the organization is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-05_odp.04">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-5_prm_4"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05_ODP[04]"/>
        <label>time period</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>time period within which to notify organization-defined personnel or roles when individuals are reassigned or transferred to other positions within the organization is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-05"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-5"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-05"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-5_smt">
        <part name="item" id="ps-5_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Review and confirm ongoing operational need for current logical and physical access authorizations to systems and facilities when individuals are reassigned or transferred to other positions within the organization;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-5_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Initiate <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.01"/> within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.02"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-5_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Modify access authorization as needed to correspond with any changes in operational need due to reassignment or transfer; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-5_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Notify <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.03"/> within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.04"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-5_gdn">
        <p>Personnel transfer applies when reassignments or transfers of individuals are permanent or of such extended duration as to make the actions warranted. Organizations define actions appropriate for the types of reassignments or transfers, whether permanent or extended. Actions that may be required for personnel transfers or reassignments to other positions within organizations include returning old and issuing new keys, identification cards, and building passes; closing system accounts and establishing new accounts; changing system access authorizations (i.e., privileges); and providing for access to official records to which individuals had access at previous work locations and in previous system accounts.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05"/>
        <part id="ps-5_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05a."/>
          <p>the ongoing operational need for current logical and physical access authorizations to systems and facilities are reviewed and confirmed when individuals are reassigned or transferred to other positions within the organization;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-5_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-5_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05b."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.01"/> are initiated within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.02"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-5_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-5_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05c."/>
          <p>access authorization is modified as needed to correspond with any changes in operational need due to reassignment or transfer;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-5_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-5_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05d."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.03"/> are notified within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-05_odp.04"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-5_smt.d"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-5_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing personnel transfer</p>
          <p>records of personnel transfer actions</p>
          <p>list of system and facility access authorizations</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-05-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for personnel transfer</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing personnel transfer notifications</p>
          <p>mechanisms for disabling system access/revoking authenticators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ps-6">
      <title>Access Agreements</title>
      <param id="ps-06_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-6_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to review and update access agreements is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-06_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-6_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to re-sign access agreements to maintain access to organizational information is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-06"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-6"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-06"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-17"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pl-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-21"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-12"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-6_smt">
        <part name="item" id="ps-6_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Develop and document access agreements for organizational systems;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-6_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Review and update the access agreements <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-06_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-6_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Verify that individuals requiring access to organizational information and systems:</p>
          <part name="item" id="ps-6_smt.c.1">
            <prop name="label" value="1."/>
            <p>Sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ps-6_smt.c.2">
            <prop name="label" value="2."/>
            <p>Re-sign access agreements to maintain access to organizational systems when access agreements have been updated or <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-06_odp.02"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-6_gdn">
        <p>Access agreements include nondisclosure agreements, acceptable use agreements, rules of behavior, and conflict-of-interest agreements. Signed access agreements include an acknowledgement that individuals have read, understand, and agree to abide by the constraints associated with organizational systems to which access is authorized. Organizations can use electronic signatures to acknowledge access agreements unless specifically prohibited by organizational policy.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06"/>
        <part id="ps-6_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06a."/>
          <p>access agreements are developed and documented for organizational systems;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06b."/>
          <p>the access agreements are reviewed and updated <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-06_odp.01"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06c."/>
          <part id="ps-6_obj.c.1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06c.01"/>
            <p>individuals requiring access to organizational information and systems sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6_smt.c.1"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-6_obj.c.2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06c.02"/>
            <p>individuals requiring access to organizational information and systems re-sign access agreements to maintain access to organizational systems when access agreements have been updated or <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-06_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6_smt.c.2"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>personnel security procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing access agreements for organizational information and systems</p>
          <p>access control policy</p>
          <p>access control procedures</p>
          <p>access agreements (including non-disclosure agreements, acceptable use agreements, rules of behavior, and conflict-of-interest agreements)</p>
          <p>documentation of access agreement reviews, updates, and re-signing</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel who have signed/resigned access agreements</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for reviewing, updating, and re-signing access agreements</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting the reviewing, updating, and re-signing of access agreements</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-6.1">
        <title>Information Requiring Special Protection</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-6(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-06.01"/>
        <prop name="status" value="withdrawn"/>
        <link rel="incorporated-into" href="#ps-3"/>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-6.2">
        <title>Classified Information Requiring Special Protection</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-06(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-6(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-06.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-6.2_smt">
          <p>Verify that access to classified information requiring special protection is granted only to individuals who:</p>
          <part name="item" id="ps-6.2_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Have a valid access authorization that is demonstrated by assigned official government duties;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ps-6.2_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Satisfy associated personnel security criteria; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ps-6.2_smt.c">
            <prop name="label" value="(c)"/>
            <p>Have read, understood, and signed a nondisclosure agreement.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-6.2_gdn">
          <p>Classified information that requires special protection includes collateral information, Special Access Program (SAP) information, and Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI). Personnel security criteria reflect applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)"/>
          <part id="ps-6.2_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)(a)"/>
            <p>access to classified information requiring special protection is granted only to individuals who have a valid access authorization that is demonstrated by assigned official government duties;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.2_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-6.2_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)(b)"/>
            <p>access to classified information requiring special protection is granted only to individuals who satisfy associated personnel security criteria;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-6.2_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)(c)"/>
            <p>access to classified information requiring special protection is granted only to individuals who have read, understood, and signed a non-disclosure agreement.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.2_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing access agreements for organizational information and systems</p>
            <p>access agreements</p>
            <p>access authorizations</p>
            <p>personnel security criteria</p>
            <p>signed non-disclosure agreements</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel who have signed non-disclosure agreements</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for access to classified information requiring special protection</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="ps-6.3">
        <title>Post-employment Requirements</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-06(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-6(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-06.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#ps-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ps-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="ps-6.3_smt">
          <part name="item" id="ps-6.3_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Notify individuals of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for protection of organizational information; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="ps-6.3_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Require individuals to sign an acknowledgment of these requirements, if applicable, as part of granting initial access to covered information.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="ps-6.3_gdn">
          <p>Organizations consult with the Office of the General Counsel regarding matters of post-employment requirements on terminated individuals.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)"/>
          <part id="ps-6.3_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)(a)"/>
            <p>individuals are notified of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for the protection of organizational information;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.3_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="ps-6.3_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)(b)"/>
            <p>individuals are required to sign an acknowledgement of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements as part of being granted initial access to covered information.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.3_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-6.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personnel security policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing access agreements for organizational information and systems</p>
            <p>signed post-employment acknowledgement forms</p>
            <p>access agreements</p>
            <p>list of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel who have signed access agreements that include post-employment requirements</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-6.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-06(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for post-employment requirements</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting notifications and individual acknowledgements of post-employment requirements</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ps-7">
      <title>External Personnel Security</title>
      <param id="ps-07_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-7_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to be notified of any personnel transfers or terminations of external personnel who possess organizational credentials and/or badges or who have system privileges is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-07_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-7_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>time period</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>time period within which third-party providers are required to notify organization-defined personnel or roles of any personnel transfers or terminations of external personnel who possess organizational credentials and/or badges or who have system privileges is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-07"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-7"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-07"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#77faf0bc-c394-44ad-9154-bbac3b79c8ad"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#737513fa-6758-403f-831d-5ddab5e23cb3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#at-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#at-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-21"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-7_smt">
        <part name="item" id="ps-7_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Establish personnel security requirements, including security roles and responsibilities for external providers;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-7_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Require external providers to comply with personnel security policies and procedures established by the organization;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-7_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Document personnel security requirements;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-7_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Require external providers to notify <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-07_odp.01"/> of any personnel transfers or terminations of external personnel who possess organizational credentials and/or badges, or who have system privileges within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-07_odp.02"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-7_smt.e">
          <prop name="label" value="e."/>
          <p>Monitor provider compliance with personnel security requirements.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-7_gdn">
        <p>External provider refers to organizations other than the organization operating or acquiring the system. External providers include service bureaus, contractors, and other organizations that provide system development, information technology services, testing or assessment services, outsourced applications, and network/security management. Organizations explicitly include personnel security requirements in acquisition-related documents. External providers may have personnel working at organizational facilities with credentials, badges, or system privileges issued by organizations. Notifications of external personnel changes ensure the appropriate termination of privileges and credentials. Organizations define the transfers and terminations deemed reportable by security-related characteristics that include functions, roles, and the nature of credentials or privileges associated with transferred or terminated individuals.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07"/>
        <part id="ps-7_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07a."/>
          <p>personnel security requirements are established, including security roles and responsibilities for external providers;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-7_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-7_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07b."/>
          <p>external providers are required to comply with personnel security policies and procedures established by the organization;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-7_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-7_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07c."/>
          <p>personnel security requirements are documented;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-7_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-7_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07d."/>
          <p>external providers are required to notify <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-07_odp.01"/> of any personnel transfers or terminations of external personnel who possess organizational credentials and/or badges or who have system privileges within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-07_odp.02"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-7_smt.d"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-7_obj.e" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07e."/>
          <p>provider compliance with personnel security requirements is monitored.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-7_smt.e"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-7_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing external personnel security</p>
          <p>list of personnel security requirements</p>
          <p>acquisition documents</p>
          <p>service-level agreements</p>
          <p>compliance monitoring process</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>external providers</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with account management responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-07-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for managing and monitoring external personnel security</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the monitoring of provider compliance</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ps-8">
      <title>Personnel Sanctions</title>
      <param id="ps-08_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-8_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to be notified when a formal employee sanctions process is initiated is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ps-08_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ps-8_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>time period</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the time period within which organization-defined personnel or roles must be notified when a formal employee sanctions process is initiated is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-08"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-8"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-08"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pl-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-1"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-8_smt">
        <part name="item" id="ps-8_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Employ a formal sanctions process for individuals failing to comply with established information security and privacy policies and procedures; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="ps-8_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Notify <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-08_odp.01"/> within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-08_odp.02"/> when a formal employee sanctions process is initiated, identifying the individual sanctioned and the reason for the sanction.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-8_gdn">
        <p>Organizational sanctions reflect applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. Sanctions processes are described in access agreements and can be included as part of general personnel policies for organizations and/or specified in security and privacy policies. Organizations consult with the Office of the General Counsel regarding matters of employee sanctions.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08"/>
        <part id="ps-8_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08a."/>
          <p>a formal sanctions process is employed for individuals failing to comply with established information security and privacy policies and procedures;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-8_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-8_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08b."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="ps-08_odp.01"/> is/are notified within <insert type="param" id-ref="ps-08_odp.02"/> when a formal employee sanctions process is initiated, identifying the individual sanctioned and the reason for the sanction.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-8_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-8_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>personnel security procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing personnel sanctions</p>
          <p>access agreements (including non-disclosure agreements, acceptable use agreements, rules of behavior, and conflict-of-interest agreements)</p>
          <p>list of personnel or roles to be notified of formal employee sanctions</p>
          <p>records or notifications of formal employee sanctions</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>legal counsel</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-08-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for managing formal employee sanctions</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing formal employee sanctions notifications</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ps-9">
      <title>Position Descriptions</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PS-09"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PS-9"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="ps-09"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#276bd50a-7e58-48e5-a405-8c8cb91d7a5f"/>
      <part name="statement" id="ps-9_smt">
        <p>Incorporate security and privacy roles and responsibilities into organizational position descriptions.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="ps-9_gdn">
        <p>Specification of security and privacy roles in individual organizational position descriptions facilitates clarity in understanding the security or privacy responsibilities associated with the roles and the role-based security and privacy training requirements for the roles.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09"/>
        <part id="ps-9_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09[01]"/>
          <p>security roles and responsibilities are incorporated into organizational position descriptions;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-9_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="ps-9_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09[02]"/>
          <p>privacy roles and responsibilities are incorporated into organizational position descriptions.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-9_smt"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#ps-9_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-9_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personnel security policy</p>
          <p>personnel security procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing position descriptions</p>
          <p>security and privacy position descriptions</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>privacy program plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with human capital management responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="ps-9_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PS-09-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for managing position descriptions</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
  </group>
  <group class="family" id="pt">
    <title>Personally Identifiable Information Processing and Transparency</title>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pt-1">
      <title>Policy and Procedures</title>
      <param id="pt-1_prm_1">
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="pt-01_odp.01"/>
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="pt-01_odp.02"/>
        <label>organization-defined personnel or roles</label>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.01">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to whom the personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy is to be disseminated is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.02">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to whom the personally identifiable information processing and transparency procedures are to be disseminated is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-1_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[03]"/>
        <select how-many="one-or-more">
          <choice>organization-level</choice>
          <choice>mission/business process-level</choice>
          <choice>system-level</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.04">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-1_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[04]"/>
        <label>official</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>an official to manage the personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.05">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-1_prm_4"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[05]"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which the current personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy is reviewed and updated is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.06">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-1_prm_5"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[06]"/>
        <label>events</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>events that would require the current personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy to be reviewed and updated are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-01_odp.07">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-1_prm_6"/>

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-01_ODP[08]"/>
