    <control class="SP800-53" id="pt-4">
      <title>Consent</title>
      <param id="pt-04_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-4_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04_ODP"/>
        <label>tools or mechanisms</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the tools or mechanisms to be implemented for individuals to consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-04"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-4"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-04"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#737513fa-6758-403f-831d-5ddab5e23cb3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-5"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pt-4_smt">
        <p>Implement <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04_odp"/> for individuals to consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information prior to its collection that facilitate individuals’ informed decision-making.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pt-4_gdn">
        <p>Consent allows individuals to participate in making decisions about the processing of their information and transfers some of the risk that arises from the processing of personally identifiable information from the organization to an individual. Consent may be required by applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, or guidelines. Otherwise, when selecting consent as a control, organizations consider whether individuals can be reasonably expected to understand and accept the privacy risks that arise from their authorization. Organizations consider whether other controls may more effectively mitigate privacy risk either alone or in conjunction with consent. Organizations also consider any demographic or contextual factors that may influence the understanding or behavior of individuals with respect to the processing carried out by the system or organization. When soliciting consent from individuals, organizations consider the appropriate mechanism for obtaining consent, including the type of consent (e.g., opt-in, opt-out), how to properly authenticate and identity proof individuals and how to obtain consent through electronic means. In addition, organizations consider providing a mechanism for individuals to revoke consent once it has been provided, as appropriate. Finally, organizations consider usability factors to help individuals understand the risks being accepted when providing consent, including the use of plain language and avoiding technical jargon.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04"/>
        <p>the <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04_odp"/> are implemented for individuals to consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information prior to its collection that facilitate individuals’ informed decision-making.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-4_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
          <p>consent policies and procedures</p>
          <p>consent tools and mechanisms</p>
          <p>consent presentation or display (user interface)</p>
          <p>evidence of individuals’ consent</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for the collection of personally identifiable information</p>
          <p>consent tools or mechanisms for users to authorize the processing of their personally identifiable information</p>
          <p>mechanisms implementing consent</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-4.1">
        <title>Tailored Consent</title>
        <param id="pt-04.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-4.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>tailoring mechanisms for processing selected elements of personally identifiable information permissions are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-4(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-04.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-4.1_smt">
          <p>Provide <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.01_odp"/> to allow individuals to tailor processing permissions to selected elements of personally identifiable information.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-4.1_gdn">
          <p>While some processing may be necessary for the basic functionality of the product or service, other processing may not. In these circumstances, organizations allow individuals to select how specific personally identifiable information elements may be processed. More tailored consent may help reduce privacy risk, increase individual satisfaction, and avoid adverse behaviors, such as abandonment of the product or service.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.01_odp"/> are provided to allow individuals to tailor processing permissions to selected elements of personally identifiable information.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-4.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>consent policies and procedures</p>
            <p>consent tools and mechanisms</p>
            <p>consent presentation or display (user interface)</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with user interface or user experience responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for consenting to the processing of personally identifiable information</p>
            <p>consent tools or mechanisms</p>
            <p>mechanisms implementing consent</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-4.2">
        <title>Just-in-time Consent</title>
        <param id="pt-04.02_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-4.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>consent mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>consent mechanisms to be presented to individuals are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pt-04.02_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-4.2_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to present consent mechanisms to individuals is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="pt-04.02_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-4.2_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>personally identifiable information processing</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing to be presented in conjunction with organization-defined consent mechanisms is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-4(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-04.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-4.2_smt">
          <p>Present <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.02_odp.01"/> to individuals at <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.02_odp.02"/> and in conjunction with <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.02_odp.03"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-4.2_gdn">
          <p>Just-in-time consent enables individuals to participate in how their personally identifiable information is being processed at the time or in conjunction with specific types of data processing when such participation may be most useful to the individual. Individual assumptions about how personally identifiable information is being processed might not be accurate or reliable if time has passed since the individual last gave consent or the type of processing creates significant privacy risk. Organizations use discretion to determine when to use just-in-time consent and may use supporting information on demographics, focus groups, or surveys to learn more about individuals’ privacy interests and concerns.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.02_odp.01"/> are presented to individuals <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.02_odp.02"/> and in conjunction with <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.02_odp.03"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-4.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>consent policies and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with user interface or user experience responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for the collection of personally identifiable information</p>
            <p>mechanisms for obtaining just-in-time consent from users for the processing of their personally identifiable information</p>
            <p>mechanisms implementing just-in-time consent</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-4.3">
        <title>Revocation</title>
        <param id="pt-04.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-4.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(03)_ODP"/>
          <label>tools or mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the tools or mechanisms to be implemented for revoking consent to the processing of personally identifiable information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-04(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-4(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-04.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-4.3_smt">
          <p>Implement <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.03_odp"/> for individuals to revoke consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-4.3_gdn">
          <p>Revocation of consent enables individuals to exercise control over their initial consent decision when circumstances change. Organizations consider usability factors in enabling easy-to-use revocation capabilities.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(03)"/>
          <p>the <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-04.03_odp"/> are implemented for individuals to revoke consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-4.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>consent revocation policies and procedures</p>
            <p>consent revocation user interface or user experience</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with user interface or user experience responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-4.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-04(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for consenting to the processing of personally identifiable information</p>
            <p>tools or mechanisms for implementing consent revocation</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pt-5">
      <title>Privacy Notice</title>
      <param id="pt-05_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-5_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which a notice is provided to individuals after initial interaction with an organization is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="pt-05_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-5_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>information</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>information to be included with the notice about the processing of personally identifiable information is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-05"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-5"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-05"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#3671ff20-c17c-44d6-8a88-7de203fa74aa"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-20"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-22"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-42"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-18"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pt-5_smt">
        <p>Provide notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information that:</p>
        <part name="item" id="pt-5_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Is available to individuals upon first interacting with an organization, and subsequently at <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-05_odp.01"/>;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-5_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Is clear and easy-to-understand, expressing information about personally identifiable information processing in plain language;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-5_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Identifies the authority that authorizes the processing of personally identifiable information;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-5_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Identifies the purposes for which personally identifiable information is to be processed; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-5_smt.e">
          <prop name="label" value="e."/>
          <p>Includes <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-05_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pt-5_gdn">
        <p>Privacy notices help inform individuals about how their personally identifiable information is being processed by the system or organization. Organizations use privacy notices to inform individuals about how, under what authority, and for what purpose their personally identifiable information is processed, as well as other information such as choices individuals might have with respect to that processing and other parties with whom information is shared. Laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, or policies may require that privacy notices include specific elements or be provided in specific formats. Federal agency personnel consult with the senior agency official for privacy and legal counsel regarding when and where to provide privacy notices, as well as elements to include in privacy notices and required formats. In circumstances where laws or government-wide policies do not require privacy notices, organizational policies and determinations may require privacy notices and may serve as a source of the elements to include in privacy notices.</p>
        <p>Privacy risk assessments identify the privacy risks associated with the processing of personally identifiable information and may help organizations determine appropriate elements to include in a privacy notice to manage such risks. To help individuals understand how their information is being processed, organizations write materials in plain language and avoid technical jargon.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05"/>
        <part id="pt-5_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05a."/>
          <part id="pt-5_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05a.[01]"/>
            <p>a notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information is provided such that the notice is available to individuals upon first interacting with an organization;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-5_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05a.[02]"/>
            <p>a notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information is provided such that the notice is subsequently available to individuals <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-05_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05b."/>
          <p>a notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information is provided that is clear, easy-to-understand, and expresses information about personally identifiable information processing in plain language;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05c."/>
          <p>a notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information that identifies the authority that authorizes the processing of personally identifiable information is provided;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05d."/>
          <p>a notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information that identifies the purpose for which personally identifiable information is to be processed is provided;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.d"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5_obj.e" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05e."/>
          <p>a notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information which includes <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-05_odp.02"/> is provided.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt.e"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
          <p>privacy notice</p>
          <p>Privacy Act statements</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with user interface or user experience responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes and implementation support or mechanisms for providing notice to individuals regarding the processing of their personally identifiable information</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-5.1">
        <title>Just-in-time Notice</title>
        <param id="pt-05.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-5.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to present a notice of personally identifiable information processing is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-05(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-5(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-05.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pm-21"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-5.1_smt">
          <p>Present notice of personally identifiable information processing to individuals at a time and location where the individual provides personally identifiable information or in conjunction with a data action, or <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-05.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-5.1_gdn">
          <p>Just-in-time notices inform individuals of how organizations process their personally identifiable information at a time when such notices may be most useful to the individuals. Individual assumptions about how personally identifiable information will be processed might not be accurate or reliable if time has passed since the organization last presented notice or the circumstances under which the individual was last provided notice have changed. A just-in-time notice can explain data actions that organizations have identified as potentially giving rise to greater privacy risk for individuals. Organizations can use a just-in-time notice to update or remind individuals about specific data actions as they occur or highlight specific changes that occurred since last presenting notice. A just-in-time notice can be used in conjunction with just-in-time consent to explain what will occur if consent is declined. Organizations use discretion to determine when to use a just-in-time notice and may use supporting information on user demographics, focus groups, or surveys to learn about users’ privacy interests and concerns.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(01)"/>
          <p>a notice of personally identifiable information processing is presented to individuals at a time and location where the individual provides personally identifiable information, in conjunction with a data action, or <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-05.01_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with user interface or user experience responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes and implementation support or mechanisms for providing notice to individuals regarding the processing of their personally identifiable information</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-5.2">
        <title>Privacy Act Statements</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-05(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-5(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-05.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-5.2_smt">
          <p>Include Privacy Act statements on forms that collect information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records, or provide Privacy Act statements on separate forms that can be retained by individuals.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-5.2_gdn">
          <p>If a federal agency asks individuals to supply information that will become part of a system of records, the agency is required to provide a <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> statement on the form used to collect the information or on a separate form that can be retained by the individual. The agency provides a <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> statement in such circumstances regardless of whether the information will be collected on a paper or electronic form, on a website, on a mobile application, over the telephone, or through some other medium. This requirement ensures that the individual is provided with sufficient information about the request for information to make an informed decision on whether or not to respond.</p>
          <p><a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> statements provide formal notice to individuals of the authority that authorizes the solicitation of the information; whether providing the information is mandatory or voluntary; the principal purpose(s) for which the information is to be used; the published routine uses to which the information is subject; the effects on the individual, if any, of not providing all or any part of the information requested; and an appropriate citation and link to the relevant system of records notice. Federal agency personnel consult with the senior agency official for privacy and legal counsel regarding the notice provisions of the <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a>.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(02)"/>
          <p>Privacy Act statements are included on forms that collect information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records, or Privacy Act statements are provided on separate forms that can be retained by individuals.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-5.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
            <p>forms that include Privacy Act statements</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-5.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-05(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for including Privacy Act statements on forms that collect information or on separate forms that can be retained by individuals</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pt-6">
      <title>System of Records Notice</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-06"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-6"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-06"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#3671ff20-c17c-44d6-8a88-7de203fa74aa"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-20"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-5"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pt-6_smt">
        <p>For systems that process information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records:</p>
        <part name="item" id="pt-6_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Draft system of records notices in accordance with OMB guidance and submit new and significantly modified system of records notices to the OMB and appropriate congressional committees for advance review;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-6_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Publish system of records notices in the Federal Register; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-6_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Keep system of records notices accurate, up-to-date, and scoped in accordance with policy.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pt-6_gdn">
        <p>The <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> requires that federal agencies publish a system of records notice in the Federal Register upon the establishment and/or modification of a <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> system of records. As a general matter, a system of records notice is required when an agency maintains a group of any records under the control of the agency from which information is retrieved by the name of an individual or by some identifying number, symbol, or other identifier. The notice describes the existence and character of the system and identifies the system of records, the purpose(s) of the system, the authority for maintenance of the records, the categories of records maintained in the system, the categories of individuals about whom records are maintained, the routine uses to which the records are subject, and additional details about the system as described in <a href="#3671ff20-c17c-44d6-8a88-7de203fa74aa">OMB A-108</a>.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06"/>
        <part id="pt-6_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06a."/>
          <part id="pt-6_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06a.[01]"/>
            <p>system of records notices are drafted in accordance with OMB guidance for systems that process information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-6_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06a.[02]"/>
            <p>new and significantly modified system of records notices are submitted to the OMB and appropriate congressional committees for advance review for systems that process information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06b."/>
          <p>system of records notices are published in the Federal Register for systems that process information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06c."/>
          <p>system of records notices are kept accurate, up-to-date, and scoped in accordance with policy for systems that process information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
          <p>privacy notice</p>
          <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
          <p>Federal Register notices</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for Privacy Act system of records maintenance</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-6.1">
        <title>Routine Uses</title>
        <param id="pt-06.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-6.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to review all routine uses published in the system of records notice is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-6(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-06.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-6.1_smt">
          <p>Review all routine uses published in the system of records notice at <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-06.01_odp"/> to ensure continued accuracy, and to ensure that routine uses continue to be compatible with the purpose for which the information was collected.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-6.1_gdn">
          <p>A <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> routine use is a particular kind of disclosure of a record outside of the federal agency maintaining the system of records. A routine use is an exception to the <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> prohibition on the disclosure of a record in a system of records without the prior written consent of the individual to whom the record pertains. To qualify as a routine use, the disclosure must be for a purpose that is compatible with the purpose for which the information was originally collected. The <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> requires agencies to describe each routine use of the records maintained in the system of records, including the categories of users of the records and the purpose of the use. Agencies may only establish routine uses by explicitly publishing them in the relevant system of records notice.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(01)"/>
          <p>all routine uses published in the system of records notice are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-06.01_odp"/> to ensure continued accuracy, and to ensure that routine uses continue to be compatible with the purpose for which the information was collected.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for reviewing system of records notices</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-6.2">
        <title>Exemption Rules</title>
        <param id="pt-06.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-6.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to review all Privacy Act exemptions claimed for the system of records is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-06(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-6(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-06.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-6"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-6.2_smt">
          <p>Review all Privacy Act exemptions claimed for the system of records at <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-06.02_odp"/> to ensure they remain appropriate and necessary in accordance with law, that they have been promulgated as regulations, and that they are accurately described in the system of records notice.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-6.2_gdn">
          <p>The <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> includes two sets of provisions that allow federal agencies to claim exemptions from certain requirements in the statute. In certain circumstances, these provisions allow agencies to promulgate regulations to exempt a system of records from select provisions of the <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> . At a minimum, organizations’ <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> exemption regulations include the specific name(s) of any system(s) of records that will be exempt, the specific provisions of the <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> from which the system(s) of records is to be exempted, the reasons for the exemption, and an explanation for why the exemption is both necessary and appropriate.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)"/>
          <part id="pt-6.2_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)[01]"/>
            <p>all Privacy Act exemptions claimed for the system of records are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-06.02_odp"/> to ensure that they remain appropriate and necessary in accordance with law;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-6.2_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)[02]"/>
            <p>all Privacy Act exemptions claimed for the system of records are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-06.02_odp"/> to ensure that they have been promulgated as regulations;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-6.2_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)[03]"/>
            <p>all Privacy Act exemptions claimed for the system of records are reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-06.02_odp"/> to ensure that they are accurately described in the system of records notice.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-6.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
            <p>Privacy Act exemptions</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-6.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-06(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for Privacy Act system of records maintenance</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pt-7">
      <title>Specific Categories of Personally Identifiable Information</title>
      <param id="pt-07_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="pt-7_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07_ODP"/>
        <label>processing conditions</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>processing conditions to be applied for specific categories of personally identifiable information are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-07"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-7"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-07"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#3671ff20-c17c-44d6-8a88-7de203fa74aa"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#c28ae9a8-1121-42a9-a85e-00cfcc9b9a94"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ir-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-3"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pt-7_smt">
        <p>Apply <insert type="param" id-ref="pt-07_odp"/> for specific categories of personally identifiable information.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pt-7_gdn">
        <p>Organizations apply any conditions or protections that may be necessary for specific categories of personally identifiable information. These conditions may be required by laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, or guidelines. The requirements may also come from the results of privacy risk assessments that factor in contextual changes that may result in an organizational determination that a particular category of personally identifiable information is particularly sensitive or raises particular privacy risks. Organizations consult with the senior agency official for privacy and legal counsel regarding any protections that may be necessary.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="pt-07_odp"/> are applied for specific categories of personally identifiable information.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
          <p>privacy notice</p>
          <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
          <p>computer matching agreements and notices</p>
          <p>contracts</p>
          <p>privacy information sharing agreements</p>
          <p>memoranda of understanding</p>
          <p>governing requirements</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for supporting and/or implementing personally identifiable information processing</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-7.1">
        <title>Social Security Numbers</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-07(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-7(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-07.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-7.1_smt">
          <p>When a system processes Social Security numbers:</p>
          <part name="item" id="pt-7.1_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Eliminate unnecessary collection, maintenance, and use of Social Security numbers, and explore alternatives to their use as a personal identifier;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="pt-7.1_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Do not deny any individual any right, benefit, or privilege provided by law because of such individual’s refusal to disclose his or her Social Security number; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="pt-7.1_smt.c">
            <prop name="label" value="(c)"/>
            <p>Inform any individual who is asked to disclose his or her Social Security number whether that disclosure is mandatory or voluntary, by what statutory or other authority such number is solicited, and what uses will be made of it.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-7.1_gdn">
          <p>Federal law and policy establish specific requirements for organizations’ processing of Social Security numbers. Organizations take steps to eliminate unnecessary uses of Social Security numbers and other sensitive information and observe any particular requirements that apply.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)"/>
          <part id="pt-7.1_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(a)"/>
            <part id="pt-7.1_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(a)[01]"/>
              <p>when a system processes Social Security numbers, the unnecessary collection, maintenance, and use of Social Security numbers are eliminated;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <part id="pt-7.1_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(a)[02]"/>
              <p>when a system processes Social Security numbers, alternatives to the use of Social Security Numbers as a personal identifier are explored;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-7.1_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(b)"/>
            <p>when a system processes Social Security numbers, individual rights, benefits, or privileges provided by law are not denied because of an individual’s refusal to disclose their Social Security number;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-7.1_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(c)"/>
            <part id="pt-7.1_obj.c-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(c)[01]"/>
              <p>when a system processes Social Security numbers, any individual who is asked to disclose their Social Security number is informed whether that disclosure is mandatory or voluntary, by what statutory or other authority such number is solicited, and what uses will be made of it;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.c"/>
            </part>
            <part id="pt-7.1_obj.c-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(c)[02]"/>
              <p>when a system processes Social Security numbers, any individual who is asked to disclose their Social Security number is informed by what statutory or other authority the number is solicited;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.c"/>
            </part>
            <part id="pt-7.1_obj.c-3" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)(c)[03]"/>
              <p>when a system processes Social Security numbers, any individual who is asked to disclose their Social Security number is informed what uses will be made of it.</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.c"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>separate notice regarding the use of Social Security numbers</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for identifying, reviewing, and taking action to control the unnecessary use of Social Security numbers</p>
            <p>implementation of an alternative to Social Security numbers as identifiers</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="pt-7.2">
        <title>First Amendment Information</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-07(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-7(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-07.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#pt-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="pt-7.2_smt">
          <p>Prohibit the processing of information describing how any individual exercises rights guaranteed by the First Amendment unless expressly authorized by statute or by the individual or unless pertinent to and within the scope of an authorized law enforcement activity.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="pt-7.2_gdn">
          <p>The <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> limits agencies’ ability to process information that describes how individuals exercise rights guaranteed by the First Amendment. Organizations consult with the senior agency official for privacy and legal counsel regarding these requirements.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(02)"/>
          <p>the processing of information describing how any individual exercises rights guaranteed by the First Amendment is prohibited unless expressly authorized by statute or by the individual or unless pertinent to and within the scope of an authorized law enforcement activity.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-7.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
            <p>privacy notice</p>
            <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-7.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-07(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for supporting and/or implementing personally identifiable information processing</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="pt-8">
      <title>Computer Matching Requirements</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="PT-08"/>
        <prop name="label" value="PT-8"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="pt-08"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#94c64e1a-456c-457f-86da-83ac0dfc85ac"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#3671ff20-c17c-44d6-8a88-7de203fa74aa"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-24"/>
      <part name="statement" id="pt-8_smt">
        <p>When a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program:</p>
        <part name="item" id="pt-8_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Obtain approval from the Data Integrity Board to conduct the matching program;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-8_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Develop and enter into a computer matching agreement;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-8_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Publish a matching notice in the Federal Register;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-8_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Independently verify the information produced by the matching program before taking adverse action against an individual, if required; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="pt-8_smt.e">
          <prop name="label" value="e."/>
          <p>Provide individuals with notice and an opportunity to contest the findings before taking adverse action against an individual.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="pt-8_gdn">
        <p>The <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> establishes requirements for federal and non-federal agencies if they engage in a matching program. In general, a matching program is a computerized comparison of records from two or more automated <a href="#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455">PRIVACT</a> systems of records or an automated system of records and automated records maintained by a non-federal agency (or agent thereof). A matching program either pertains to federal benefit programs or federal personnel or payroll records. A federal benefit match is performed to determine or verify eligibility for payments under federal benefit programs or to recoup payments or delinquent debts under federal benefit programs. A matching program involves not just the matching activity itself but also the investigative follow-up and ultimate action, if any.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08"/>
        <part id="pt-8_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08a."/>
          <p>approval to conduct the matching program is obtained from the Data Integrity Board when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-8_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08b."/>
          <part id="pt-8_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08b.[01]"/>
            <p>a computer matching agreement is developed when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-8_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08b.[02]"/>
            <p>a computer matching agreement is entered into when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-8_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08c."/>
          <p>a matching notice is published in the Federal Register when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-8_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08d."/>
          <p>the information produced by the matching program is independently verified before taking adverse action against an individual, if required, when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.d"/>
        </part>
        <part id="pt-8_obj.e" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08e."/>
          <part id="pt-8_obj.e-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08e.[01]"/>
            <p>individuals are provided with notice when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.e"/>
          </part>
          <part id="pt-8_obj.e-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08e.[02]"/>
            <p>individuals are provided with an opportunity to contest the findings before adverse action is taken against them when a system or organization processes information for the purpose of conducting a matching program.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.e"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt.e"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#pt-8_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Personally identifiable information processing and transparency policy and procedures</p>
          <p>privacy notice</p>
          <p>Privacy Act system of records</p>
          <p>Federal Register notices</p>
          <p>Data Integrity Board determinations</p>
          <p>contracts</p>
          <p>information sharing agreements</p>
          <p>memoranda of understanding</p>
          <p>governing requirements</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with personally identifiable information processing and transparency responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="pt-8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="PT-08-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for supporting and/or implementing personally identifiable information processing</p>
          <p>matching program</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
  </group>
  <group class="family" id="ra">
    <title>Risk Assessment</title>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="ra-1">
      <title>Policy and Procedures</title>
      <param id="ra-1_prm_1">
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ra-01_odp.01"/>
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="ra-01_odp.02"/>
        <label>organization-defined personnel or roles</label>
      </param>
      <param id="ra-01_odp.01">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="RA-01_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to whom the risk assessment policy is to be disseminated is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ra-01_odp.02">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="RA-01_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>personnel or roles</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>personnel or roles to whom the risk assessment procedures are to be disseminated is/are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ra-01_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ra-1_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="RA-01_ODP[03]"/>
        <select how-many="one-or-more">
          <choice>organization-level</choice>
          <choice>mission/business process-level</choice>
          <choice>system-level</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="ra-01_odp.04">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ra-1_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="RA-01_ODP[04]"/>
        <label>official</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>an official to manage the risk assessment policy and procedures is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="ra-01_odp.05">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="ra-1_prm_4"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="RA-01_ODP[05]"/>
