      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.7">
        <title>Split Tunneling for Remote Devices</title>
        <param id="sc-07.07_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.7_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(07)_ODP"/>
          <label>safeguards</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>safeguards to securely provision split tunneling are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(07)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(7)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(07)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.07"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.7_smt">
          <p>Prevent split tunneling for remote devices connecting to organizational systems unless the split tunnel is securely provisioned using <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.07_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.7_gdn">
          <p>Split tunneling is the process of allowing a remote user or device to establish a non-remote connection with a system and simultaneously communicate via some other connection to a resource in an external network. This method of network access enables a user to access remote devices and simultaneously, access uncontrolled networks. Split tunneling might be desirable by remote users to communicate with local system resources, such as printers or file servers. However, split tunneling can facilitate unauthorized external connections, making the system vulnerable to attack and to exfiltration of organizational information. Split tunneling can be prevented by disabling configuration settings that allow such capability in remote devices and by preventing those configuration settings from being configurable by users. Prevention can also be achieved by the detection of split tunneling (or of configuration settings that allow split tunneling) in the remote device, and by prohibiting the connection if the remote device is using split tunneling. A virtual private network (VPN) can be used to securely provision a split tunnel. A securely provisioned VPN includes locking connectivity to exclusive, managed, and named environments, or to a specific set of pre-approved addresses, without user control.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(07)"/>
          <p>split tunneling is prevented for remote devices connecting to organizational systems unless the split tunnel is securely provisioned using <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.07_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.7_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(07)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.7_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(07)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(07)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing boundary protection capabilities</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting/restricting non-remote connections</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.8">
        <title>Route Traffic to Authenticated Proxy Servers</title>
        <param id="sc-07.08_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.8_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>internal communications traffic</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>internal communications traffic to be routed to external networks is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-07.08_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.8_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>external networks</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>external networks to which internal communications traffic is to be routed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(08)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(8)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.08"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.8_smt">
          <p>Route <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.08_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.08_odp.02"/> through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.8_gdn">
          <p>External networks are networks outside of organizational control. A proxy server is a server (i.e., system or application) that acts as an intermediary for clients requesting system resources from non-organizational or other organizational servers. System resources that may be requested include files, connections, web pages, or services. Client requests established through a connection to a proxy server are assessed to manage complexity and provide additional protection by limiting direct connectivity. Web content filtering devices are one of the most common proxy servers that provide access to the Internet. Proxy servers can support the logging of Transmission Control Protocol sessions and the blocking of specific Uniform Resource Locators, Internet Protocol addresses, and domain names. Web proxies can be configured with organization-defined lists of authorized and unauthorized websites. Note that proxy servers may inhibit the use of virtual private networks (VPNs) and create the potential for <q>man-in-the-middle</q> attacks (depending on the implementation).</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.8_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.08_odp.01"/> is routed to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.08_odp.02"/> through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.8_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.8_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.8_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.8_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(08)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing traffic management through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.9">
        <title>Restrict Threatening Outgoing Communications Traffic</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(09)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(9)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(09)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.09"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-38"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-44"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.9_smt">
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.9_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Detect and deny outgoing communications traffic posing a threat to external systems; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.9_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Audit the identity of internal users associated with denied communications.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.9_gdn">
          <p>Detecting outgoing communications traffic from internal actions that may pose threats to external systems is known as extrusion detection. Extrusion detection is carried out within the system at managed interfaces. Extrusion detection includes the analysis of incoming and outgoing communications traffic while searching for indications of internal threats to the security of external systems. Internal threats to external systems include traffic indicative of denial-of-service attacks, traffic with spoofed source addresses, and traffic that contains malicious code. Organizations have criteria to determine, update, and manage identified threats related to extrusion detection.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.9_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(09)"/>
          <part id="sc-7.9_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(09)(a)"/>
            <part id="sc-7.9_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(09)(a)[01]"/>
              <p>outgoing communications traffic posing a threat to external systems is detected;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.9_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-7.9_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(09)(a)[02]"/>
              <p>outgoing communications traffic posing a threat to external systems is denied;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.9_smt.a"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.9_smt.a"/>
          </part>

            <p>system security plan</p>

          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.9_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(09)-Interview"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.10">
        <title>Prevent Exfiltration</title>
        <param id="sc-07.10_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.10_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)_ODP"/>

            <p>the frequency for conducting exfiltration tests is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(10)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.10"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ca-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.10_smt">
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.10_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Prevent the exfiltration of information; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.10_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Conduct exfiltration tests <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.10_odp"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.10_gdn">
          <p>Prevention of exfiltration applies to both the intentional and unintentional exfiltration of information. Techniques used to prevent the exfiltration of information from systems may be implemented at internal endpoints, external boundaries, and across managed interfaces and include adherence to protocol formats, monitoring for beaconing activity from systems, disconnecting external network interfaces except when explicitly needed, employing traffic profile analysis to detect deviations from the volume and types of traffic expected, call backs to command and control centers, conducting penetration testing, monitoring for steganography, disassembling and reassembling packet headers, and using data loss and data leakage prevention tools. Devices that enforce strict adherence to protocol formats include deep packet inspection firewalls and Extensible Markup Language (XML) gateways. The devices verify adherence to protocol formats and specifications at the application layer and identify vulnerabilities that cannot be detected by devices that operate at the network or transport layers. The prevention of exfiltration is similar to data loss prevention or data leakage prevention and is closely associated with cross-domain solutions and system guards that enforce information flow requirements.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.10_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)"/>
          <part id="sc-7.10_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)(a)"/>
            <p>the exfiltration of information is prevented;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.10_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-7.10_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)(b)"/>
            <p>exfiltration tests are conducted <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.10_odp"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.10_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.10_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.10_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.10_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.10_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(10)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing boundary protection capabilities that prevent the unauthorized exfiltration of information across managed interfaces</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.11">
        <title>Restrict Incoming Communications Traffic</title>
        <param id="sc-07.11_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.11_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>authorized sources</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>authorized sources of incoming communications to be routed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-07.11_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.11_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>authorized destinations</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>authorized destinations to which incoming communications from authorized sources may be routed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(11)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(11)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.11"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.11_smt">
          <p>Only allow incoming communications from <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.11_odp.01"/> to be routed to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.11_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.11_gdn">
          <p>General source address validation techniques are applied to restrict the use of illegal and unallocated source addresses as well as source addresses that should only be used within the system. The restriction of incoming communications traffic provides determinations that source and destination address pairs represent authorized or allowed communications. Determinations can be based on several factors, including the presence of such address pairs in the lists of authorized or allowed communications, the absence of such address pairs in lists of unauthorized or disallowed pairs, or meeting more general rules for authorized or allowed source and destination pairs. Strong authentication of network addresses is not possible without the use of explicit security protocols, and thus, addresses can often be spoofed. Further, identity-based incoming traffic restriction methods can be employed, including router access control lists and firewall rules.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.11_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)"/>
          <p>only incoming communications from <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.11_odp.01"/> are allowed to be routed to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.11_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.11_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.11_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.11_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.11_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(11)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing boundary protection capabilities with respect to source/destination address pairs</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.12">
        <title>Host-based Protection</title>
        <param id="sc-07.12_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.12_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>host-based boundary protection mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>host-based boundary protection mechanisms to be implemented are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-07.12_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.12_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components where host-based boundary protection mechanisms are to be implemented are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(12)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(12)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.12"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.12_smt">
          <p>Implement <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.12_odp.01"/> at <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.12_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.12_gdn">
          <p>Host-based boundary protection mechanisms include host-based firewalls. System components that employ host-based boundary protection mechanisms include servers, workstations, notebook computers, and mobile devices.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.12_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.12_odp.01"/> are implemented at <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.12_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.12_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.12_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>boundary protection hardware and software</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.12_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
            <p>system users</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.12_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(12)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing host-based boundary protection capabilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.13">
        <title>Isolation of Security Tools, Mechanisms, and Support Components</title>
        <param id="sc-07.13_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.13_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(13)_ODP"/>
          <label>information security tools, mechanisms, and support components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information security tools, mechanisms, and support components to be isolated from other internal system components are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(13)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(13)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(13)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.13"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.13_smt">
          <p>Isolate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.13_odp"/> from other internal system components by implementing physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces to other components of the system.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.13_gdn">
          <p>Physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces are useful in isolating computer network defenses from critical operational processing networks to prevent adversaries from discovering the analysis and forensics techniques employed by organizations.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.13_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(13)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.13_odp"/> are isolated from other internal system components by implementing physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces to other components of the system.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.13_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.13_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(13)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of security tools and support components to be isolated from other internal system components</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.13_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(13)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.13_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(13)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the isolation of information security tools, mechanisms, and support components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.14">
        <title>Protect Against Unauthorized Physical Connections</title>
        <param id="sc-07.14_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.14_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(14)_ODP"/>
          <label>managed interfaces</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>managed interfaces to be protected against unauthorized physical connections are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(14)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(14)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(14)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.14"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-19"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.14_smt">
          <p>Protect against unauthorized physical connections at <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.14_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.14_gdn">
          <p>Systems that operate at different security categories or classification levels may share common physical and environmental controls, since the systems may share space within the same facilities. In practice, it is possible that these separate systems may share common equipment rooms, wiring closets, and cable distribution paths. Protection against unauthorized physical connections can be achieved by using clearly identified and physically separated cable trays, connection frames, and patch panels for each side of managed interfaces with physical access controls that enforce limited authorized access to these items.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.14_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(14)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.14_odp"/> are protected against unauthorized physical connections.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.14_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.14_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(14)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>facility communications and wiring diagram system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.14_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(14)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.14_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(14)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing protection against unauthorized physical connections</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.15">
        <title>Networked Privileged Accesses</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(15)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(15)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.15"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.15_smt">
          <p>Route networked, privileged accesses through a dedicated, managed interface for purposes of access control and auditing.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.15_gdn">
          <p>Privileged access provides greater accessibility to system functions, including security functions. Adversaries attempt to gain privileged access to systems through remote access to cause adverse mission or business impacts, such as by exfiltrating information or bringing down a critical system capability. Routing networked, privileged access requests through a dedicated, managed interface further restricts privileged access for increased access control and auditing.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.15_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)"/>
          <part id="sc-7.15_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)[01]"/>
            <p>networked, privileged accesses are routed through a dedicated, managed interface for purposes of access control;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.15_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-7.15_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)[02]"/>
            <p>networked, privileged accesses are routed through a dedicated, managed interface for purposes of auditing.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.15_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.15_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.15_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>audit logs</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.15_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.15_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(15)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the routing of networked, privileged access through dedicated, managed interfaces</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.16">
        <title>Prevent Discovery of System Components</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(16)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(16)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(16)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.16"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.16_smt">
          <p>Prevent the discovery of specific system components that represent a managed interface.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.16_gdn">
          <p>Preventing the discovery of system components representing a managed interface helps protect network addresses of those components from discovery through common tools and techniques used to identify devices on networks. Network addresses are not available for discovery and require prior knowledge for access. Preventing the discovery of components and devices can be accomplished by not publishing network addresses, using network address translation, or not entering the addresses in domain name systems. Another prevention technique is to periodically change network addresses.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.16_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(16)"/>
          <p>the discovery of specific system components that represent a managed interface is prevented.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.16_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.16_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(16)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>

            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>

        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(16)-Test"/>

            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the prevention of discovery of system components at managed interfaces</p>

        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.17">
        <title>Automated Enforcement of Protocol Formats</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(17)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(17)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(17)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.17"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.17_smt">
          <p>Enforce adherence to protocol formats.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.17_gdn">
          <p>System components that enforce protocol formats include deep packet inspection firewalls and XML gateways. The components verify adherence to protocol formats and specifications at the application layer and identify vulnerabilities that cannot be detected by devices operating at the network or transport layers.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.17_obj" name="assessment-objective">

          <p>adherence to protocol formats is enforced.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.17_smt"/>
        </part>

          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(17)-Examine"/>

            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>

            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.17_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(17)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.17_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(17)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the enforcement of adherence to protocol formats</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.18">
        <title>Fail Secure</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(18)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(18)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(18)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.18"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cp-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cp-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-24"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.18_smt">
          <p>Prevent systems from entering unsecure states in the event of an operational failure of a boundary protection device.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.18_gdn">
          <p>Fail secure is a condition achieved by employing mechanisms to ensure that in the event of operational failures of boundary protection devices at managed interfaces, systems do not enter into unsecure states where intended security properties no longer hold. Managed interfaces include routers, firewalls, and application gateways that reside on protected subnetworks (commonly referred to as demilitarized zones). Failures of boundary protection devices cannot lead to or cause information external to the devices to enter the devices nor can failures permit unauthorized information releases.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.18_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(18)"/>
          <p>systems are prevented from entering unsecure states in the event of an operational failure of a boundary protection device.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.18_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.18_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(18)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.18_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(18)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.18_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(18)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing secure failure</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.19">
        <title>Block Communication from Non-organizationally Configured Hosts</title>
        <param id="sc-07.19_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.19_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)_ODP"/>
          <label>communication clients</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>communication clients that are independently configured by end users and external service providers are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(19)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(19)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.19"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.19_smt">
          <p>Block inbound and outbound communications traffic between <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.19_odp"/> that are independently configured by end users and external service providers.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.19_gdn">
          <p>Communication clients independently configured by end users and external service providers include instant messaging clients and video conferencing software and applications. Traffic blocking does not apply to communication clients that are configured by organizations to perform authorized functions.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.19_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)"/>
          <part id="sc-7.19_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)[01]"/>
            <p>inbound communications traffic is blocked between <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.19_odp"/> that are independently configured by end users and external service providers;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.19_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-7.19_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)[02]"/>
            <p>outbound communications traffic is blocked between <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.19_odp"/> that are independently configured by end users and external service providers.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.19_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.19_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.19_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of communication clients independently configured by end users and external service providers</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.19_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.19_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(19)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the blocking of inbound and outbound communications traffic between communication clients independently configured by end users and external service providers</p>
          </part>
        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.20">
        <title>Dynamic Isolation and Segregation</title>
        <param id="sc-07.20_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.20_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(20)_ODP"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components to be dynamically isolated from other system components are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(20)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(20)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(20)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.20"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.20_smt">
          <p>Provide the capability to dynamically isolate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.20_odp"/> from other system components.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.20_gdn">
          <p>The capability to dynamically isolate certain internal system components is useful when it is necessary to partition or separate system components of questionable origin from components that possess greater trustworthiness. Component isolation reduces the attack surface of organizational systems. Isolating selected system components can also limit the damage from successful attacks when such attacks occur.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.20_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(20)"/>
          <p>the capability to dynamically isolate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.20_odp"/> from other system components is provided.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.20_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.20_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(20)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of system components to be dynamically isolated/segregated from other components of the system</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.20_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(20)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.20_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(20)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to dynamically isolate/segregate system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.21">
        <title>Isolation of System Components</title>
        <param id="sc-07.21_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.21_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components to be isolated by boundary protection mechanisms are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-07.21_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.21_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>missions and/or business functions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>missions and/or business functions to be supported by system components isolated by boundary protection mechanisms are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(21)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(21)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.21"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ca-9"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.21_smt">
          <p>Employ boundary protection mechanisms to isolate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.21_odp.01"/> supporting <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.21_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.21_gdn">
          <p>Organizations can isolate system components that perform different mission or business functions. Such isolation limits unauthorized information flows among system components and provides the opportunity to deploy greater levels of protection for selected system components. Isolating system components with boundary protection mechanisms provides the capability for increased protection of individual system components and to more effectively control information flows between those components. Isolating system components provides enhanced protection that limits the potential harm from hostile cyber-attacks and errors. The degree of isolation varies depending upon the mechanisms chosen. Boundary protection mechanisms include routers, gateways, and firewalls that separate system components into physically separate networks or subnetworks; cross-domain devices that separate subnetworks; virtualization techniques; and the encryption of information flows among system components using distinct encryption keys.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.21_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)"/>
          <p>boundary protection mechanisms are employed to isolate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.21_odp.01"/> supporting <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.21_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.21_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.21_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>enterprise architecture documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.21_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.21_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(21)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to separate system components supporting organizational missions and/or business functions</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.22">
        <title>Separate Subnets for Connecting to Different Security Domains</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(22)"/>

          <p>Implement separate network addresses to connect to systems in different security domains.</p>

        </part>

          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(22)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.22_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(22)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.22_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(22)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing separate network addresses/different subnets</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.23">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.24">
        <title>Personally Identifiable Information</title>
        <param id="sc-07.24_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.24_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)_ODP"/>
          <label>processing rules</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>processing rules for systems that process personally identifiable information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(24)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(24)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.24"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-15"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.24_smt">
          <p>For systems that process personally identifiable information:</p>
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.24_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Apply the following processing rules to data elements of personally identifiable information: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.24_odp"/>;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.24_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Monitor for permitted processing at the external interfaces to the system and at key internal boundaries within the system;</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.24_smt.c">
            <prop name="label" value="(c)"/>
            <p>Document each processing exception; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-7.24_smt.d">
            <prop name="label" value="(d)"/>
            <p>Review and remove exceptions that are no longer supported.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.24_gdn">
          <p>Managing the processing of personally identifiable information is an important aspect of protecting an individual’s privacy. Applying, monitoring for, and documenting exceptions to processing rules ensure that personally identifiable information is processed only in accordance with established privacy requirements.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.24_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)"/>
          <part id="sc-7.24_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(a)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.24_odp"/> are applied to data elements of personally identifiable information on systems that process personally identifiable information;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-7.24_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(b)"/>
            <part id="sc-7.24_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(b)[01]"/>
              <p>permitted processing is monitored at the external interfaces to the systems that process personally identifiable information;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.b"/>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-7.24_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(b)[02]"/>
              <p>permitted processing is monitored at key internal boundaries within the systems that process personally identifiable information;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.b"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-7.24_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(c)"/>
            <p>each processing exception is documented for systems that process personally identifiable information;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-7.24_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(d)"/>
            <part id="sc-7.24_obj.d-1" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(d)[01]"/>
              <p>exceptions for systems that process personally identifiable information are reviewed;</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.d"/>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-7.24_obj.d-2" name="assessment-objective">
              <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)(d)[02]"/>
              <p>exceptions for systems that process personally identifiable information that are no longer supported are removed.</p>
              <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.d"/>
            </part>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt.d"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.24_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.24_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policies</p>
            <p>list of key internal boundaries of the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>enterprise security and privacy architecture documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information inventory documentation</p>
            <p>data mapping documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.24_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.24_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(24)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms implementing boundary protection capabilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.25">
        <title>Unclassified National Security System Connections</title>
        <param id="sc-07.25_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.25_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>unclassified national security system</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the unclassified national security system prohibited from directly connecting to an external network is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-07.25_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.25_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>boundary protection device</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the boundary protection device required for a direct connection to an external network is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(25)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(25)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.25"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.25_smt">
          <p>Prohibit the direct connection of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.25_odp.01"/> to an external network without the use of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.25_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.25_gdn">
          <p>A direct connection is a dedicated physical or virtual connection between two or more systems. Organizations typically do not have complete control over external networks, including the Internet. Boundary protection devices (e.g., firewalls, gateways, and routers) mediate communications and information flows between unclassified national security systems and external networks.</p>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)"/>

        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.25_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.25_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.25_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(25)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms prohibiting the direct connection of unclassified national security systems to an external network</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-7.26">
        <title>Classified National Security System Connections</title>
        <param id="sc-07.26_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-7.26_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(26)_ODP"/>
          <label>boundary protection device</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the boundary protection device required for a direct connection to an external network is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-07(26)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-7(26)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(26)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-07.26"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-7.26_smt">
          <p>Prohibit the direct connection of a classified national security system to an external network without the use of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.26_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-7.26_gdn">
          <p>A direct connection is a dedicated physical or virtual connection between two or more systems. Organizations typically do not have complete control over external networks, including the Internet. Boundary protection devices (e.g., firewalls, gateways, and routers) mediate communications and information flows between classified national security systems and external networks. In addition, approved boundary protection devices (typically managed interface or cross-domain systems) provide information flow enforcement from systems to external networks.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.26_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(26)"/>
          <p>the direct connection of classified national security system to an external network without the use of a <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-07.26_odp"/> is prohibited.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-7.26_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-7.26_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(26)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing boundary protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system hardware and software</p>

            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>

        <part id="sc-7.26_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-07(26)-Interview"/>
