    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-27">
      <title>Platform-independent Applications</title>
      <param id="sc-27_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-27_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-27_ODP"/>
        <label>platform-independent applications</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>platform-independent applications to be included within organizational systems are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-27"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-27"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-27"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-27"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-29"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-27_smt">
        <p>Include within organizational systems the following platform independent applications: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-27_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-27_gdn">
        <p>Platforms are combinations of hardware, firmware, and software components used to execute software applications. Platforms include operating systems, the underlying computer architectures, or both. Platform-independent applications are applications with the capability to execute on multiple platforms. Such applications promote portability and reconstitution on different platforms. Application portability and the ability to reconstitute on different platforms increase the availability of mission-essential functions within organizations in situations where systems with specific operating systems are under attack.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-27_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-27"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-27_odp"/> are included within organizational systems.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-27_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-27_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-27-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing platform-independent applications</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>list of platform-independent applications</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-27_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-27-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developer</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-27_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-27-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing platform-independent applications</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-28">
      <title>Protection of Information at Rest</title>
      <param id="sc-28_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28_ODP[01]"/>
        <select how-many="one-or-more">
          <choice>confidentiality</choice>
          <choice>integrity</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-28_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>information at rest</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>information at rest requiring protection is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-28"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-28"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-28"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#20957dbb-6a1e-40a2-b38a-66f67d33ac2e"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0d083d8a-5cc6-46f1-8d79-3081d42bcb75"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#eef62b16-c796-4554-955c-505824135b8a"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#110e26af-4765-49e1-8740-6750f83fcda1"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e7942589-e267-4a5a-a3d9-f39a7aae81f0"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#8306620b-1920-4d73-8b21-12008528595f"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#22f2d4f0-4365-4e88-a30d-275c1f5473ea"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f66be67-85e7-4ca6-bd19-39453e9f4394"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-19"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ca-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cp-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pe-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-34"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-16"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-28_smt">
        <p>Protect the <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28_odp.01"/> of the following information at rest: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28_odp.02"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-28_gdn">
        <p>Information at rest refers to the state of information when it is not in process or in transit and is located on system components. Such components include internal or external hard disk drives, storage area network devices, or databases. However, the focus of protecting information at rest is not on the type of storage device or frequency of access but rather on the state of the information. Information at rest addresses the confidentiality and integrity of information and covers user information and system information. System-related information that requires protection includes configurations or rule sets for firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, filtering routers, and authentication information. Organizations may employ different mechanisms to achieve confidentiality and integrity protections, including the use of cryptographic mechanisms and file share scanning. Integrity protection can be achieved, for example, by implementing write-once-read-many (WORM) technologies. When adequate protection of information at rest cannot otherwise be achieved, organizations may employ other controls, including frequent scanning to identify malicious code at rest and secure offline storage in lieu of online storage.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-28_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28"/>
        <p>the <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28_odp.01"/> of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28_odp.02"/> is/are protected.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-28_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing the protection of information at rest</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>cryptographic mechanisms and associated configuration documentation</p>
          <p>list of information at rest requiring confidentiality and integrity protections</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-28_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developer</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-28_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing confidentiality and integrity protections for information at rest</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-28.1">
        <title>Cryptographic Protection</title>
        <param id="sc-28.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28.1_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>information</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information requiring cryptographic protection is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-28.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>system components or media</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components or media requiring cryptographic protection is/are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-28(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-28(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-28.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-28"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-19"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-28.1_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of the following information at rest on <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.01_odp.02"/>: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.01_odp.01"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-28.1_gdn">
          <p>The selection of cryptographic mechanisms is based on the need to protect the confidentiality and integrity of organizational information. The strength of mechanism is commensurate with the security category or classification of the information. Organizations have the flexibility to encrypt information on system components or media or encrypt data structures, including files, records, or fields.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)"/>
          <part id="sc-28.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)[01]"/>
            <p>cryptographic mechanisms are implemented to prevent unauthorized disclosure of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.01_odp.01"/> at rest on <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.01_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-28.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)[02]"/>
            <p>cryptographic mechanisms are implemented to prevent unauthorized modification of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.01_odp.01"/> at rest on <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.01_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the protection of information at rest</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>cryptographic mechanisms and associated configuration documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Cryptographic mechanisms implementing confidentiality and integrity protections for information at rest</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-28.2">
        <title>Offline Storage</title>
        <param id="sc-28.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>information</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information to be removed from online storage and stored offline in a secure location is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-28(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-28(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-28.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-28"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-28.2_smt">
          <p>Remove the following information from online storage and store offline in a secure location: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-28.2_gdn">
          <p>Removing organizational information from online storage to offline storage eliminates the possibility of individuals gaining unauthorized access to the information through a network. Therefore, organizations may choose to move information to offline storage in lieu of protecting such information in online storage.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)"/>
          <part id="sc-28.2_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)[01]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.02_odp"/> is removed from online storage;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-28.2_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)[02]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.02_odp"/> is stored offline in a secure location.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)-Examine"/>

            <p>procedures addressing the protection of information at rest</p>

            <p>system security plan</p>

        <part id="sc-28.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(02)-Interview"/>

            <p>System/network administrators</p>

          </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-28.3">
        <title>Cryptographic Keys</title>
        <param id="sc-28.03_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)_ODP[01]"/>
          <select>
            <choice><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.03_odp.02"/> </choice>
            <choice>hardware-protected key store</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-28.03_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-28.3_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>safeguards</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>safeguards for protecting the storage of cryptographic keys are defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-28(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-28(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-28.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>

        <link rel="required" href="#sc-28"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-28.3_smt">
          <p>Provide protected storage for cryptographic keys <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.03_odp.01"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-28.3_gdn">
          <p>A Trusted Platform Module (TPM) is an example of a hardware-protected data store that can be used to protect cryptographic keys.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)"/>
          <p>protected storage for cryptographic keys is provided using <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-28.03_odp.01"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-28.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the protection of information at rest</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>cryptographic mechanisms and associated configuration documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-28.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-28(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing hardware-based key store protection</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-29">
      <title>Heterogeneity</title>
      <param id="sc-29_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-29_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29_ODP"/>
        <label>system components</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>system components requiring a diverse set of information technologies to be employed in the implementation of the system are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-29"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-29"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-29"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pl-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-27"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-30"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-3"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-29_smt">
        <p>Employ a diverse set of information technologies for the following system components in the implementation of the system: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-29_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-29_gdn">
        <p>Increasing the diversity of information technologies within organizational systems reduces the impact of potential exploitations or compromises of specific technologies. Such diversity protects against common mode failures, including those failures induced by supply chain attacks. Diversity in information technologies also reduces the likelihood that the means adversaries use to compromise one system component will be effective against other system components, thus further increasing the adversary work factor to successfully complete planned attacks. An increase in diversity may add complexity and management overhead that could ultimately lead to mistakes and unauthorized configurations.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-29_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29"/>
        <p>a diverse set of information technologies is employed for <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-29_odp"/> in the implementation of the system.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-29_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-29_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>list of technologies deployed in the system</p>
          <p>acquisition documentation</p>
          <p>acquisition contracts for system components or services</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-29_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with system acquisition, development, and implementation responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-29_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the employment of a diverse set of information technologies</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-29.1">
        <title>Virtualization Techniques</title>
        <param id="sc-29.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-29.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to change the diversity of operating systems and applications deployed using virtualization techniques is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-29(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-29(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-29.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-29"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-29.1_smt">
          <p>Employ virtualization techniques to support the deployment of a diversity of operating systems and applications that are changed <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-29.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-29.1_gdn">
          <p>While frequent changes to operating systems and applications can pose significant configuration management challenges, the changes can result in an increased work factor for adversaries to conduct successful attacks. Changing virtual operating systems or applications, as opposed to changing actual operating systems or applications, provides virtual changes that impede attacker success while reducing configuration management efforts. Virtualization techniques can assist in isolating untrustworthy software or software of dubious provenance into confined execution environments.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-29.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29(01)"/>
          <p>virtualization techniques are employed to support the deployment of a diverse range of operating systems and applications that are changed <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-29.01_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-29.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-29.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>configuration management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of operating systems and applications deployed using virtualization techniques</p>
            <p>change control records</p>
            <p>configuration management records</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-29.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with responsibilities for implementing approved virtualization techniques to the system</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-29.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-29(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the employment of a diverse set of information technologies</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing virtualization techniques</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-30">
      <title>Concealment and Misdirection</title>
      <param id="sc-30_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>concealment and misdirection techniques</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>concealment and misdirection techniques to be employed to confuse and mislead adversaries potentially targeting systems are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-30_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>systems</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>systems for which concealment and misdirection techniques are to be employed are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-30_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>time periods</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>time periods to employ concealment and misdirection techniques for systems are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-30"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-30"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-30"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-25"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-26"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-29"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-44"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-14"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-30_smt">
        <p>Employ the following concealment and misdirection techniques for <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30_odp.02"/> at <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30_odp.03"/> to confuse and mislead adversaries: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30_odp.01"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-30_gdn">
        <p>Concealment and misdirection techniques can significantly reduce the targeting capabilities of adversaries (i.e., window of opportunity and available attack surface) to initiate and complete attacks. For example, virtualization techniques provide organizations with the ability to disguise systems, potentially reducing the likelihood of successful attacks without the cost of having multiple platforms. The increased use of concealment and misdirection techniques and methods—including randomness, uncertainty, and virtualization—may sufficiently confuse and mislead adversaries and subsequently increase the risk of discovery and/or exposing tradecraft. Concealment and misdirection techniques may provide additional time to perform core mission and business functions. The implementation of concealment and misdirection techniques may add to the complexity and management overhead required for the system.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-30_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30_odp.01"/> are employed for <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30_odp.02"/> for <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30_odp.03"/> to confuse and mislead adversaries.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-30_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-30_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing concealment and misdirection techniques for the system</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>list of concealment and misdirection techniques to be employed for organizational systems</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-30_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with the responsibility to implement concealment and misdirection techniques for systems</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-30_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing concealment and misdirection techniques</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-30.1">
        <title>Virtualization Techniques</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-30(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-30(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-30.01"/>
        <prop name="status" value="withdrawn"/>
        <link rel="incorporated-into" href="#sc-29.1"/>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-30.2">
        <title>Randomness</title>
        <param id="sc-30.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>techniques</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>techniques employed to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-30(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-30(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-30.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-30"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-30.2_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.02_odp"/> to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-30.2_gdn">
          <p>Randomness introduces increased levels of uncertainty for adversaries regarding the actions that organizations take to defend their systems against attacks. Such actions may impede the ability of adversaries to correctly target information resources of organizations that support critical missions or business functions. Uncertainty may also cause adversaries to hesitate before initiating or continuing attacks. Misdirection techniques that involve randomness include performing certain routine actions at different times of day, employing different information technologies, using different suppliers, and rotating roles and responsibilities of organizational personnel.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(02)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.02_odp"/> are employed to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-30.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing concealment and misdirection techniques for the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of techniques to be employed to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with the responsibility to implement concealment and misdirection techniques for systems</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing randomness as a concealment and misdirection technique</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-30.3">
        <title>Change Processing and Storage Locations</title>
        <param id="sc-30.03_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>processing and/or storage</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>processing and/or storage locations to be changed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-30.03_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.3_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)_ODP[02]"/>
          <select>
            <choice><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.03_odp.03"/> </choice>
            <choice>random time intervals</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-30.03_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.3_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>time frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>time frequency at which to change the location of processing and/or storage is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-30(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-30(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-30.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-30"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-30.3_smt">
          <p>Change the location of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.03_odp.01"/> <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.03_odp.02"/>].</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-30.3_gdn">
          <p>Adversaries target critical mission and business functions and the systems that support those mission and business functions while also trying to minimize the exposure of their existence and tradecraft. The static, homogeneous, and deterministic nature of organizational systems targeted by adversaries make such systems more susceptible to attacks with less adversary cost and effort to be successful. Changing processing and storage locations (also referred to as moving target defense) addresses the advanced persistent threat using techniques such as virtualization, distributed processing, and replication. This enables organizations to relocate the system components (i.e., processing, storage) that support critical mission and business functions. Changing the locations of processing activities and/or storage sites introduces a degree of uncertainty into the targeting activities of adversaries. The targeting uncertainty increases the work factor of adversaries and makes compromises or breaches of the organizational systems more difficult and time-consuming. It also increases the chances that adversaries may inadvertently disclose certain aspects of their tradecraft while attempting to locate critical organizational resources.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)"/>
          <p>the location of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.03_odp.01"/> is changed <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.03_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-30.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>configuration management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing concealment and misdirection techniques for the system</p>
            <p>list of processing/storage locations to be changed at organizational time intervals</p>
            <p>change control records</p>
            <p>configuration management records</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with the responsibility to change processing and/or storage locations</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing changing processing and/or storage locations</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-30.4">
        <title>Misleading Information</title>
        <param id="sc-30.04_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(04)_ODP"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components for which realistic but misleading information about their security state or posture is employed are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-30(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-30(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-30.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-30"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-30.4_smt">
          <p>Employ realistic, but misleading information in <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.04_odp"/> about its security state or posture.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-30.4_gdn">
          <p>Employing misleading information is intended to confuse potential adversaries regarding the nature and extent of controls deployed by organizations. Thus, adversaries may employ incorrect and ineffective attack techniques. One technique for misleading adversaries is for organizations to place misleading information regarding the specific controls deployed in external systems that are known to be targeted by adversaries. Another technique is the use of deception nets that mimic actual aspects of organizational systems but use, for example, out-of-date software configurations.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(04)"/>
          <p>realistic but misleading information about the security state or posture of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.04_odp"/> is employed.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-30.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>configuration management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing concealment and misdirection techniques for the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with the responsibility to define and employ realistic but misleading information about the security posture of system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the employment of realistic but misleading information about the security posture of system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-30.5">
        <title>Concealment of System Components</title>
        <param id="sc-30.05_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.5_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>techniques</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>techniques to be employed to hide or conceal system components are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-30.05_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-30.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components to be hidden or concealed using techniques (defined in SC-30(05)_ODP[01]) are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-30(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-30(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-30.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-30"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-30.5_smt">
          <p>Employ the following techniques to hide or conceal <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.05_odp.02"/>: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.05_odp.01"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-30.5_gdn">
          <p>By hiding, disguising, or concealing critical system components, organizations may be able to decrease the probability that adversaries target and successfully compromise those assets. Potential means to hide, disguise, or conceal system components include the configuration of routers or the use of encryption or virtualization techniques.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.05_odp.01"/> are employed to hide or conceal <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-30.05_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-30.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>configuration management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing concealment and misdirection techniques for the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of techniques employed to hide or conceal system components</p>
            <p>list of system components to be hidden or concealed</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with the responsibility to conceal system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-30.5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-30(05)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing techniques for the concealment of system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-31">
      <title>Covert Channel Analysis</title>
      <param id="sc-31_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-31_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31_ODP"/>
        <select how-many="one-or-more">
          <choice>storage</choice>
          <choice>timing</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-31"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-31"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-31"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-11"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-31_smt">
        <part name="item" id="sc-31_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Perform a covert channel analysis to identify those aspects of communications within the system that are potential avenues for covert <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31_odp"/> channels; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="sc-31_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Estimate the maximum bandwidth of those channels.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-31_gdn">
        <p>Developers are in the best position to identify potential areas within systems that might lead to covert channels. Covert channel analysis is a meaningful activity when there is the potential for unauthorized information flows across security domains, such as in the case of systems that contain export-controlled information and have connections to external networks (i.e., networks that are not controlled by organizations). Covert channel analysis is also useful for multilevel secure systems, multiple security level systems, and cross-domain systems.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-31_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31"/>
        <part id="sc-31_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31a."/>
          <p>a covert channel analysis is performed to identify those aspects of communications within the system that are potential avenues for covert <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31_odp"/> channels;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-31_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31b."/>
          <p>the maximum bandwidth of those channels is estimated.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-31_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-31_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-31_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing covert channel analysis</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>covert channel analysis documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-31_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with covert channel analysis responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developers/integrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-31_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational process for conducting covert channel analysis</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing covert channel analysis</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to estimate the bandwidth of covert channels</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-31.1">
        <title>Test Covert Channels for Exploitability</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-31(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-31(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-31.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-31"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-31.1_smt">
          <p>Test a subset of the identified covert channels to determine the channels that are exploitable.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-31.1_gdn">
          <p>None.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(01)"/>
          <p>a subset of the identified covert channels is tested to determine the channels that are exploitable.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-31.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of covert channels</p>
            <p>covert channel analysis documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with covert channel analysis responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational process for testing covert channels</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the testing of covert channel analysis</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-31.2">
        <title>Maximum Bandwidth</title>
        <param id="sc-31.02_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-31.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)_ODP[01]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>storage</choice>
            <choice>timing</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-31.02_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-31.2_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>values</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>values for the maximum bandwidth for identified covert channels are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-31(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-31(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-31.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-31"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-31.2_smt">
          <p>Reduce the maximum bandwidth for identified covert <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31.02_odp.01"/> channels to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31.02_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-31.2_gdn">
          <p>The complete elimination of covert channels, especially covert timing channels, is usually not possible without significant performance impacts.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)"/>
          <p>the maximum bandwidth for identified covert <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31.02_odp.01"/> channels is reduced to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31.02_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-31.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>acquisition contracts for systems or services</p>
            <p>acquisition documentation</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>covert channel analysis documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with covert channel analysis responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational process for conducting covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to reduce the bandwidth of covert channels</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-31.3">
        <title>Measure Bandwidth in Operational Environments</title>
        <param id="sc-31.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-31.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(03)_ODP"/>
          <label>subset of identified covert channels</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>subset of identified covert channels whose bandwidth is to be measured in the operational environment of the system is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-31(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-31(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-31.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-31"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-31.3_smt">
          <p>Measure the bandwidth of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31.03_odp"/> in the operational environment of the system.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-31.3_gdn">
          <p>Measuring covert channel bandwidth in specified operational environments helps organizations determine how much information can be covertly leaked before such leakage adversely affects mission or business functions. Covert channel bandwidth may be significantly different when measured in settings that are independent of the specific environments of operation, including laboratories or system development environments.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(03)"/>
          <p>the bandwidth of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-31.03_odp"/> is measured in the operational environment of the system.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-31.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>covert channel analysis documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with covert channel analysis responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-31.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-31(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational process for conducting covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing covert channel analysis</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to measure the bandwidth of covert channels</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-32">
      <title>System Partitioning</title>
      <param id="sc-32_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-32_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>system components</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>system components to reside in separate physical or logical domains or environments based on circumstances for the physical or logical separation of components are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-32_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-32_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32_ODP[02]"/>
        <select>
          <choice>physical</choice>
          <choice>logical</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-32_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-32_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="circumstances for physical or logical separation of components"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>circumstances for the physical or logical separation of components</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>circumstances for the physical or logical separation of components are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-32"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-32"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-32"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#628d22a1-6a11-4784-bc59-5cd9497b5445"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#d4296805-2dca-4c63-a95f-eeccaa826aec"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-36"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-32_smt">
        <p>Partition the system into <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-32_odp.01"/> residing in separate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-32_odp.02"/> domains or environments based on <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-32_odp.03"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-32_gdn">
        <p>System partitioning is part of a defense-in-depth protection strategy. Organizations determine the degree of physical separation of system components. Physical separation options include physically distinct components in separate racks in the same room, critical components in separate rooms, and geographical separation of critical components. Security categorization can guide the selection of candidates for domain partitioning. Managed interfaces restrict or prohibit network access and information flow among partitioned system components.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-32_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32"/>
        <p>the system is partitioned into <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-32_odp.01"/> residing in separate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-32_odp.02"/> domains or environments based on <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-32_odp.03"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-32_smt"/>
      </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-32.1">
        <title>Separate Physical Domains for Privileged Functions</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-32(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-32(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-32.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-32"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-32.1_smt">
          <p>Partition privileged functions into separate physical domains.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-32.1_gdn">
          <p>Privileged functions that operate in a single physical domain may represent a single point of failure if that domain becomes compromised or experiences a denial of service.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-32.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32(01)"/>
          <p>privileged functions are partitioned into separate physical domains.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-32.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-32.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing system partitioning</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of system physical domains (or environments)</p>
            <p>system facility diagrams</p>
            <p>system network diagrams</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>

          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-32-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>

            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the physical separation of system components</p>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-33">
      <title>Transmission Preparation Integrity</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-33"/>
