    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-34">
      <title>Non-modifiable Executable Programs</title>
      <param id="sc-34_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-34_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>system components</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>system components for which the operating environment and applications are to be loaded and executed from hardware-enforced, read-only media are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-34_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-34_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>applications</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>applications to be loaded and executed from hardware-enforced, read-only media are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-34"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-34"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-34"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-14"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-34_smt">
        <p>For <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34_odp.01"/> , load and execute:</p>
        <part name="item" id="sc-34_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>The operating environment from hardware-enforced, read-only media; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="sc-34_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>The following applications from hardware-enforced, read-only media: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-34_gdn">
        <p>The operating environment for a system contains the code that hosts applications, including operating systems, executives, or virtual machine monitors (i.e., hypervisors). It can also include certain applications that run directly on hardware platforms. Hardware-enforced, read-only media include Compact Disc-Recordable (CD-R) and Digital Versatile Disc-Recordable (DVD-R) disk drives as well as one-time, programmable, read-only memory. The use of non-modifiable storage ensures the integrity of software from the point of creation of the read-only image. The use of reprogrammable, read-only memory can be accepted as read-only media provided that integrity can be adequately protected from the point of initial writing to the insertion of the memory into the system, and there are reliable hardware protections against reprogramming the memory while installed in organizational systems.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-34_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34"/>
        <part id="sc-34_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34a."/>
          <p>the operating environment for <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34_odp.01"/> is loaded and executed from hardware-enforced, read-only media;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34b."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34_odp.02"/> for <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34_odp.01"/> are loaded and executed from hardware-enforced, read-only media.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-34_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing non-modifiable executable programs</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>list of operating system components to be loaded from hardware-enforced, read-only media</p>
          <p>list of applications to be loaded from hardware-enforced, read-only media</p>
          <p>media used to load and execute the system operating environment</p>
          <p>media used to load and execute system applications</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-34_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developer</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>system developers/integrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-34_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing, loading, and executing the operating environment from hardware-enforced, read-only media</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing, loading, and executing applications from hardware-enforced, read-only media</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-34.1">
        <title>No Writable Storage</title>
        <param id="sc-34.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-34.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components to be employed with no writeable storage are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-34(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-34(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-34.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-34"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-19"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#mp-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-34.1_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34.01_odp"/> with no writeable storage that is persistent across component restart or power on/off.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-34.1_gdn">
          <p>Disallowing writeable storage eliminates the possibility of malicious code insertion via persistent, writeable storage within the designated system components. The restriction applies to fixed and removable storage, with the latter being addressed either directly or as specific restrictions imposed through access controls for mobile devices.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-34.01_odp"/> are employed with no writeable storage that is persistent across component restart or power on/off.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-modifiable executable programs</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of system components to be employed without writeable storage capabilities</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the employment of components with no writeable storage</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing persistent non-writeable storage across component restart and power on/off</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-34.2">
        <title>Integrity Protection on Read-only Media</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-34(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-34(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-34.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-34"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cm-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cm-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cm-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#mp-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#mp-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#mp-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-28"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-34.2_smt">
          <p>Protect the integrity of information prior to storage on read-only media and control the media after such information has been recorded onto the media.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-34.2_gdn">
          <p>Controls prevent the substitution of media into systems or the reprogramming of programmable read-only media prior to installation into the systems. Integrity protection controls include a combination of prevention, detection, and response.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)"/>
          <part id="sc-34.2_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)[01]"/>
            <p>the integrity of information is protected prior to storage on read-only media;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-34.2_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)[02]"/>
            <p>the media is controlled after such information has been recorded onto the media;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-34.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-modifiable executable programs</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-34.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to protect information integrity on read-only media prior to storage and after information has been recorded onto the media</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-34.3">
        <title>Hardware-based Protection</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-34(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-34(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-34(03)"/>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-35">
      <title>External Malicious Code Identification</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-35"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-35"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-35"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-35"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-26"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-44"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-35_smt">
        <p>Include system components that proactively seek to identify network-based malicious code or malicious websites.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-35_gdn">
        <p>External malicious code identification differs from decoys in <a href="#sc-26">SC-26</a> in that the components actively probe networks, including the Internet, in search of malicious code contained on external websites. Like decoys, the use of external malicious code identification techniques requires some supporting isolation measures to ensure that any malicious code discovered during the search and subsequently executed does not infect organizational systems. Virtualization is a common technique for achieving such isolation.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-35_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-35"/>
        <p>system components that proactively seek to identify network-based malicious code or malicious websites are included.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-35_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-35_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-35-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing external malicious code identification</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system components deployed to identify malicious websites and/or web-based malicious code</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-35_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-35-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>system developers/integrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-35_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-35-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing external malicious code identification</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>

        <select>
          <choice>physical locations</choice>
          <choice>logical domains</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-36"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-36"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-36"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>

      <link rel="related" href="#cp-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pl-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-32"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-36_smt">
        <p>Distribute the following processing and storage components across multiple <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36_prm_1"/>: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36_prm_2"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-36_gdn">
        <p>Distributing processing and storage across multiple physical locations or logical domains provides a degree of redundancy or overlap for organizations. The redundancy and overlap increase the work factor of adversaries to adversely impact organizational operations, assets, and individuals. The use of distributed processing and storage does not assume a single primary processing or storage location. Therefore, it allows for parallel processing and storage.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-36_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36"/>
        <part id="sc-36_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36[01]"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36_odp.01"/> are distributed across <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36_odp.02"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36[02]"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36_odp.03"/> are distributed across <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36_odp.04"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36_smt"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-36_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>contingency planning policy and procedures</p>
          <p>contingency plan</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>list of system physical locations (or environments) with distributed processing and storage</p>
          <p>system facility diagrams</p>
          <p>processing site agreements</p>
          <p>storage site agreements</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-36_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with contingency planning and plan implementation responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developers/integrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-36_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for distributed processing and storage across multiple physical locations</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the capability to distribute processing and storage across multiple physical locations</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-36.1">
        <title>Polling Techniques</title>
        <param id="sc-36.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-36.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>distributed processing and storage components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>distributed processing and storage components for which polling techniques are to be employed to identify potential faults, errors, or compromises are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-36.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-36.1_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>actions</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>actions to be taken in response to identified faults, errors, or compromise are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-36(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-36(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-36.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-36"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-36.1_smt">
          <part name="item" id="sc-36.1_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Employ polling techniques to identify potential faults, errors, or compromises to the following processing and storage components: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36.01_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-36.1_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Take the following actions in response to identified faults, errors, or compromises: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36.01_odp.02"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-36.1_gdn">
          <p>Distributed processing and/or storage may be used to reduce opportunities for adversaries to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of organizational information and systems. However, the distribution of processing and storage components does not prevent adversaries from compromising one or more of the components. Polling compares the processing results and/or storage content from the distributed components and subsequently votes on the outcomes. Polling identifies potential faults, compromises, or errors in the distributed processing and storage components.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)"/>
          <part id="sc-36.1_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)(a)"/>
            <p>polling techniques are employed to identify potential faults, errors, or compromises to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36.01_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36.1_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-36.1_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)(b)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36.01_odp.02"/> are taken in response to identified faults, errors, or compromise.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36.1_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of distributed processing and storage components subject to polling</p>
            <p>system polling techniques and associated documentation or records</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing polling techniques</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-36.2">
        <title>Synchronization</title>
        <param id="sc-36.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-36.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>duplicate systems or system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>duplicate systems or system components to be synchronized are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-36(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-36(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-36.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-36"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#cp-9"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-36.2_smt">
          <p>Synchronize the following duplicate systems or system components: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-36.2_gdn">
          <p><a href="#sc-36">SC-36</a> and <a href="#cp-9.6">CP-9(6)</a> require the duplication of systems or system components in distributed locations. The synchronization of duplicated and redundant services and data helps to ensure that information contained in the distributed locations can be used in the mission or business functions of organizations, as needed.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(02)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-36.02_odp"/> are synchronized.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-36.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of distributed processing and storage components subject to polling</p>
            <p>system polling techniques and associated documentation or records</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-36.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-36(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing duplicate system or system component synchronization</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-37">
      <title>Out-of-band Channels</title>
      <param id="sc-37_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-37_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>out-of-band channels</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>out-of-band channels to be employed for the physical delivery or electronic transmission of information, system components, or devices to individuals or the system are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-37_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-37_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>information, system components, or devices</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>information, system components, or devices to employ out-of-band-channels for physical delivery or electronic transmission are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-37_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-37_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>individuals or systems</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>individuals or systems to which physical delivery or electronic transmission of information, system components, or devices is to be achieved via the employment of out-of-band channels are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-37"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-37"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-37"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#110e26af-4765-49e1-8740-6750f83fcda1"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e7942589-e267-4a5a-a3d9-f39a7aae81f0"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#8306620b-1920-4d73-8b21-12008528595f"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-37_smt">
        <p>Employ the following out-of-band channels for the physical delivery or electronic transmission of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37_odp.02"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37_odp.03"/>: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37_odp.01"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-37_gdn">
        <p>Out-of-band channels include local, non-network accesses to systems; network paths physically separate from network paths used for operational traffic; or non-electronic paths, such as the U.S. Postal Service. The use of out-of-band channels is contrasted with the use of in-band channels (i.e., the same channels) that carry routine operational traffic. Out-of-band channels do not have the same vulnerability or exposure as in-band channels. Therefore, the confidentiality, integrity, or availability compromises of in-band channels will not compromise or adversely affect the out-of-band channels. Organizations may employ out-of-band channels in the delivery or transmission of organizational items, including authenticators and credentials; cryptographic key management information; system and data backups; configuration management changes for hardware, firmware, or software; security updates; maintenance information; and malicious code protection updates. For example, cryptographic keys for encrypted files are delivered using a different channel than the file.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-37_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37_odp.01"/> are employed for the physical delivery or electronic transmission of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37_odp.02"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37_odp.03"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-37_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-37_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing the use of out-of-band channels</p>
          <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
          <p>identification and authentication policy and procedures</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>list of out-of-band channels</p>
          <p>types of information, system components, or devices requiring the use of out-of-band channels for physical delivery or electronic transmission to authorized individuals or systems</p>
          <p>physical delivery records</p>
          <p>electronic transmission records</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-37_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>organizational personnel authorizing, installing, configuring, operating, and/or using out-of-band channels</p>
          <p>system developers/integrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-37_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for the use of out-of-band channels</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the use of out-of-band channels</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-37.1">
        <title>Ensure Delivery and Transmission</title>
        <param id="sc-37.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-37.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls to be employed to ensure that only designated individuals or systems receive specific information, system components, or devices are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-37.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-37.1_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>individuals or systems</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>individuals or systems designated to receive specific information, system components, or devices are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-37.01_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-37.1_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>information, system components, or devices</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>information, system components, or devices that only individuals or systems are designated to receive are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-37(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-37(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-37.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-37"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-37.1_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37.01_odp.01"/> to ensure that only <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37.01_odp.02"/> receive the following information, system components, or devices: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37.01_odp.03"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-37.1_gdn">
          <p>Techniques employed by organizations to ensure that only designated systems or individuals receive certain information, system components, or devices include sending authenticators via an approved courier service but requiring recipients to show some form of government-issued photographic identification as a condition of receipt.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-37.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37.01_odp.01"/> are employed to ensure that only <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37.01_odp.02"/> receive <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-37.01_odp.03"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-37.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-37.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the use of out-of-band channels</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>identification and authentication policy and procedures</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of security safeguards to be employed to ensure that designated individuals or systems receive organization-defined information, system components, or devices</p>
            <p>list of security safeguards for delivering designated information, system components, or devices to designated individuals or systems</p>
            <p>list of information, system components, or devices to be delivered to designated individuals or systems</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-37.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel authorizing, installing, configuring, operating, and/or using out-of-band channels</p>
            <p>system developers/integrators</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-37.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-37(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for the use of out-of-band channels</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the use of out-of-band channels</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting/implementing safeguards to ensure the delivery of designated information, system components, or devices</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-38">

        <label>operations security controls</label>

          <p>operations security controls to be employed to protect key organizational information throughout the system development life cycle are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-38"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-38"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-38"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-38"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ca-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ca-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pl-1"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-38_smt">
        <p>Employ the following operations security controls to protect key organizational information throughout the system development life cycle: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-38_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-38_gdn">
        <p>Operations security (OPSEC) is a systematic process by which potential adversaries can be denied information about the capabilities and intentions of organizations by identifying, controlling, and protecting generally unclassified information that specifically relates to the planning and execution of sensitive organizational activities. The OPSEC process involves five steps: identification of critical information, analysis of threats, analysis of vulnerabilities, assessment of risks, and the application of appropriate countermeasures. OPSEC controls are applied to organizational systems and the environments in which those systems operate. OPSEC controls protect the confidentiality of information, including limiting the sharing of information with suppliers, potential suppliers, and other non-organizational elements and individuals. Information critical to organizational mission and business functions includes user identities, element uses, suppliers, supply chain processes, functional requirements, security requirements, system design specifications, testing and evaluation protocols, and security control implementation details.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-38_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-38"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-38_odp"/> are employed to protect key organizational information throughout the system development life cycle.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-38_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-38_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-38-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing operations security</p>
          <p>security plan</p>
          <p>list of operations security safeguards</p>
          <p>security control assessments</p>
          <p>risk assessments</p>
          <p>threat and vulnerability assessments</p>
          <p>plans of action and milestones</p>
          <p>system development life cycle documentation</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-38_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-38-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>system developers/integrators</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-38_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-38-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for protecting organizational information throughout the system development life cycle</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing safeguards to protect organizational information throughout the system development life cycle</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-39">
      <title>Process Isolation</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-39"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-39"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-39"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-39"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e3cc0520-a366-4fc9-abc2-5272db7e3564"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-25"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-16"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-39_smt">
        <p>Maintain a separate execution domain for each executing system process.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-39_gdn">
        <p>Systems can maintain separate execution domains for each executing process by assigning each process a separate address space. Each system process has a distinct address space so that communication between processes is performed in a manner controlled through the security functions, and one process cannot modify the executing code of another process. Maintaining separate execution domains for executing processes can be achieved, for example, by implementing separate address spaces. Process isolation technologies, including sandboxing or virtualization, logically separate software and firmware from other software, firmware, and data. Process isolation helps limit the access of potentially untrusted software to other system resources. The capability to maintain separate execution domains is available in commercial operating systems that employ multi-state processor technologies.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-39_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-39"/>
        <p>a separate execution domain is maintained for each executing system process.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-39_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-39_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-39-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System design documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>independent verification and validation documentation</p>
          <p>testing and evaluation documentation</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-39_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-39-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System developers/integrators</p>
          <p>system security architect</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-39_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-39-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing separate execution domains for each executing process</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-39.1">
        <title>Hardware Separation</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-39(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-39(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-39(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-39.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-39"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-39.1_smt">
          <p>Implement hardware separation mechanisms to facilitate process isolation.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-39.1_gdn">
          <p>Hardware-based separation of system processes is generally less susceptible to compromise than software-based separation, thus providing greater assurance that the separation will be enforced. Hardware separation mechanisms include hardware memory management.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-39.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">

          <p>hardware separation is implemented to facilitate process isolation.</p>

          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-40">
      <title>Wireless Link Protection</title>
      <param id="sc-40_prm_1">
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sc-40_odp.01"/>
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sc-40_odp.03"/>

      </param>
      <param id="sc-40_prm_2">
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sc-40_odp.02"/>
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sc-40_odp.04"/>
        <label>organization-defined types of signal parameter attacks or references to sources for such attacks</label>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-40_odp.01">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>wireless links</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>external wireless links to be protected from particular types of signal parameter attacks are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-40_odp.02">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>types of signal parameter attacks or references to sources for such attacks</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>types of signal parameter attacks or references to sources for such attacks from which to protect external wireless links are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-40_odp.03">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>wireless links</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>internal wireless links to be protected from particular types of signal parameter attacks are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-40_odp.04">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40_ODP[04]"/>
        <label>types of signal parameter attacks or references to sources for such attacks</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>types of signal parameter attacks or references to sources for such attacks from which to protect internal wireless links are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-40"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-40"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-40"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-18"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-5"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-40_smt">
        <p>Protect external and internal <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40_prm_1"/> from the following signal parameter attacks: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40_prm_2"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-40_gdn">
        <p>Wireless link protection applies to internal and external wireless communication links that may be visible to individuals who are not authorized system users. Adversaries can exploit the signal parameters of wireless links if such links are not adequately protected. There are many ways to exploit the signal parameters of wireless links to gain intelligence, deny service, or spoof system users. Protection of wireless links reduces the impact of attacks that are unique to wireless systems. If organizations rely on commercial service providers for transmission services as commodity items rather than as fully dedicated services, it may not be possible to implement wireless link protections to the extent necessary to meet organizational security requirements.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-40_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40"/>
        <part id="sc-40_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40[01]"/>
          <p>external <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40_odp.01"/> are protected from <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-40_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40[02]"/>
          <p>internal <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40_odp.03"/> are protected from <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40_odp.04"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-40_smt"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-40_smt"/>
      </part>

          <p>wireless network diagrams</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>list of internal and external wireless links</p>

          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-40_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>

          <p>system developer</p>

        </part>

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40-Test"/>

          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the protection of wireless links</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-40.1">
        <title>Electromagnetic Interference</title>
        <param id="sc-40.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-40.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>level of protection</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>level of protection to be employed against the effects of intentional electromagnetic interference is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-40(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-40(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-40.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-40"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-21"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-40.1_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms that achieve <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40.01_odp"/> against the effects of intentional electromagnetic interference.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-40.1_gdn">
          <p>The implementation of cryptographic mechanisms for electromagnetic interference protects systems against intentional jamming that might deny or impair communications by ensuring that wireless spread spectrum waveforms used to provide anti-jam protection are not predictable by unauthorized individuals. The implementation of cryptographic mechanisms may also coincidentally mitigate the effects of unintentional jamming due to interference from legitimate transmitters that share the same spectrum. Mission requirements, projected threats, concept of operations, and laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, and standards determine levels of wireless link availability, cryptography needed, and performance.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(01)"/>
          <p>cryptographic mechanisms that achieve <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40.01_odp"/> against the effects of intentional electromagnetic interference are implemented.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-40.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing wireless link protection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>wireless network diagrams</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system communications hardware and software</p>
            <p>security categorization results</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel authorizing, installing, configuring, and/or maintaining internal and external wireless links</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Cryptographic mechanisms enforcing protections against effects of intentional electromagnetic interference</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-40.2">
        <title>Reduce Detection Potential</title>
        <param id="sc-40.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-40.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>level of reduction</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the level of reduction to be achieved to reduce the detection potential of wireless links is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-40(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-40(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-40.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-40"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-40.2_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms to reduce the detection potential of wireless links to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-40.2_gdn">
          <p>The implementation of cryptographic mechanisms to reduce detection potential is used for covert communications and to protect wireless transmitters from geo-location. It also ensures that the spread spectrum waveforms used to achieve a low probability of detection are not predictable by unauthorized individuals. Mission requirements, projected threats, concept of operations, and applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, and standards determine the levels to which wireless links are undetectable.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(02)"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-40.3">
        <title>Imitative or Manipulative Communications Deception</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-40(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-40(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-40.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-40"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-40.3_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms to identify and reject wireless transmissions that are deliberate attempts to achieve imitative or manipulative communications deception based on signal parameters.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-40.3_gdn">
          <p>The implementation of cryptographic mechanisms to identify and reject imitative or manipulative communications ensures that the signal parameters of wireless transmissions are not predictable by unauthorized individuals. Such unpredictability reduces the probability of imitative or manipulative communications deception based on signal parameters alone.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(03)"/>
          <p>cryptographic mechanisms are implemented to identify and reject wireless transmissions that are deliberate attempts to achieve imitative or manipulative communications deception based on signal parameters.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-40.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing system design documentation</p>
            <p>wireless network diagrams</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system communications hardware and software</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel authorizing, installing, configuring, and/or maintaining internal and external wireless links</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Cryptographic mechanisms enforcing wireless link protections against imitative or manipulative communications deception</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-40.4">
        <title>Signal Parameter Identification</title>
        <param id="sc-40.04_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-40.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(04)_ODP"/>
          <label>wireless transmitters</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>wireless transmitters for which cryptographic mechanisms are to be implemented are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-40(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-40(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-40.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-40"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-12"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-40.4_smt">
          <p>Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent the identification of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40.04_odp"/> by using the transmitter signal parameters.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-40.4_gdn">
          <p>The implementation of cryptographic mechanisms to prevent the identification of wireless transmitters protects against the unique identification of wireless transmitters for the purposes of intelligence exploitation by ensuring that anti-fingerprinting alterations to signal parameters are not predictable by unauthorized individuals. It also provides anonymity when required. Radio fingerprinting techniques identify the unique signal parameters of transmitters to fingerprint such transmitters for purposes of tracking and mission or user identification.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(04)"/>
          <p>cryptographic mechanisms are implemented to prevent the identification of <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-40.04_odp"/> by using the transmitter signal parameters.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-40.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing system design documentation</p>
            <p>wireless network diagrams</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>system communications hardware and software</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system developer</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel authorizing, installing, configuring, and/or maintaining internal and external wireless links</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-40.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-40(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Cryptographic mechanisms preventing the identification of wireless transmitters</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
