    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-41">
      <title>Port and I/O Device Access</title>
      <param id="sc-41_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-41_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>connection ports or input/output devices</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>connection ports or input/output devices to be disabled or removed are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-41_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-41_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41_ODP[02]"/>
        <select>
          <choice>physically</choice>
          <choice>logically</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-41_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-41_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>systems or system components</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>systems or system components with connection ports or input/output devices to be disabled or removed are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-41"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-41"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-41"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-20"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#mp-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-41_smt">
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-41_odp.02"/> disable or remove <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-41_odp.01"/> on the following systems or system components: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-41_odp.03"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-41_gdn">
        <p>Connection ports include Universal Serial Bus (USB), Thunderbolt, and Firewire (IEEE 1394). Input/output (I/O) devices include compact disc and digital versatile disc drives. Disabling or removing such connection ports and I/O devices helps prevent the exfiltration of information from systems and the introduction of malicious code from those ports or devices. Physically disabling or removing ports and/or devices is the stronger action.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-41_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-41_odp.01"/> are <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-41_odp.02"/> disabled or removed on <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-41_odp.03"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-41_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-41_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing port and input/output device access</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>systems or system components</p>
          <p>list of connection ports or input/output devices to be physically disabled or removed on systems or system components</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-41_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-41_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-41-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the disabling of connection ports or input/output devices</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-42">
      <title>Sensor Capability and Data</title>
      <param id="sc-42_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42_ODP[01]"/>
        <select how-many="one-or-more">
          <choice>the use of devices possessing <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.02"/> in <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.03"/> </choice>
          <choice>the remote activation of environmental sensing capabilities on organizational systems or system components with the following exceptions: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.04"/> </choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-42_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>environmental sensing capabilities</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>environmental sensing capabilities in devices are defined (if selected);</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-42_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>facilities, areas, or systems</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>facilities, areas, or systems where the use of devices possessing environmental sensing capabilities is prohibited are defined (if selected);</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-42_odp.04">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42_prm_4"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42_ODP[04]"/>
        <label>exceptions where remote activation of sensors is allowed</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>exceptions where remote activation of sensors is allowed are defined (if selected);</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-42_odp.05">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42_prm_5"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42_ODP[05]"/>
        <label>group of users</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>group of users to whom an explicit indication of sensor use is to be provided is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-42"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-42"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-42"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f66be67-85e7-4ca6-bd19-39453e9f4394"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-15"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-42_smt">
        <part name="item" id="sc-42_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Prohibit <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="sc-42_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Provide an explicit indication of sensor use to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.05"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-42_gdn">
        <p>Sensor capability and data applies to types of systems or system components characterized as mobile devices, such as cellular telephones, smart phones, and tablets. Mobile devices often include sensors that can collect and record data regarding the environment where the system is in use. Sensors that are embedded within mobile devices include microphones, cameras, Global Positioning System (GPS) mechanisms, and accelerometers. While the sensors on mobiles devices provide an important function, if activated covertly, such devices can potentially provide a means for adversaries to learn valuable information about individuals and organizations. For example, remotely activating the GPS function on a mobile device could provide an adversary with the ability to track the movements of an individual. Organizations may prohibit individuals from bringing cellular telephones or digital cameras into certain designated facilities or controlled areas within facilities where classified information is stored or sensitive conversations are taking place.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-42_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42"/>
        <part id="sc-42_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42a."/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.01"/> is/are prohibited;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-42_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42b."/>
          <p>an explicit indication of sensor use is provided to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42_odp.05"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-42_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-42_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-42_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing sensor capabilities and data collection</p>
          <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-42_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developer</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>organizational personnel responsible for sensor capabilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-42_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms implementing access controls for the remote activation of system sensor capabilities</p>
          <p>mechanisms implementing the capability to indicate sensor use</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        <prop name="label" value="SC-42(1)"/>

            <p>organizational personnel responsible for the sensor capabilities</p>

        </part>

        <link rel="required" href="#sc-42.1"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-42.2_smt">
          <p>Employ the following measures so that data or information collected by <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.01_odp"/> is only used for authorized purposes: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-42.2_gdn">
          <p>Information collected by sensors for a specific authorized purpose could be misused for some unauthorized purpose. For example, GPS sensors that are used to support traffic navigation could be misused to track the movements of individuals. Measures to mitigate such activities include additional training to help ensure that authorized individuals do not abuse their authority and, in the case where sensor data is maintained by external parties, contractual restrictions on the use of such data.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(02)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.02_odp"/> are employed so that data or information collected by <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.01_odp"/> is only used for authorized purposes.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-42.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
            <p>sensor capability and data collection</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of measures to be employed to that the ensure data or information collected by sensors is only used for authorized purposes</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel responsible for sensor capabilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing measures to ensure that sensor information is only used for authorized purposes</p>
            <p>sensor information collection capability for the system</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-42.4">
        <title>Notice of Collection</title>
        <param id="sc-42.04_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42.4_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(04)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>measures</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>measures to facilitate an individual’s awareness that personally identifiable information is being collected are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-42.04_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(04)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>sensors</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>sensors that collect personally identifiable information are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-42(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-42(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-42.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-42"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-1"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pt-5"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-42.4_smt">
          <p>Employ the following measures to facilitate an individual’s awareness that personally identifiable information is being collected by <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.04_odp.02"/>: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.04_odp.01"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-42.4_gdn">
          <p>Awareness that organizational sensors are collecting data enables individuals to more effectively engage in managing their privacy. Measures can include conventional written notices and sensor configurations that make individuals directly or indirectly aware through other devices that the sensor is collecting information. The usability and efficacy of the notice are important considerations.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(04)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.04_odp.01"/> are employed to facilitate an individual’s awareness that personally identifiable information is being collected by <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.04_odp.02"/> </p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-42.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>

            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessments</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>

            <p>examples of notifications provided to individuals that personally identifiable information is being collected by sensors</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>

        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-42.5">
        <title>Collection Minimization</title>
        <param id="sc-42.05_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-42.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(05)_ODP"/>
          <label>sensors</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the sensors that are configured to minimize the collection of unneeded information about individuals are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-42(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-42(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-42.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-42"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-12"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-42.5_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.05_odp"/> that are configured to minimize the collection of information about individuals that is not needed.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-42.5_gdn">
          <p>Although policies to control for authorized use can be applied to information once it is collected, minimizing the collection of information that is not needed mitigates privacy risk at the system entry point and mitigates the risk of policy control failures. Sensor configurations include the obscuring of human features, such as blurring or pixelating flesh tones.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(05)"/>
          <p>the <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-42.05_odp"/> configured to minimize the collection of information about individuals that is not needed are employed.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-42.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-42.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(05)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>access control policy and procedures</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
            <p>sensor capability and data collection policy and procedures</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessments</p>
            <p>system architecture</p>
            <p>list of information being collected by sensors</p>
            <p>list of sensor configurations that minimize the collection of personally identifiable information (e.g., obscure human features)</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-42(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel responsible for sensor capabilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-43">
      <title>Usage Restrictions</title>
      <param id="sc-43_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-43_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="system components"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-43_ODP"/>

          <p>the components for which usage restrictions and implementation guidance are to be established are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-43"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-43"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-43"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-43"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>

      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f66be67-85e7-4ca6-bd19-39453e9f4394"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-18"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-19"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-18"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-43_smt">
        <part name="item" id="sc-43_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Establish usage restrictions and implementation guidelines for the following system components: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-43_odp"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="sc-43_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Authorize, monitor, and control the use of such components within the system.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-43_gdn">
        <p>Usage restrictions apply to all system components including but not limited to mobile code, mobile devices, wireless access, and wired and wireless peripheral components (e.g., copiers, printers, scanners, optical devices, and other similar technologies). The usage restrictions and implementation guidelines are based on the potential for system components to cause damage to the system and help to ensure that only authorized system use occurs.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-43_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-43"/>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-43b."/>

            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-43_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-43_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-43b.[02]"/>

          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-44">
      <title>Detonation Chambers</title>
      <param id="sc-44_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-44_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-44_ODP"/>
        <label>system, system component, or location</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the system, system component, or location where a detonation chamber capability is to be employed is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-44"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-44"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-44"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-44"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#1c71b420-2bd9-4e52-9fc8-390f58b85b59"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-18"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-25"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-26"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-30"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-35"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-39"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-44_smt">
        <p>Employ a detonation chamber capability within <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-44_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-44_gdn">
        <p>Detonation chambers, also known as dynamic execution environments, allow organizations to open email attachments, execute untrusted or suspicious applications, and execute Universal Resource Locator requests in the safety of an isolated environment or a virtualized sandbox. Protected and isolated execution environments provide a means of determining whether the associated attachments or applications contain malicious code. While related to the concept of deception nets, the employment of detonation chambers is not intended to maintain a long-term environment in which adversaries can operate and their actions can be observed. Rather, detonation chambers are intended to quickly identify malicious code and either reduce the likelihood that the code is propagated to user environments of operation or prevent such propagation completely.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-44_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-44"/>
        <p>a detonation chamber capability is employed within the <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-44_odp"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-44_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-44_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-44-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing detonation chambers</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-44_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-44-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-44_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-44-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the detonation chamber capability</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-45">
      <title>System Time Synchronization</title>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-45"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-45"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-45"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e4d37285-1e79-4029-8b6a-42df39cace30"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ia-8"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-45_smt">
        <p>Synchronize system clocks within and between systems and system components.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-45_gdn">
        <p>Time synchronization of system clocks is essential for the correct execution of many system services, including identification and authentication processes that involve certificates and time-of-day restrictions as part of access control. Denial of service or failure to deny expired credentials may result without properly synchronized clocks within and between systems and system components. Time is commonly expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), a modern continuation of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), or local time with an offset from UTC. The granularity of time measurements refers to the degree of synchronization between system clocks and reference clocks, such as clocks synchronizing within hundreds of milliseconds or tens of milliseconds. Organizations may define different time granularities for system components. Time service can be critical to other security capabilities—such as access control and identification and authentication—depending on the nature of the mechanisms used to support the capabilities.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-45_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45"/>
        <p>system clocks are synchronized within and between systems and system components.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-45_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-45_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing time synchronization</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-45_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-45_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing system time synchronization</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-45.1">
        <title>Synchronization with Authoritative Time Source</title>
        <param id="sc-45.01_odp.01">

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to compare the internal system clocks with the authoritative time source is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-45.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-45.1_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>authoritative time source</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the authoritative time source to which internal system clocks are to be compared is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-45.01_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-45.1_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>time period</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the time period to compare the internal system clocks with the authoritative time source is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-45(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-45(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-45.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-45"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-45.1_smt">
          <part name="item" id="sc-45.1_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Compare the internal system clocks <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-45.01_odp.01"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-45.01_odp.02"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-45.1_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Synchronize the internal system clocks to the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-45.01_odp.03"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sc-45.1_gdn">
          <p>Synchronization of internal system clocks with an authoritative source provides uniformity of time stamps for systems with multiple system clocks and systems connected over a network.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)"/>
          <part id="sc-45.1_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)(a)"/>
            <p>the internal system clocks are compared <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-45.01_odp.01"/> with <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-45.01_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-45.1_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sc-45.1_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)(b)"/>
            <p>the internal system clocks are synchronized with the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-45.01_odp.03"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-45.1_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-45.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing time synchronization</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing system time synchronization</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-45.2">
        <title>Secondary Authoritative Time Source</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-45(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-45(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(02)"/>

          <part name="item" id="sc-45.2_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Identify a secondary authoritative time source that is in a different geographic region than the primary authoritative time source; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="sc-45.2_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>

          </part>

        <part name="guidance" id="sc-45.2_gdn">
          <p>It may be necessary to employ geolocation information to determine that the secondary authoritative time source is in a different geographic region.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(02)"/>

          <part id="sc-45.2_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(02)(b)"/>
            <p>the internal system clocks are synchronized to the secondary authoritative time source if the primary authoritative time source is unavailable.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-45.2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-45.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing time synchronization</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sc-45.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-45(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing system time synchronization with secondary authoritative time sources</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-46">
      <title>Cross Domain Policy Enforcement</title>
      <param id="sc-46_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-46_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-46_ODP"/>
        <select>
          <choice>physically</choice>
          <choice>logically</choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-46"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-46"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-46"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-46"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e3cc0520-a366-4fc9-abc2-5272db7e3564"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-46_smt">
        <p>Implement a policy enforcement mechanism <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-46_odp"/> between the physical and/or network interfaces for the connecting security domains.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-46_gdn">
        <p>For logical policy enforcement mechanisms, organizations avoid creating a logical path between interfaces to prevent the ability to bypass the policy enforcement mechanism. For physical policy enforcement mechanisms, the robustness of physical isolation afforded by the physical implementation of policy enforcement to preclude the presence of logical covert channels penetrating the security domain may be needed. Contact <a href="mailto:ncdsmo@nsa.gov">ncdsmo@nsa.gov</a> for more information.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-46_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-46"/>
        <p>a policy enforcement mechanism is <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-46_odp"/> implemented between the physical and/or network interfaces for the connecting security domains.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-46_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-46_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-46-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing cross-domain policy enforcement</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-46_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-46-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-46_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-46-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing cross-domain policy enforcement</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-47">
      <title>Alternate Communications Paths</title>
      <param id="sc-47_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-47_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="alternate communications paths"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-47_ODP"/>
        <label>alternate communication paths</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>alternate communication paths for system operations and operational command and control are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-47"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-47"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-47"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-47"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#bc39f179-c735-4da2-b7a7-b2b622119755"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#49b8aa2d-a88c-4bff-9f20-876ccb8f7dcb"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#61ccf0f4-d3e7-42db-9796-ce6cb1c85989"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cp-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cp-8"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-47_smt">
        <p>Establish <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-47_odp"/> for system operations organizational command and control.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-47_gdn">
        <p>An incident, whether adversarial- or nonadversarial-based, can disrupt established communications paths used for system operations and organizational command and control. Alternate communications paths reduce the risk of all communications paths being affected by the same incident. To compound the problem, the inability of organizational officials to obtain timely information about disruptions or to provide timely direction to operational elements after a communications path incident, can impact the ability of the organization to respond to such incidents in a timely manner. Establishing alternate communications paths for command and control purposes, including designating alternative decision makers if primary decision makers are unavailable and establishing the extent and limitations of their actions, can greatly facilitate the organization’s ability to continue to operate and take appropriate actions during an incident.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-47_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-47"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-47_odp"/> are established for system operations and operational command and control.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-47_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-47_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-47-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing communication paths</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-47_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-47-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system developers</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-47_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-47-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing alternate communication paths for system operations</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sc-48">
      <title>Sensor Relocation</title>
      <param id="sc-48_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-48_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>sensors and monitoring capabilities</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>sensors and monitoring capabilities to be relocated are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-48_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-48_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>locations</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>locations to where sensors and monitoring capabilities are to be relocated are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="sc-48_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-48_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>conditions or circumstances</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>conditions or circumstances for relocating sensors and monitoring capabilities are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-48"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-48"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-48"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#61ccf0f4-d3e7-42db-9796-ce6cb1c85989"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#au-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sc-48_smt">
        <p>Relocate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48_odp.02"/> under the following conditions or circumstances: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48_odp.03"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sc-48_gdn">
        <p>Adversaries may take various paths and use different approaches as they move laterally through an organization (including its systems) to reach their target or as they attempt to exfiltrate information from the organization. The organization often only has a limited set of monitoring and detection capabilities, and they may be focused on the critical or likely infiltration or exfiltration paths. By using communications paths that the organization typically does not monitor, the adversary can increase its chances of achieving its desired goals. By relocating its sensors or monitoring capabilities to new locations, the organization can impede the adversary’s ability to achieve its goals. The relocation of the sensors or monitoring capabilities might be done based on threat information that the organization has acquired or randomly to confuse the adversary and make its lateral transition through the system or organization more challenging.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-48_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48_odp.01"/> are relocated to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48_odp.02"/> under <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48_odp.03"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sc-48_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-48_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing sensor and monitoring capability relocation</p>
          <p>list of sensors/monitoring capabilities to be relocated</p>
          <p>change control records</p>
          <p>configuration management records</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-48_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sc-48_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Mechanisms supporting and/or implementing sensor relocation</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sc-48.1">
        <title>Dynamic Relocation of Sensors or Monitoring Capabilities</title>
        <param id="sc-48.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sc-48.1_prm_1"/>

          <label>locations</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>locations to where sensors and monitoring capabilities are to be dynamically relocated are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sc-48.01_odp.03">

        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SC-48(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SC-48(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sc-48.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sc-48"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sc-48.1_smt">
          <p>Dynamically relocate <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48.01_odp.01"/> to <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48.01_odp.02"/> under the following conditions or circumstances: <insert type="param" id-ref="sc-48.01_odp.03"/>.</p>

        <part id="sc-48.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">

            <p>System and communications protection policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing sensor and monitoring capability relocation</p>
            <p>list of sensors/monitoring capabilities to be relocated</p>
            <p>change control records</p>

            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>

        </part>
        <part id="sc-48.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SC-48(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>

        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-01"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-1"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-01"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-01"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#c7ac44e8-10db-4b64-b2b9-9e32ec1efed0"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#4c0ec2ee-a0d6-428a-9043-4504bc3ade6f"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ps-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-12"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-1_smt">
        <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Develop, document, and disseminate to <insert type="param" id-ref="si-1_prm_1"/>:</p>
          <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.a.1">
            <prop name="label" value="1."/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-01_odp.03"/> system and information integrity policy that:</p>
            <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.a.1.a">
              <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
              <p>Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and</p>
            </part>
            <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.a.1.b">
              <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
              <p>Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and</p>
            </part>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.a.2">
            <prop name="label" value="2."/>
            <p>Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and information integrity policy and the associated system and information integrity controls;</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Designate an <insert type="param" id-ref="si-01_odp.04"/> to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and information integrity policy and procedures; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Review and update the current system and information integrity:</p>
          <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.c.1">
            <prop name="label" value="1."/>
            <p>Policy <insert type="param" id-ref="si-01_odp.05"/> and following <insert type="param" id-ref="si-01_odp.06"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="si-1_smt.c.2">
            <prop name="label" value="2."/>
            <p>Procedures <insert type="param" id-ref="si-01_odp.07"/> and following <insert type="param" id-ref="si-01_odp.08"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-1_gdn">
        <p>System and information integrity policy and procedures address the controls in the SI family that are implemented within systems and organizations. The risk management strategy is an important factor in establishing such policies and procedures. Policies and procedures contribute to security and privacy assurance. Therefore, it is important that security and privacy programs collaborate on the development of system and information integrity policy and procedures. Security and privacy program policies and procedures at the organization level are preferable, in general, and may obviate the need for mission- or system-specific policies and procedures. The policy can be included as part of the general security and privacy policy or be represented by multiple policies that reflect the complex nature of organizations. Procedures can be established for security and privacy programs, for mission or business processes, and for systems, if needed. Procedures describe how the policies or controls are implemented and can be directed at the individual or role that is the object of the procedure. Procedures can be documented in system security and privacy plans or in one or more separate documents. Events that may precipitate an update to system and information integrity policy and procedures include assessment or audit findings, security incidents or breaches, or changes in applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. Simply restating controls does not constitute an organizational policy or procedure.</p>
      </part>

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-01"/>
        <part id="si-1_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-01a."/>
          <part id="si-1_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">

              <part id="si-1_obj.a.1.a-2" name="assessment-objective">

    <control class="SP800-53" id="si-2">
      <title>Flaw Remediation</title>
      <param id="si-02_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-2_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02_ODP"/>
        <label>time period</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>time period within which to install security-relevant software updates after the release of the updates is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-02"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-2"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-02"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#27847491-5ce1-4f6a-a1e4-9e483782f0ef"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#678e3d6c-150b-4393-aec5-6e3481eb1e00"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#7c37a38d-21d7-40d8-bc3d-b5e27eac17e1"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#cec037f3-8aba-4c97-84b4-4082f9e515d2"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#155f941a-cba9-4afd-9ca6-5d040d697ba9"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#20db4e66-e257-450c-b2e4-2bb9a62a2c88"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#aa5d04e0-6090-4e17-84d4-b9963d55fc2c"/>

      <link rel="related" href="#cm-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-10"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-11"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-11"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-2_smt">
        <part name="item" id="si-2_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Identify, report, and correct system flaws;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-2_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Test software and firmware updates related to flaw remediation for effectiveness and potential side effects before installation;</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-2_smt.c">
          <prop name="label" value="c."/>
          <p>Install security-relevant software and firmware updates within <insert type="param" id-ref="si-02_odp"/> of the release of the updates; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-2_smt.d">
          <prop name="label" value="d."/>
          <p>Incorporate flaw remediation into the organizational configuration management process.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-2_gdn">
        <p>The need to remediate system flaws applies to all types of software and firmware. Organizations identify systems affected by software flaws, including potential vulnerabilities resulting from those flaws, and report this information to designated organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities. Security-relevant updates include patches, service packs, and malicious code signatures. Organizations also address flaws discovered during assessments, continuous monitoring, incident response activities, and system error handling. By incorporating flaw remediation into configuration management processes, required remediation actions can be tracked and verified.</p>
        <p>Organization-defined time periods for updating security-relevant software and firmware may vary based on a variety of risk factors, including the security category of the system, the criticality of the update (i.e., severity of the vulnerability related to the discovered flaw), the organizational risk tolerance, the mission supported by the system, or the threat environment. Some types of flaw remediation may require more testing than other types. Organizations determine the type of testing needed for the specific type of flaw remediation activity under consideration and the types of changes that are to be configuration-managed. In some situations, organizations may determine that the testing of software or firmware updates is not necessary or practical, such as when implementing simple malicious code signature updates. In testing decisions, organizations consider whether security-relevant software or firmware updates are obtained from authorized sources with appropriate digital signatures.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02"/>
        <part id="si-2_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02a."/>
          <part id="si-2_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02a.[01]"/>
            <p>system flaws are identified;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02a.[02]"/>
            <p>system flaws are reported;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2_obj.a-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02a.[03]"/>
            <p>system flaws are corrected;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02b."/>
          <part id="si-2_obj.b-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02b.[01]"/>
            <p>software updates related to flaw remediation are tested for effectiveness before installation;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2_obj.b-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02b.[02]"/>
            <p>software updates related to flaw remediation are tested for potential side effects before installation;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2_obj.b-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02b.[03]"/>
            <p>firmware updates related to flaw remediation are tested for effectiveness before installation;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2_obj.b-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02b.[04]"/>
            <p>firmware updates related to flaw remediation are tested for potential side effects before installation;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2_obj.c" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02c."/>
          <part id="si-2_obj.c-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02c.[01]"/>
            <p>security-relevant software updates are installed within <insert type="param" id-ref="si-02_odp"/> of the release of the updates;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2_obj.c-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02c.[02]"/>
            <p>security-relevant firmware updates are installed within <insert type="param" id-ref="si-02_odp"/> of the release of the updates;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.c"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.c"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2_obj.d" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02d."/>
          <p>flaw remediation is incorporated into the organizational configuration management process.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt.d"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="si-2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">

          <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing flaw remediation</p>
          <p>procedures addressing configuration management</p>
          <p>list of flaws and vulnerabilities potentially affecting the system</p>
          <p>list of recent security flaw remediation actions performed on the system (e.g., list of installed patches, service packs, hot fixes, and other software updates to correct system flaws)</p>
          <p>test results from the installation of software and firmware updates to correct system flaws</p>
          <p>installation/change control records for security-relevant software and firmware updates</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>

        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel responsible for installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
          <p>organizational personnel responsible for flaw remediation</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with configuration management responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">

        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02-Test"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-2.3">
        <title>Time to Remediate Flaws and Benchmarks for Corrective Actions</title>
        <param id="si-02.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-2.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)_ODP"/>
          <label>benchmarks</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the benchmarks for taking corrective actions are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-02(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-2(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-02.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-2.3_smt">
          <part name="item" id="si-2.3_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p>Measure the time between flaw identification and flaw remediation; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="si-2.3_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Establish the following benchmarks for taking corrective actions: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-02.03_odp"/>.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-2.3_gdn">
          <p>Organizations determine the time it takes on average to correct system flaws after such flaws have been identified and subsequently establish organizational benchmarks (i.e., time frames) for taking corrective actions. Benchmarks can be established by the type of flaw or the severity of the potential vulnerability if the flaw can be exploited.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)"/>
          <part id="si-2.3_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)(a)"/>
            <p>the time between flaw identification and flaw remediation is measured;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2.3_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-2.3_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)(b)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-02.03_odp"/> for taking corrective actions have been established.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2.3_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-2.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing flaw remediation</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>list of benchmarks for taking corrective action on identified flaws</p>
            <p>records that provide timestamps of flaw identification and subsequent flaw remediation activities</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the system</p>
            <p>organizational personnel responsible for flaw remediation</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-2.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-02(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for identifying, reporting, and correcting system flaws</p>
            <p>mechanisms used to measure the time between flaw identification and flaw remediation</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-2.4">

        <param id="si-02.04_odp">
