        <part name="item" id="si-13_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Determine mean time to failure (MTTF) for the following system components in specific environments of operation: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-13_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Provide substitute system components and a means to exchange active and standby components in accordance with the following criteria: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-13_gdn">
        <p>While MTTF is primarily a reliability issue, predictable failure prevention is intended to address potential failures of system components that provide security capabilities. Failure rates reflect installation-specific consideration rather than the industry-average. Organizations define the criteria for the substitution of system components based on the MTTF value with consideration for the potential harm from component failures. The transfer of responsibilities between active and standby components does not compromise safety, operational readiness, or security capabilities. The preservation of system state variables is also critical to help ensure a successful transfer process. Standby components remain available at all times except for maintenance issues or recovery failures in progress.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-13_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13"/>
        <part id="si-13_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13a."/>
          <p>mean time to failure (MTTF) is determined for <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13_odp.01"/> in specific environments of operation;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-13_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13b."/>
          <p>substitute system components and a means to exchange active and standby components are provided in accordance with <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-13_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-13_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="si-13_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
          <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing predictable failure prevention</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>list of MTTF substitution criteria</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-13_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel responsible for MTTF determinations and activities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with contingency planning responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-13_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for managing MTTF</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-13.1">
        <title>Transferring Component Responsibilities</title>
        <param id="si-13.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-13.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>fraction or percentage</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the fraction or percentage of mean time to failure within which to transfer the responsibilities of a system component to a substitute component is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-13(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-13(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-13.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-13.1_smt">
          <p>Take system components out of service by transferring component responsibilities to substitute components no later than <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13.01_odp"/> of mean time to failure.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-13.1_gdn">
          <p>Transferring primary system component responsibilities to other substitute components prior to primary component failure is important to reduce the risk of degraded or debilitated mission or business functions. Making such transfers based on a percentage of mean time to failure allows organizations to be proactive based on their risk tolerance. However, the premature replacement of system components can result in the increased cost of system operations.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(01)"/>
          <p>system components are taken out of service by transferring component responsibilities to substitute components no later than <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13.01_odp"/> of mean time to failure.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-13.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing predictable failure prevention</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for MTTF activities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with contingency planning responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for managing MTTF</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the transfer of component responsibilities to substitute components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-13.2">
        <title>Time Limit on Process Execution Without Supervision</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-13(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-13(2)"/>

        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-13.02"/>
        <prop name="status" value="withdrawn"/>
        <link rel="incorporated-into" href="#si-7.16"/>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-13.3">
        <title>Manual Transfer Between Components</title>
        <param id="si-13.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-13.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(03)_ODP"/>
          <label>percentage</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the percentage of the mean time to failure for transfers to be manually initiated is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-13(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-13(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-13.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-13"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-13.3_smt">
          <p>Manually initiate transfers between active and standby system components when the use of the active component reaches <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13.03_odp"/> of the mean time to failure.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-13.3_gdn">
          <p>For example, if the MTTF for a system component is 100 days and the MTTF percentage defined by the organization is 90 percent, the manual transfer would occur after 90 days.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(03)"/>
          <p>transfers are initiated manually between active and standby system components when the use of the active component reaches <insert type="param" id-ref="si-13.03_odp"/> of the mean time to failure.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-13.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing predictable failure prevention</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for MTTF activities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>system/network administrators</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with contingency planning responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-13.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-13(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for managing MTTF and conducting the manual transfer between active and standby components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-13.4">
        <title>Standby Component Installation and Notification</title>
        <param id="si-13.04_odp.01">

        <prop name="label" value="SI-13(4)"/>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="si-14">
      <title>Non-persistence</title>
      <param id="si-14_odp.01">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>system components and services</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>non-persistent system components and services to be implemented are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="si-14_odp.02">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14_prm_2"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14_ODP[02]"/>
        <select how-many="one-or-more">
          <choice>upon end of session of use</choice>
          <choice><insert type="param" id-ref="si-14_odp.03"/> </choice>
        </select>
      </param>
      <param id="si-14_odp.03">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14_prm_3"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14_ODP[03]"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to terminate non-persistent components and services that are initiated in a known state is defined (if selected);</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-14"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-14"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-14"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-30"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-34"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-21"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-14_smt">
        <p>Implement non-persistent <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14_odp.01"/> that are initiated in a known state and terminated <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14_odp.02"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-14_gdn">
        <p>Implementation of non-persistent components and services mitigates risk from advanced persistent threats (APTs) by reducing the targeting capability of adversaries (i.e., window of opportunity and available attack surface) to initiate and complete attacks. By implementing the concept of non-persistence for selected system components, organizations can provide a trusted, known state computing resource for a specific time period that does not give adversaries sufficient time to exploit vulnerabilities in organizational systems or operating environments. Since the APT is a high-end, sophisticated threat with regard to capability, intent, and targeting, organizations assume that over an extended period, a percentage of attacks will be successful. Non-persistent system components and services are activated as required using protected information and terminated periodically or at the end of sessions. Non-persistence increases the work factor of adversaries attempting to compromise or breach organizational systems.</p>
        <p>Non-persistence can be achieved by refreshing system components, periodically reimaging components, or using a variety of common virtualization techniques. Non-persistent services can be implemented by using virtualization techniques as part of virtual machines or as new instances of processes on physical machines (either persistent or non-persistent). The benefit of periodic refreshes of system components and services is that it does not require organizations to first determine whether compromises of components or services have occurred (something that may often be difficult to determine). The refresh of selected system components and services occurs with sufficient frequency to prevent the spread or intended impact of attacks, but not with such frequency that it makes the system unstable. Refreshes of critical components and services may be done periodically to hinder the ability of adversaries to exploit optimum windows of vulnerabilities.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-14_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14"/>

        <part id="si-14_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">

        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14_smt"/>

        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-14.1">
        <title>Refresh from Trusted Sources</title>
        <param id="si-14.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>trusted sources</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>trusted sources to obtain software and data for system component and service refreshes are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-14(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-14(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-14.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-14"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-14.1_smt">
          <p>Obtain software and data employed during system component and service refreshes from the following trusted sources: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-14.1_gdn">
          <p>Trusted sources include software and data from write-once, read-only media or from selected offline secure storage facilities.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(01)"/>
          <p>the software and data employed during system component and service refreshes are obtained from <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.01_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-persistence for system components</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for obtaining component and service refreshes from trusted sources</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining and obtaining component and service refreshes from trusted sources</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing component and service refreshes</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-14.2">
        <title>Non-persistent Information</title>
        <param id="si-14.02_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)_ODP[01]"/>
          <select>
            <choice>refresh <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.02_odp.02"/> <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.02_odp.03"/> </choice>
            <choice>generate <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.02_odp.04"/> on demand</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="si-14.02_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14.2_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>information</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the information to be refreshed is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="si-14.02_odp.03">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14.2_prm_3"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)_ODP[03]"/>
          <label>frequency</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the frequency at which to refresh information is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="si-14.02_odp.04">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14.2_prm_4"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)_ODP[04]"/>
          <label>information</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>the information to be generated is defined (if selected);</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-14(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-14(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-14.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-14"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-14.2_smt">
          <part name="item" id="si-14.2_smt.a">
            <prop name="label" value="(a)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.02_odp.01"/> ; and</p>
          </part>
          <part name="item" id="si-14.2_smt.b">
            <prop name="label" value="(b)"/>
            <p>Delete information when no longer needed.</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-14.2_gdn">
          <p>Retaining information longer than is needed makes the information a potential target for advanced adversaries searching for high value assets to compromise through unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized modification, or exfiltration. For system-related information, unnecessary retention provides advanced adversaries information that can assist in their reconnaissance and lateral movement through the system.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)"/>
          <part id="si-14.2_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)(a)"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.02_odp.01"/> is performed;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.2_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-14.2_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)(b)"/>
            <p>information is deleted when no longer needed.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.2_smt.b"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-persistence for system components</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for ensuring that information is and remains non-persistent</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for ensuring that information is and remains non-persistent</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing component and service refreshes</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-14.3">
        <title>Non-persistent Connectivity</title>
        <param id="si-14.03_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-14.3_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)_ODP"/>
          <select>
            <choice>completion of a request</choice>
            <choice>a period of non-use</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-14(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-14(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-14.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-14"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-10"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-14.3_smt">
          <p>Establish connections to the system on demand and terminate connections after <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.03_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-14.3_gdn">
          <p>Persistent connections to systems can provide advanced adversaries with paths to move laterally through systems and potentially position themselves closer to high value assets. Limiting the availability of such connections impedes the adversary’s ability to move freely through organizational systems.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)"/>
          <part id="si-14.3_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)[01]"/>
            <p>connections to the system are established on demand;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-14.3_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)[02]"/>
            <p>connections to the system are terminated after <insert type="param" id-ref="si-14.03_odp"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-14.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>procedures addressing non-persistence for system components</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for limiting persistent connections</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-14.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-14(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for limiting persistent connections</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing non-persistent connectivity</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="si-15">
      <title>Information Output Filtering</title>
      <param id="si-15_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-15_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-15_ODP"/>
        <label>software programs and/or applications</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>software programs and/or applications whose information output requires validation are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-15"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-15"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-15"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-15"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-11"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-15_smt">
        <p>Validate information output from the following software programs and/or applications to ensure that the information is consistent with the expected content: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-15_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-15_gdn">
        <p>Certain types of attacks, including SQL injections, produce output results that are unexpected or inconsistent with the output results that would be expected from software programs or applications. Information output filtering focuses on detecting extraneous content, preventing such extraneous content from being displayed, and then alerting monitoring tools that anomalous behavior has been discovered.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-15_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-15"/>
        <p>information output from <insert type="param" id-ref="si-15_odp"/> is validated to ensure that the information is consistent with the expected content.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-15_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="si-15_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-15-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
          <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing information output filtering</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-15_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-15-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel responsible for validating information output</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developer</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-15_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-15-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for validating information output</p>
          <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing information output validation</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="si-16">
      <title>Memory Protection</title>
      <param id="si-16_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-16_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-16_ODP"/>
        <label>controls</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>controls to be implemented to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-16"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-16"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-16"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-16"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ac-25"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-16_smt">
        <p>Implement the following controls to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-16_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-16_gdn">
        <p>Some adversaries launch attacks with the intent of executing code in non-executable regions of memory or in memory locations that are prohibited. Controls employed to protect memory include data execution prevention and address space layout randomization. Data execution prevention controls can either be hardware-enforced or software-enforced with hardware enforcement providing the greater strength of mechanism.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-16_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-16"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-16_odp"/> are implemented to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-16_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="si-16_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-16-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
          <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing memory protection for the system</p>
          <p>system design documentation</p>
          <p>system configuration settings and associated documentation</p>
          <p>list of security safeguards protecting system memory from unauthorized code execution</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-16_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-16-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel responsible for memory protection</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>system/network administrators</p>
          <p>system developer</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-16_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-16-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing safeguards to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution</p>
        </part>
      </part>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="si-17">
      <title>Fail-safe Procedures</title>
      <param id="si-17_prm_1">
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="si-17_odp.01"/>
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="si-17_odp.02"/>
        <label>organization-defined list of failure conditions and associated fail-safe procedures</label>
      </param>
      <param id="si-17_odp.01">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-17_ODP[01]"/>
        <label>fail-safe procedures</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>fail-safe procedures associated with failure conditions are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="si-17_odp.02">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-17_ODP[02]"/>
        <label>list of failure conditions</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>a list of failure conditions requiring fail-safe procedures is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-17"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-17"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-17"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-17"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cp-12"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cp-13"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-24"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-13"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-17_smt">
        <p>Implement the indicated fail-safe procedures when the indicated failures occur: <insert type="param" id-ref="si-17_prm_1"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-17_gdn">
        <p>Failure conditions include the loss of communications among critical system components or between system components and operational facilities. Fail-safe procedures include alerting operator personnel and providing specific instructions on subsequent steps to take. Subsequent steps may include doing nothing, reestablishing system settings, shutting down processes, restarting the system, or contacting designated organizational personnel.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-17_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-17"/>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="si-18">
      <title>Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations</title>
      <param id="si-18_prm_1">
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="si-18_odp.01"/>
        <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="si-18_odp.02"/>

      </param>
      <param id="si-18_odp.01">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18_ODP[01]"/>

        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to check the accuracy of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="si-18_odp.02">

        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to check the relevance of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <param id="si-18_odp.03">

        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to check the timeliness of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>

        <label>frequency</label>

        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-18"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-18"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="si-18"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#227063d4-431e-435f-9e8f-009b6dbc20f4"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#c15bfc12-a61e-4ca5-bf35-fa9ce3ccb5d2"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a2590922-82f3-4277-83c0-ca5bee06dba4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-22"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pm-24"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#pt-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <part name="statement" id="si-18_smt">
        <part name="item" id="si-18_smt.a">
          <prop name="label" value="a."/>
          <p>Check the accuracy, relevance, timeliness, and completeness of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18_prm_1"/> ; and</p>
        </part>
        <part name="item" id="si-18_smt.b">
          <prop name="label" value="b."/>
          <p>Correct or delete inaccurate or outdated personally identifiable information.</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="si-18_gdn">
        <p>Personally identifiable information quality operations include the steps that organizations take to confirm the accuracy and relevance of personally identifiable information throughout the information life cycle. The information life cycle includes the creation, collection, use, processing, storage, maintenance, dissemination, disclosure, and disposal of personally identifiable information. Personally identifiable information quality operations include editing and validating addresses as they are collected or entered into systems using automated address verification look-up application programming interfaces. Checking personally identifiable information quality includes the tracking of updates or changes to data over time, which enables organizations to know how and what personally identifiable information was changed should erroneous information be identified. The measures taken to protect personally identifiable information quality are based on the nature and context of the personally identifiable information, how it is to be used, how it was obtained, and the potential de-identification methods employed. The measures taken to validate the accuracy of personally identifiable information used to make determinations about the rights, benefits, or privileges of individuals covered under federal programs may be more comprehensive than the measures used to validate personally identifiable information used for less sensitive purposes.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="si-18_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18"/>
        <part id="si-18_obj.a" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18a."/>
          <part id="si-18_obj.a-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18a.[01]"/>
            <p>the accuracy of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is checked <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-18_obj.a-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18a.[02]"/>
            <p>the relevance of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is checked <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18_odp.02"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-18_obj.a-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18a.[03]"/>
            <p>the timeliness of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is checked <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18_odp.03"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <part id="si-18_obj.a-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18a.[04]"/>
            <p>the completeness of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle is checked <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18_odp.04"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt.a"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt.a"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18_obj.b" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18b."/>
          <p>inaccurate or outdated personally identifiable information is corrected or deleted.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt.b"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="si-18_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
          <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
          <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
          <p>documentation addressing personally identifiable information quality operations</p>
          <p>quality reports</p>
          <p>maintenance logs</p>
          <p>system audit records</p>
          <p>audit findings</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
          <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-18_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel responsible for performing personally identifiable information quality inspections</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with privacy responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="si-18_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for personally identifiable information quality inspection</p>
          <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing personally identifiable information quality operations</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-18.1">
        <title>Automation Support</title>
        <param id="si-18.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-18.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>automated mechanisms</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>automated mechanisms used to correct or delete personally identifiable information that is inaccurate, outdated, incorrectly determined regarding impact, or incorrectly de-identified are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-18(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-18(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-18.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-18"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pm-18"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ra-8"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-18.1_smt">
          <p>Correct or delete personally identifiable information that is inaccurate or outdated, incorrectly determined regarding impact, or incorrectly de-identified using <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-18.1_gdn">
          <p>The use of automated mechanisms to improve data quality may inadvertently create privacy risks. Automated tools may connect to external or otherwise unrelated systems, and the matching of records between these systems may create linkages with unintended consequences. Organizations assess and document these risks in their privacy impact assessments and make determinations that are in alignment with their privacy program plans.</p>
          <p>As data is obtained and used across the information life cycle, it is important to confirm the accuracy and relevance of personally identifiable information. Automated mechanisms can augment existing data quality processes and procedures and enable an organization to better identify and manage personally identifiable information in large-scale systems. For example, automated tools can greatly improve efforts to consistently normalize data or identify malformed data. Automated tools can also be used to improve the auditing of data and detect errors that may incorrectly alter personally identifiable information or incorrectly associate such information with the wrong individual. Automated capabilities backstop processes and procedures at-scale and enable more fine-grained detection and correction of data quality errors.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-18.01_odp"/> are used to correct or delete personally identifiable information that is inaccurate, outdated, incorrectly determined regarding impact, or incorrectly de-identified.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
            <p>documentation addressing personally identifiable information quality operations</p>
            <p>quality reports</p>
            <p>maintenance logs</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>audit findings</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for performing personally identifiable information quality inspections</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for personally identifiable information quality inspection</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing personally identifiable information quality operations</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-18.2">
        <title>Data Tags</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-18(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-18(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-18.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-18"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ac-16"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sc-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-18.2_smt">
          <p>Employ data tags to automate the correction or deletion of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle within organizational systems.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-18.2_gdn">
          <p>Data tagging personally identifiable information includes tags that note processing permissions, authority to process, de-identification, impact level, information life cycle stage, and retention or last updated dates. Employing data tags for personally identifiable information can support the use of automation tools to correct or delete relevant personally identifiable information.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(02)"/>
          <p>data tags are employed to automate the correction or deletion of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle within organizational systems.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing data tagging</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information inventory</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>audit findings</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for tagging data</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Data tagging mechanisms</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing data tagging</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-18.3">
        <title>Collection</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-18(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-18(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-18.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-18"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-18.3_smt">
          <p>Collect personally identifiable information directly from the individual.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-18.3_gdn">
          <p>Individuals or their designated representatives can be sources of correct personally identifiable information. Organizations consider contextual factors that may incentivize individuals to provide correct data versus false data. Additional steps may be necessary to validate collected information based on the nature and context of the personally identifiable information, how it is to be used, and how it was obtained. The measures taken to validate the accuracy of personally identifiable information used to make determinations about the rights, benefits, or privileges of individuals under federal programs may be more comprehensive than the measures taken to validate less sensitive personally identifiable information.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(03)"/>
          <p>personally identifiable information is collected directly from the individual.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
            <p>system configuration documentation</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>user interface where personally identifiable information is collected</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for data collection</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Data collection mechanisms</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or validating collection directly from the individual</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-18.4">
        <title>Individual Requests</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-18(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-18(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-18.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-18"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-18.4_smt">
          <p>Correct or delete personally identifiable information upon request by individuals or their designated representatives.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-18.4_gdn">
          <p>Inaccurate personally identifiable information maintained by organizations may cause problems for individuals, especially in those business functions where inaccurate information may result in inappropriate decisions or the denial of benefits and services to individuals. Even correct information, in certain circumstances, can cause problems for individuals that outweigh the benefits of an organization maintaining the information. Organizations use discretion when determining if personally identifiable information is to be corrected or deleted based on the scope of requests, the changes sought, the impact of the changes, and laws, regulations, and policies. Organizational personnel consult with the senior agency official for privacy and legal counsel regarding appropriate instances of correction or deletion.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(04)"/>
          <p>personally identifiable information is corrected or deleted upon request by individuals or their designated representatives.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System and information integrity policy</p>
            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>
            <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
            <p>system configuration</p>
            <p>individual requests</p>
            <p>records of correction or deletion actions performed</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for responding to individual requests for personally identifiable information correction or deletion</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Request mechanisms</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing individual requests for correction or deletion</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="si-18.5">
        <title>Notice of Correction or Deletion</title>
        <param id="si-18.05_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="si-18.5_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="recipients of personally identifiable information"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(05)_ODP"/>
          <label>recipients</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>recipients of personally identifiable information to be notified when the personally identifiable information has been corrected or deleted are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SI-18(05)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SI-18(5)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(05)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="si-18.05"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="system"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#si-18"/>
        <part name="statement" id="si-18.5_smt">
          <p>Notify <insert type="param" id-ref="si-18.05_odp"/> and individuals that the personally identifiable information has been corrected or deleted.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="si-18.5_gdn">
          <p>When personally identifiable information is corrected or deleted, organizations take steps to ensure that all authorized recipients of such information, and the individual with whom the information is associated or their designated representatives, are informed of the corrected or deleted information.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(05)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="si-18.05_odp"/> and individuals are notified when the personally identifiable information has been corrected or deleted.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#si-18.5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(05)-Examine"/>

            <p>system and information integrity procedures</p>

            <p>individual requests for corrections or deletions</p>
            <p>notifications of correction or deletion action</p>
            <p>system audit records</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>privacy plan</p>
            <p>privacy impact assessment</p>
            <p>privacy risk assessment documentation</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="si-18.5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(05)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel responsible for sending correction or deletion notices</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SI-18(05)-Test"/>

            <p>Organizational processes for notifications of correction or deletion</p>
            <p>automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing notifications of correction or deletion</p>
          </part>
        </part>
