          <p>Organizational processes for identifying and addressing supply chain element and process deficiencies</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-3.1">
        <title>Diverse Supply Base</title>
        <param id="sr-3.1_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sr-03.01_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sr-03.01_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined system components and services</label>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-03.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>system components with a diverse set of sources are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-03.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>services</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>services with a diverse set of sources are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-03(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-3(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-03.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-3.1_smt">
          <p>Employ a diverse set of sources for the following system components and services: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-3.1_prm_1"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-3.1_gdn">
          <p>Diversifying the supply of systems, system components, and services can reduce the probability that adversaries will successfully identify and target the supply chain and can reduce the impact of a supply chain event or compromise. Identifying multiple suppliers for replacement components can reduce the probability that the replacement component will become unavailable. Employing a diverse set of developers or logistics service providers can reduce the impact of a natural disaster or other supply chain event. Organizations consider designing the system to include diverse materials and components.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)"/>
          <part id="sr-3.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)[01]"/>
            <p>a diverse set of sources is employed for <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-03.01_odp.01"/>;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-3.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-3.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)[02]"/>
            <p>a diverse set of sources is employed for <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-03.01_odp.02"/>.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-3.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-3.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>planning policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>physical inventory of critical systems and system components</p>
            <p>inventory of critical suppliers, service providers, developers, and contracts</p>
            <p>inventory records of critical system components</p>
            <p>list of security safeguards ensuring an adequate supply of critical system components</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing security safeguards to ensure an adequate supply of critical system components</p>
            <p>processes to identify critical suppliers</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the security safeguards that ensure an adequate supply of critical system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-3.2">
        <title>Limitation of Harm</title>
        <param id="sr-03.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-3.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls to limit harm from potential supply chain adversaries are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-03(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-3(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-03.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-3.2_smt">
          <p>Employ the following controls to limit harm from potential adversaries identifying and targeting the organizational supply chain: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-03.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-3.2_gdn">
          <p>Controls that can be implemented to reduce the probability of adversaries successfully identifying and targeting the supply chain include avoiding the purchase of custom or non-standardized configurations, employing approved vendor lists with standing reputations in industry, following pre-agreed maintenance schedules and update and patch delivery mechanisms, maintaining a contingency plan in case of a supply chain event, using procurement carve-outs that provide exclusions to commitments or obligations, using diverse delivery routes, and minimizing the time between purchase decisions and delivery.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(02)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-03.02_odp"/> are employed to limit harm from potential adversaries identifying and targeting the organizational supply chain.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-3.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>configuration management policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security requirements into the acquisition process</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the baseline configuration of the system</p>
            <p>configuration management plan</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>system architecture and associated configuration documentation</p>
            <p>solicitation documentation</p>
            <p>acquisition documentation</p>
            <p>acquisition contracts for the system, system component, or system service</p>
            <p>threat assessments</p>
            <p>vulnerability assessments</p>
            <p>list of security safeguards to be taken to protect the organizational supply chain against potential supply chain threats</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing safeguards to limit harm from adversaries of the organizational supply chain</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the definition and employment of safeguards to protect the organizational supply chain</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-3.3">
        <title>Sub-tier Flow Down</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-03(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-3(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-03.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-8"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-3.3_smt">
          <p>Ensure that the controls included in the contracts of prime contractors are also included in the contracts of subcontractors.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-3.3_gdn">
          <p>To manage supply chain risk effectively and holistically, it is important that organizations ensure that supply chain risk management controls are included at all tiers in the supply chain. This includes ensuring that Tier 1 (prime) contractors have implemented processes to facilitate the <q>flow down</q> of supply chain risk management controls to sub-tier contractors. The controls subject to flow down are identified in <a href="#sr-3_smt.b">SR-3b</a>.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(03)"/>
          <p>the controls included in the contracts of prime contractors are also included in the contracts of subcontractors.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-3.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>acquisition documentation</p>
            <p>service level agreements</p>
            <p>acquisition contracts for the system, system component, or system service</p>
            <p>inter-organizational agreements and procedures</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-3.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-03(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for establishing inter-organizational agreements and procedures with supply chain entities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sr-4">
      <title>Provenance</title>
      <param id="sr-04_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-4_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04_ODP"/>
        <label>systems, system components, and associated data</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>systems, system components, and associated data that require valid provenance are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-04"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-4"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-04"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#4ff10ed3-d8fe-4246-99e3-443045e27482"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f963c17-ab5a-432a-a867-91eac550309b"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#21caa535-1154-4369-ba7b-32c309fee0f7"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#863caf2a-978a-4260-9e8d-4a8929bce40c"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#15a95e24-65b6-4686-bc18-90855a10457d"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e3cc0520-a366-4fc9-abc2-5272db7e3564"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e8e84963-14fc-4c3a-be05-b412a5d37cd2"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e24b06cc-9129-4998-a76a-65c3d7a576ba"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a2590922-82f3-4277-83c0-ca5bee06dba4"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#38ff38f0-1366-4f50-a4c9-26a39aacee16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#cm-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ma-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#ra-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sr-4_smt">
        <p>Document, monitor, and maintain valid provenance of the following systems, system components, and associated data: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sr-4_gdn">
        <p>Every system and system component has a point of origin and may be changed throughout its existence. Provenance is the chronology of the origin, development, ownership, location, and changes to a system or system component and associated data. It may also include personnel and processes used to interact with or make modifications to the system, component, or associated data. Organizations consider developing procedures (see <a href="#sr-1">SR-1</a> ) for allocating responsibilities for the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of provenance for systems and system components; transferring provenance documentation and responsibility between organizations; and preventing and monitoring for unauthorized changes to the provenance records. Organizations have methods to document, monitor, and maintain valid provenance baselines for systems, system components, and related data. These actions help track, assess, and document any changes to the provenance, including changes in supply chain elements or configuration, and help ensure non-repudiation of provenance information and the provenance change records. Provenance considerations are addressed throughout the system development life cycle and incorporated into contracts and other arrangements, as appropriate.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04"/>
        <part id="sr-4_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04[01]"/>
          <p>valid provenance is documented for <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04_odp"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04[02]"/>
          <p>valid provenance is monitored for <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04_odp"/>;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04[03]"/>
          <p>valid provenance is maintained for <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04_odp"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Supply chain risk management policy</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management procedures</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
          <p>documentation of critical systems, critical system components, and associated data</p>
          <p>documentation showing the history of ownership, custody, and location of and changes to critical systems or critical system components</p>
          <p>system architecture</p>
          <p>inter-organizational agreements and procedures</p>
          <p>contracts</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>personally identifiable information processing policy</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with acquisition responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for identifying the provenance of critical systems and critical system components</p>
          <p>mechanisms used to document, monitor, or maintain provenance</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-4.1">
        <title>Identity</title>
        <param id="sr-04.01_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-4.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with organization-defined systems and critical system components"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(01)_ODP"/>
          <label>supply chain elements, processes, and personnel</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with systems and critical system components that require unique identification are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-4(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-04.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-16"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-4.1_smt">
          <p>Establish and maintain unique identification of the following supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with the identified system and critical system components: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.01_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-4.1_gdn">
          <p>Knowing who and what is in the supply chains of organizations is critical to gaining visibility into supply chain activities. Visibility into supply chain activities is also important for monitoring and identifying high-risk events and activities. Without reasonable visibility into supply chains elements, processes, and personnel, it is very difficult for organizations to understand and manage risk and reduce their susceptibility to adverse events. Supply chain elements include organizations, entities, or tools used for the research and development, design, manufacturing, acquisition, delivery, integration, operations, maintenance, and disposal of systems and system components. Supply chain processes include development processes for hardware, software, and firmware; shipping and handling procedures; configuration management tools, techniques, and measures to maintain provenance; personnel and physical security programs; or other programs, processes, or procedures associated with the production and distribution of supply chain elements. Supply chain personnel are individuals with specific roles and responsibilities related to the secure the research and development, design, manufacturing, acquisition, delivery, integration, operations and maintenance, and disposal of a system or system component. Identification methods are sufficient to support an investigation in case of a supply chain change (e.g. if a supply company is purchased), compromise, or event.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(01)"/>
          <part id="sr-4.1_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(01)[01]"/>
            <p>unique identification of <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.01_odp"/> is established;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.1_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-4.1_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(01)[02]"/>

          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.1_smt"/>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-4.2">
        <title>Track and Trace</title>
        <param id="sr-04.02_odp">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-4.2_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)_ODP"/>
          <label>systems and critical system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>systems and critical system components that require unique identification for tracking through the supply chain are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-4(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-04.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-2"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ia-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pe-16"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#pl-2"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-4.2_smt">
          <p>Establish and maintain unique identification of the following systems and critical system components for tracking through the supply chain: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.02_odp"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-4.2_gdn">
          <p>Tracking the unique identification of systems and system components during development and transport activities provides a foundational identity structure for the establishment and maintenance of provenance. For example, system components may be labeled using serial numbers or tagged using radio-frequency identification tags. Labels and tags can help provide better visibility into the provenance of a system or system component. A system or system component may have more than one unique identifier. Identification methods are sufficient to support a forensic investigation after a supply chain compromise or event.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)"/>
          <part id="sr-4.2_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)[01]"/>
            <p>the unique identification of <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.02_odp"/> is established for tracking through the supply chain;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-4.2_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)[02]"/>
            <p>the unique identification of <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.02_odp"/> is maintained for tracking through the supply chain.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.2_smt"/>
        </part>

          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)-Examine"/>

            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security requirements into the acquisition process</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>list of supply chain elements, processes, and actors (associated with the system, system component, or system service) requiring implementation of unique identification processes, procedures, tools, mechanisms, equipment, techniques, and/or configurations</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain protection responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with responsibilities for establishing and retaining the unique identification of supply chain elements, processes, and actors</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining, establishing, and retaining unique identification for supply chain elements, processes, and actors</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the definition, establishment, and retention of unique identification for supply chain elements, processes, and actors</p>
          </part>
        </part>

      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-4.3">
        <title>Validate as Genuine and Not Altered</title>
        <param id="sr-4.3_prm_1">
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sr-04.03_odp.01"/>
          <prop name="aggregates" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="sr-04.03_odp.02"/>
          <label>organization-defined controls</label>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-04.03_odp.01">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls to validate that the system or system component received is genuine are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-04.03_odp.02">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls to validate that the system or system component received has not been altered are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-04(03)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-4(3)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-04.03"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#at-3"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-9"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-10"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sr-11"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-4.3_smt">
          <p>Employ the following controls to validate that the system or system component received is genuine and has not been altered: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-4.3_prm_1"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-4.3_gdn">
          <p>For many systems and system components, especially hardware, there are technical means to determine if the items are genuine or have been altered, including optical and nanotechnology tagging, physically unclonable functions, side-channel analysis, cryptographic hash verifications or digital signatures, and visible anti-tamper labels or stickers. Controls can also include monitoring for out of specification performance, which can be an indicator of tampering or counterfeits. Organizations may leverage supplier and contractor processes for validating that a system or component is genuine and has not been altered and for replacing a suspect system or component. Some indications of tampering may be visible and addressable before accepting delivery, such as inconsistent packaging, broken seals, and incorrect labels. When a system or system component is suspected of being altered or counterfeit, the supplier, contractor, or original equipment manufacturer may be able to replace the item or provide a forensic capability to determine the origin of the counterfeit or altered item. Organizations can provide training to personnel on how to identify suspicious system or component deliveries.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.3_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)"/>
          <part id="sr-4.3_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)[01]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.03_odp.01"/> are employed to validate that the system or system component received is genuine;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-4.3_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)[02]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.03_odp.02"/> are employed to validate that the system or system component received has not been altered.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.3_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.3_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.3_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the security design principle of trusted components used in the specification, design, development, implementation, and modification of the system</p>
            <p>system design documentation</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security requirements into the acquisition process</p>
            <p>solicitation documentation</p>
            <p>acquisition documentation</p>
            <p>service level agreements</p>
            <p>acquisition contracts for the system, system component, or system service</p>
            <p>evidentiary documentation (including applicable configurations) indicating that the system or system component is genuine and has not been altered</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.3_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.3_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(03)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing validation safeguards</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the definition and employment of validation safeguards</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting the application of the security design principle of trusted components in system specification, design, development, implementation, and modification</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-4.4">
        <title>Supply Chain Integrity — Pedigree</title>
        <param id="sr-04.04_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-4.4_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls employed to ensure that the integrity of the system and system component are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-04.04_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-4.4_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="analysis"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>analysis method</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>an analysis method to be conducted to validate the internal composition and provenance of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services to ensure the integrity of the system and system component is defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-04(04)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-4(4)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-04.04"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-4"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ra-3"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-4.4_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.04_odp.01"/> and conduct <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.04_odp.02"/> to ensure the integrity of the system and system components by validating the internal composition and provenance of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-4.4_gdn">
          <p>Authoritative information regarding the internal composition of system components and the provenance of technology, products, and services provides a strong basis for trust. The validation of the internal composition and provenance of technologies, products, and services is referred to as the pedigree. For microelectronics, this includes material composition of components. For software this includes the composition of open-source and proprietary code, including the version of the component at a given point in time. Pedigrees increase the assurance that the claims suppliers assert about the internal composition and provenance of the products, services, and technologies they provide are valid. The validation of the internal composition and provenance can be achieved by various evidentiary artifacts or records that manufacturers and suppliers produce during the research and development, design, manufacturing, acquisition, delivery, integration, operations and maintenance, and disposal of technology, products, and services. Evidentiary artifacts include, but are not limited to, software identification (SWID) tags, software component inventory, the manufacturers’ declarations of platform attributes (e.g., serial numbers, hardware component inventory), and measurements (e.g., firmware hashes) that are tightly bound to the hardware itself.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.4_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)"/>
          <part id="sr-4.4_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)[01]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.04_odp.01"/> are employed to ensure the integrity of the system and system components;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.4_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-4.4_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)[02]"/>
            <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-04.04_odp.02"/> is conducted to ensure the integrity of the system and system components.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.4_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-4.4_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.4_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>bill of materials for critical systems or system components</p>
            <p>acquisition documentation</p>
            <p>software identification tags</p>
            <p>manufacturer declarations of platform attributes (e.g., serial numbers, hardware component inventory) and measurements (e.g., firmware hashes) that are tightly bound to the hardware itself</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.4_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-4.4_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-04(04)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for identifying pedigree information</p>
            <p>organizational processes to determine and validate the integrity of the internal composition of critical systems and critical system components</p>
            <p>mechanisms to determine and validate the integrity of the internal composition of critical systems and critical system components</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sr-5">
      <title>Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods</title>
      <param id="sr-05_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-5_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05_ODP"/>
        <label>strategies, tools, and methods</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods to protect against, identify, and mitigate supply chain risks are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-05"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-5"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-05"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#4ff10ed3-d8fe-4246-99e3-443045e27482"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f963c17-ab5a-432a-a867-91eac550309b"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#21caa535-1154-4369-ba7b-32c309fee0f7"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#863caf2a-978a-4260-9e8d-4a8929bce40c"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#15a95e24-65b6-4686-bc18-90855a10457d"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#08b07465-dbdc-48d6-8a0b-37279602ac16"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e8e84963-14fc-4c3a-be05-b412a5d37cd2"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e24b06cc-9129-4998-a76a-65c3d7a576ba"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#38ff38f0-1366-4f50-a4c9-26a39aacee16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#at-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-2"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-4"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-5"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-8"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-10"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sa-15"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-6"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-9"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-10"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-11"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sr-5_smt">
        <p>Employ the following acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods to protect against, identify, and mitigate supply chain risks: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sr-5_gdn">
        <p>The use of the acquisition process provides an important vehicle to protect the supply chain. There are many useful tools and techniques available, including obscuring the end use of a system or system component, using blind or filtered buys, requiring tamper-evident packaging, or using trusted or controlled distribution. The results from a supply chain risk assessment can guide and inform the strategies, tools, and methods that are most applicable to the situation. Tools and techniques may provide protections against unauthorized production, theft, tampering, insertion of counterfeits, insertion of malicious software or backdoors, and poor development practices throughout the system development life cycle. Organizations also consider providing incentives for suppliers who implement controls, promote transparency into their processes and security and privacy practices, provide contract language that addresses the prohibition of tainted or counterfeit components, and restrict purchases from untrustworthy suppliers. Organizations consider providing training, education, and awareness programs for personnel regarding supply chain risk, available mitigation strategies, and when the programs should be employed. Methods for reviewing and protecting development plans, documentation, and evidence are commensurate with the security and privacy requirements of the organization. Contracts may specify documentation protection requirements.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-5_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05"/>
        <part id="sr-5_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05[01]"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05_odp"/> are employed to protect against supply chain risks;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05[02]"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05_odp"/> are employed to identify supply chain risks;</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05[03]"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05_odp"/> are employed to mitigate supply chain risks.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5_smt"/>
        </part>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-5_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Supply chain risk management policy</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management procedures</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
          <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
          <p>system and services acquisition procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
          <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security and privacy requirements into the acquisition process</p>
          <p>solicitation documentation</p>
          <p>acquisition documentation (including purchase orders)</p>
          <p>service level agreements</p>
          <p>acquisition contracts for systems, system components, or services</p>
          <p>documentation of training, education, and awareness programs for personnel regarding supply chain risk</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-5_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with acquisition responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-5_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing tailored acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the definition and employment of tailored acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-5.1">
        <title>Adequate Supply</title>
        <param id="sr-05.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-5.1_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <label>controls</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>controls to ensure an adequate supply of critical system components are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-05.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-5.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>critical system components</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>critical system components of which an adequate supply is required are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-05(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-5(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-05.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ra-9"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-5.1_smt">
          <p>Employ the following controls to ensure an adequate supply of <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05.01_odp.02"/>: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05.01_odp.01"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-5.1_gdn">
          <p>Adversaries can attempt to impede organizational operations by disrupting the supply of critical system components or corrupting supplier operations. Organizations may track systems and component mean time to failure to mitigate the loss of temporary or permanent system function. Controls to ensure that adequate supplies of critical system components include the use of multiple suppliers throughout the supply chain for the identified critical components, stockpiling spare components to ensure operation during mission-critical times, and the identification of functionally identical or similar components that may be used, if necessary.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05.01_odp.01"/> are employed to ensure an adequate supply of <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-05.01_odp.02"/>.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management strategy</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>contingency planning documents</p>
            <p>inventory of critical systems and system components</p>
            <p>determination of adequate supply</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security requirements into the acquisition process</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the integration of acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods into the acquisition process</p>
            <p>solicitation documentation</p>
            <p>acquisition documentation</p>
            <p>service level agreements</p>
            <p>acquisition contracts for systems or services</p>
            <p>purchase orders/requisitions for the system, system component, or system service from suppliers</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing tailored acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the definition and employment of tailored acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-5.2">
        <title>Assessments Prior to Selection, Acceptance, Modification, or Update</title>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-05(02)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-5(2)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-05.02"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ca-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ra-5"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#sa-11"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-7"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-5.2_smt">
          <p>Assess the system, system component, or system service prior to selection, acceptance, modification, or update.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-5.2_gdn">
          <p>Organizational personnel or independent, external entities conduct assessments of systems, components, products, tools, and services to uncover evidence of tampering, unintentional and intentional vulnerabilities, or evidence of non-compliance with supply chain controls. These include malicious code, malicious processes, defective software, backdoors, and counterfeits. Assessments can include evaluations; design proposal reviews; visual or physical inspection; static and dynamic analyses; visual, x-ray, or magnetic particle inspections; simulations; white, gray, or black box testing; fuzz testing; stress testing; and penetration testing (see <a href="#sr-6.1">SR-6(1)</a> ). Evidence generated during assessments is documented for follow-on actions by organizations. The evidence generated during the organizational or independent assessments of supply chain elements may be used to improve supply chain processes and inform the supply chain risk management process. The evidence can be leveraged in follow-on assessments. Evidence and other documentation may be shared in accordance with organizational agreements.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.2_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)"/>
          <part id="sr-5.2_obj-1" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)[01]"/>
            <p>the system, system component, or system service is assessed prior to selection;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-5.2_obj-2" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)[02]"/>
            <p>the system, system component, or system service is assessed prior to acceptance;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-5.2_obj-3" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)[03]"/>
            <p>the system, system component, or system service is assessed prior to modification;</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <part id="sr-5.2_obj-4" name="assessment-objective">
            <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)[04]"/>
            <p>the system, system component, or system service is assessed prior to update.</p>
            <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5.2_smt"/>
          </part>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-5.2_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.2_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>System security plan</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security requirements into the acquisition process</p>
            <p>security test and evaluation results</p>
            <p>vulnerability assessment results</p>
            <p>penetration testing results</p>
            <p>organizational risk assessment results</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.2_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain protection responsibilities</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-5.2_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-05(02)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for conducting assessments prior to selection, acceptance, or update</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the conducting of assessments prior to selection, acceptance, or update</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sr-6">
      <title>Supplier Assessments and Reviews</title>
      <param id="sr-06_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-6_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06_ODP"/>
        <label>frequency</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>the frequency at which to assess and review the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors and the systems, system components, or system services they provide is defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-06"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-6"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-06"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#4ff10ed3-d8fe-4246-99e3-443045e27482"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f963c17-ab5a-432a-a867-91eac550309b"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#21caa535-1154-4369-ba7b-32c309fee0f7"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#863caf2a-978a-4260-9e8d-4a8929bce40c"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#15a95e24-65b6-4686-bc18-90855a10457d"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#678e3d6c-150b-4393-aec5-6e3481eb1e00"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#eea3c092-42ed-4382-a6f4-1adadef01b9d"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#7c37a38d-21d7-40d8-bc3d-b5e27eac17e1"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#a295ca19-8c75-4b4c-8800-98024732e181"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#08b07465-dbdc-48d6-8a0b-37279602ac16"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e8e84963-14fc-4c3a-be05-b412a5d37cd2"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e24b06cc-9129-4998-a76a-65c3d7a576ba"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#38ff38f0-1366-4f50-a4c9-26a39aacee16"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-3"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sr-5"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sr-6_smt">
        <p>Assess and review the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors and the system, system component, or system service they provide <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-06_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sr-6_gdn">
        <p>An assessment and review of supplier risk includes security and supply chain risk management processes, foreign ownership, control or influence (FOCI), and the ability of the supplier to effectively assess subordinate second-tier and third-tier suppliers and contractors. The reviews may be conducted by the organization or by an independent third party. The reviews consider documented processes, documented controls, all-source intelligence, and publicly available information related to the supplier or contractor. Organizations can use open-source information to monitor for indications of stolen information, poor development and quality control practices, information spillage, or counterfeits. In some cases, it may be appropriate or required to share assessment and review results with other organizations in accordance with any applicable rules, policies, or inter-organizational agreements or contracts.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-6_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06"/>
        <p>the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors and the systems, system components, or system services they provide are assessed and reviewed <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-06_odp"/>.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-6_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-6_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management strategy</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
          <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
          <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
          <p>procedures addressing the integration of information security requirements into the acquisition process</p>
          <p>records of supplier due diligence reviews</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-6_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06-Interview"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
          <p>organizational personnel with supply chain protection responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-6_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06-Test"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Organizational processes for conducting supplier reviews</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing supplier reviews</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <control class="SP800-53-enhancement" id="sr-6.1">
        <title>Testing and Analysis</title>
        <param id="sr-06.01_odp.01">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-6.1_prm_1"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)_ODP[01]"/>
          <select how-many="one-or-more">
            <choice>organizational analysis</choice>
            <choice>independent third-party analysis</choice>
            <choice>organizational testing</choice>
            <choice>independent third-party testing</choice>
          </select>
        </param>
        <param id="sr-06.01_odp.02">
          <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-6.1_prm_2"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)_ODP[02]"/>
          <label>supply chain elements, processes, and actors</label>
          <guideline>
            <p>supply chain elements, processes, and actors to be analyzed and tested are defined;</p>
          </guideline>
        </param>
        <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-6(1)"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)"/>
        <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-06.01"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
        <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
        <link rel="required" href="#sr-6"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#ca-8"/>
        <link rel="related" href="#si-4"/>
        <part name="statement" id="sr-6.1_smt">
          <p>Employ <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-06.01_odp.01"/> of the following supply chain elements, processes, and actors associated with the system, system component, or system service: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-06.01_odp.02"/>.</p>
        </part>
        <part name="guidance" id="sr-6.1_gdn">
          <p>Relationships between entities and procedures within the supply chain, including development and delivery, are considered. Supply chain elements include organizations, entities, or tools that are used for the research and development, design, manufacturing, acquisition, delivery, integration, operations, maintenance, and disposal of systems, system components, or system services. Supply chain processes include supply chain risk management programs; SCRM strategies and implementation plans; personnel and physical security programs; hardware, software, and firmware development processes; configuration management tools, techniques, and measures to maintain provenance; shipping and handling procedures; and programs, processes, or procedures associated with the production and distribution of supply chain elements. Supply chain actors are individuals with specific roles and responsibilities in the supply chain. The evidence generated and collected during analyses and testing of supply chain elements, processes, and actors is documented and used to inform organizational risk management activities and decisions.</p>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-6.1_obj" name="assessment-objective">
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)"/>
          <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-06.01_odp.01"/> is/are employed on <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-06.01_odp.02"/> associated with the system, system component, or system service.</p>
          <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-6.1_smt"/>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-6.1_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)-Examine"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Supply chain risk management policy and procedures</p>
            <p>supply chain risk management plan</p>
            <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
            <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
            <p>evidence of organizational analysis, independent third-party analysis, organizational penetration testing, and/or independent third-party penetration testing</p>
            <p>list of supply chain elements, processes, and actors (associated with the system, system component, or system service) subject to analysis and/or testing</p>
            <p>system security plan</p>
            <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-6.1_asm-interview" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="INTERVIEW"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)-Interview"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with information security responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
            <p>organizational personnel with responsibilities for analyzing and/or testing supply chain elements, processes, and actors</p>
          </part>
        </part>
        <part id="sr-6.1_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
          <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>
          <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-06(01)-Test"/>
          <part name="assessment-objects">
            <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing methods of analysis/testing of supply chain elements, processes, and actors</p>
            <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the analysis/testing of supply chain elements, processes, and actors</p>
          </part>
        </part>
      </control>
    </control>
    <control class="SP800-53" id="sr-7">
      <title>Supply Chain Operations Security</title>
      <param id="sr-07_odp">
        <prop name="alt-identifier" value="sr-7_prm_1"/>
        <prop name="alt-label" class="sp800-53" value="Operations Security (OPSEC) controls"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-07_ODP"/>
        <label>OPSEC controls</label>
        <guideline>
          <p>Operations Security (OPSEC) controls to protect supply chain-related information for the system, system component, or system service are defined;</p>
        </guideline>
      </param>
      <prop name="label" class="zero-padded" value="SR-07"/>
        <prop name="label" value="SR-7"/>
      <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-07"/>
      <prop name="sort-id" value="sr-07"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="implementation-level" value="organization"/>
      <prop ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" name="contributes-to-assurance" value="true"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#21caa535-1154-4369-ba7b-32c309fee0f7"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#08b07465-dbdc-48d6-8a0b-37279602ac16"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#863caf2a-978a-4260-9e8d-4a8929bce40c"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e8e84963-14fc-4c3a-be05-b412a5d37cd2"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#e24b06cc-9129-4998-a76a-65c3d7a576ba"/>
      <link rel="related" href="#sc-38"/>
      <part name="statement" id="sr-7_smt">
        <p>Employ the following Operations Security (OPSEC) controls to protect supply chain-related information for the system, system component, or system service: <insert type="param" id-ref="sr-07_odp"/>.</p>
      </part>
      <part name="guidance" id="sr-7_gdn">
        <p>Supply chain OPSEC expands the scope of OPSEC to include suppliers and potential suppliers. OPSEC is a process that includes identifying critical information, analyzing friendly actions related to operations and other activities to identify actions that can be observed by potential adversaries, determining indicators that potential adversaries might obtain that could be interpreted or pieced together to derive information in sufficient time to cause harm to organizations, implementing safeguards or countermeasures to eliminate or reduce exploitable vulnerabilities and risk to an acceptable level, and considering how aggregated information may expose users or specific uses of the supply chain. Supply chain information includes user identities; uses for systems, system components, and system services; supplier identities; security and privacy requirements; system and component configurations; supplier processes; design specifications; and testing and evaluation results. Supply chain OPSEC may require organizations to withhold mission or business information from suppliers and may include the use of intermediaries to hide the end use or users of systems, system components, or system services.</p>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-7_obj" name="assessment-objective">
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-07"/>
        <p><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-07_odp"/> are employed to protect supply chain-related information for the system, system component, or system service.</p>
        <link rel="assessment-for" href="#sr-7_smt"/>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-7_asm-examine" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="EXAMINE"/>
        <prop name="label" class="sp800-53a" value="SR-07-Examine"/>
        <part name="assessment-objects">
          <p>Supply chain risk management plan</p>
          <p>supply chain risk management procedures</p>
          <p>system and services acquisition policy</p>
          <p>system and services acquisition procedures</p>
          <p>procedures addressing supply chain protection</p>
          <p>list of OPSEC controls to be employed</p>
          <p>solicitation documentation</p>
          <p>acquisition documentation</p>
          <p>acquisition contracts for the system, system component, or system service</p>
          <p>records of all-source intelligence analyses</p>
          <p>system security plan</p>
          <p>privacy plan</p>
          <p>other relevant documents or records</p>
        </part>
      </part>

          <p>organizational personnel with information security and privacy responsibilities</p>

          <p>organizational personnel with supply chain risk management responsibilities</p>
        </part>
      </part>
      <part id="sr-7_asm-test" name="assessment-method">
        <prop name="method" ns="http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/rmf" value="TEST"/>

          <p>Organizational processes for defining and employing OPSEC safeguards</p>
          <p>mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the definition and employment of OPSEC safeguards</p>
        </part>

    <control class="SP800-53" id="sr-8">
      <title>Notification Agreements</title>
      <param id="sr-08_odp.01">

          <choice>notification of supply chain compromises</choice>
          <choice><insert type="param" id-ref="sr-08_odp.02"/> </choice>

      <link rel="reference" href="#4ff10ed3-d8fe-4246-99e3-443045e27482"/>
      <link rel="reference" href="#0f963c17-ab5a-432a-a867-91eac550309b"/>
