      <!-- - - IA-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="NSO"/>
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>NSO for non-privileged users. Attestation for privileged users related to
                  multi-factor identification and authentication - specifically include description
                  of management of service accounts.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-2 (1) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-2.1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ia-2.1_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ia-2.1_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization implements multifactor authentication for network access to privileged accounts.</p>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-2.1_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Identification and authentication policy; procedures addressing user identification and authentication; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; list of information system accounts; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-2.1_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system operations responsibilities; organizational personnel with account management responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; and system/network administrators; system developer.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-2.1_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing multifactor authentication capability.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-2 (12) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-2.12">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ia-2.12_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="ia-2.12_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the information system:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Accepts PIV credentials.</li>
                  <li>Electronically verifies PIV credentials.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-2.12_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Identification and authentication policy; procedures addressing user identification and authentication; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; PIV verification records; evidence of PIV credentials; PIV credential authorizations; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-2.12_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system operations responsibilities; organizational personnel with account management responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators; and system developers.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-2.12_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing acceptance and verification of PIV credentials.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Must document and assess for privileged users. May attest to this
                  control for non-privileged users. FedRAMP requires a minimum of multi-factor
                  authentication for all Federal privileged users, if acceptance of PIV credentials
                  is not supported. The implementation status and details of how this control is
                  implemented must be clearly defined by the CSP.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
         <add by-id="ia-2.12_smt">
            <part id="ia-2.12_fr" name="item">
               <title>IA-2 (12) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ia-2.12_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Include Common Access Card (CAC), i.e., the DoD technical implementation of
                          PIV/FIPS 201/HSPD-12.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>

      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-5 (1) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-5.1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-5 (11) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-5.11">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ia-5.11_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="FED"/>
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="ia-5.11_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if, for hardware token-based authentication, the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines token quality requirements to be satisfied.</li>
                  <li>Employs mechanisms that satisfy organization-defined token quality requirements.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-5.11_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Identification and authentication policy; procedures addressing authenticator management; security plan; information system design documentation; automated mechanisms employing hardware token-based authentication for the information system; list of token quality requirements; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-5.11_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with authenticator management responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators; and system developers.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-5.11_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing hardware token-based authenticator management capability.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>FED - for Federal privileged users. Condition - Must document and assess for
                  privileged users. May attest to this control for non-privileged users.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-6 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-6">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ia-6_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ia-6_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the information system obscures feedback of authentication information during the authentication process to protect the information from possible exploitation/use by unauthorized individuals.</p>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-6_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Identification and authentication policy; procedures addressing authenticator feedback; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-6_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators; and system developers.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-6_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing the obscuring of feedback of authentication information during authentication.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-7 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-7">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-8 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-8">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-8 (1) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-8.1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ia-8.1_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="ia-8.1_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the information system:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Accepts PIV credentials from other agencies.</li>
                  <li>Electronically verifies PIV credentials from other agencies.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.1_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Identification and authentication policy; procedures addressing user identification and authentication; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; PIV verification records; evidence of PIV credentials; PIV credential authorizations; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.1_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system operations responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators; system developers; and organizational personnel with account management responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.1_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication capability; automated mechanisms that accept and verify PIV credentials.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Must document and assess for privileged users. May attest to this
                  control for non-privileged users. FedRAMP requires a minimum of multi-factor
                  authentication for all Federal privileged users, if acceptance of PIV credentials
                  is not supported. The implementation status and details of how this control is
                  implemented must be clearly defined by the CSP.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-8 (2) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-8.2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ia-8.2_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="ia-8.2_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the information system accepts only FICAM-approved third-party credentials.</p>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.2_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Identification and authentication policy; procedures addressing user identification and authentication; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; list of FICAM-approved, third-party credentialing products, components, or services procured and implemented by organization; third-party credential verification records; evidence of FICAM-approved third-party credentials; third-party credential authorizations; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.2_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system operations responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators; system developers; and organizational personnel with account management responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ia-8.2_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing identification and authentication capability; automated mechanisms that accept FICAM-approved credentials.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Must document and assess for privileged users. May attest to this
                  control for non-privileged users. FedRAMP requires a minimum of multi-factor
                  authentication for all Federal privileged users, if acceptance of PIV credentials
                  is not supported. The implementation status and details of how this control is
                  implemented must be clearly defined by the CSP.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-8 (3) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-8.3">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IA-8 (4) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ia-8.4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ir-4_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ir-4_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Implements an incident handling capability for security incidents that includes:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Preparation;</li>
                        <li>Detection and analysis;</li>
                        <li>Containment;</li>
                        <li>Eradication; and</li>
                        <li>Recovery.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Coordinates incident handling activities with contingency planning activities.</li>
                  <li>Incorporates lessons learned from ongoing incident handling activities into:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Incident response procedures;</li>
                        <li>Training; and</li>
                        <li>Testing/exercises.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Implements the resulting changes accordingly to:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Incident response procedures;</li>
                        <li>Training; and</li>
                        <li>Testing/exercises.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-4_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Incident response policy; contingency planning policy; procedures addressing incident handling; incident response plan; contingency plan; security plan; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-4_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with incident handling responsibilities; organizational personnel with contingency planning responsibilities; and organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-4_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Incident handling capability for the organization</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-4_fr" name="item">
               <title>IR-4 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ir-4_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider ensures that individuals conducting incident handling meet
                     personnel security requirements commensurate with the criticality/sensitivity
                     of the information being processed, stored, and transmitted by the information
                     system.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-6 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-6">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ir-6_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ir-6_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines the time period within which personnel report suspected security incidents to the organizational incident response capability.</li>
                  <li>Requires personnel to report suspected security incidents to the organizational incident response capability within the organization-defined time period.</li>
                  <li>Defines authorities to whom security incident information is to be reported.</li>
                  <li>Reports security incident information to organization-defined authorities.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-6_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Incident response policy; procedures addressing incident reporting; incident reporting records and documentation; incident response plan; security plan; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-6_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with incident reporting responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; personnel who have/should have reported incidents; and personnel (authorities) to whom incident information is to be reported.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ir-6_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for incident reporting; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing incident reporting.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
         <add by-id="ir-6_smt" position="ending">
            <part id="ir-6_fr" name="item">
               <title>IR-6 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ir-6_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>Report security incident information according to FedRAMP Incident
                          Communications Procedure.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-7 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-7">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-8 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-8">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Attestation - Specifically attest to US-CERT compliance.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - IR-9 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ir-9">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Attestation - Specifically describe information spillage response processes.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MA-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ma-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MA-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ma-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ma-2_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="ma-2_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>schedules maintenance and repairs on information system components in accordance with manufacturer or vendor specifications; and/or organizational requirements;</li>
                  <li>performs maintenance and repairs on information system components in accordance with manufacturer or vendor specifications; and/or organizational requirements;</li>
                  <li>documents maintenance and repairs on information system components in accordance with manufacturer or vendor specifications; and/or organizational requirements;</li>
                  <li>reviews records of maintenance and repairs on information system components in accordance with manufacturer or vendor specifications; and/or organizational requirements;</li>
                  <li>approves all maintenance activities, whether performed on-site or remotely and whether the equipment is serviced on-site or removed to another location;</li>
                  <li>monitors all maintenance activities, whether performed on-site or remotely and whether the equipment is serviced on-site or removed to another location;</li>
                  <li>defines personnel or roles required to explicitly approve the removal of the information system or system components from organizational facilities for off-site maintenance or repairs;</li>
                  <li>requires that organization-defined personnel or roles explicitly approve the removal of the information system or system components from organizational facilities for off-site maintenance or repairs;</li>
                  <li>sanitizes equipment to remove all information from associated media prior to removal from organizational facilities for off-site maintenance or repairs;</li>
                  <li>checks all potentially impacted security controls to verify that the controls are still functioning properly following maintenance or repair actions;</li>
                  <li>defines maintenance-related information to be included in organizational maintenance records; and</li>
                  <li>includes organization-defined maintenance-related information in organizational maintenance records.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ma-2_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Information system maintenance policy; procedures addressing controlled information system maintenance; maintenance records; manufacturer/vendor maintenance specifications; equipment sanitization records; media sanitization records; other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ma-2_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system maintenance responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; organizational personnel responsible for media sanitization; system/network administrators.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ma-2_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for scheduling, performing, documenting, reviewing, approving, and monitoring maintenance and repairs for the information system; organizational processes for sanitizing information system components; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing controlled maintenance; automated mechanisms implementing sanitization of information system components.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Control is not inherited from a FedRAMP-authorized PaaS or IaaS.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MA-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ma-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MA-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ma-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ma-5_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="ma-5_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>establishes a process for maintenance personnel authorization;</li>
                  <li>maintains a list of authorized maintenance organizations or personnel;</li>
                  <li>ensures that non-escorted personnel performing maintenance on the information system have required access authorizations; and</li>
                  <li>designates organizational personnel with required access authorizations and technical competence to supervise the maintenance activities of personnel who do not possess the required access authorizations.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ma-5_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Information system maintenance policy; procedures addressing maintenance personnel; service provider contracts; service-level agreements; list of authorized personnel; maintenance records; access control records; other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ma-5_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system maintenance responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ma-5_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for authorizing and managing maintenance personnel; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing authorization of maintenance personnel.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Control is not inherited from a FedRAMP-authorized PaaS or IaaS.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MP-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="mp-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MP-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="mp-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="mp-2_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="mp-2_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>defines types of digital and/or non-digital media requiring restricted access;</li>
                  <li>defines personnel or roles authorized to access organization-defined types of digital and/or non-digital media; and</li>
                  <li>restricts access to organization-defined types of digital and/or non-digital media to organization-defined personnel or roles.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="mp-2_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Information system media protection policy; procedures addressing media access restrictions; access control policy and procedures; physical and environmental protection policy and procedures; media storage facilities; access control records; other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="mp-2_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with information system media protection responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="mp-2_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for restricting information media; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing media access restrictions.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Control is not inherited from a FedRAMP-authorized PaaS or IaaS.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - MP-6 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="mp-6">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="mp-6_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="mp-6_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>defines information system media to be sanitized prior to:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>disposal;</li>
                        <li>release out of organizational controls; or</li>
                        <li>release for reuse.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>defines sanitization techniques or procedures to be used for sanitizing organization-defined information system media prior to:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>disposal;</li>
                        <li>release out of organizational controls; or</li>
                        <li>release for reuse.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>sanitizes organization-defined information system media prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse using organization-defined sanitization techniques or procedures in accordance with applicable federal and organizational standards and policies; and</li>
                  <li>employs sanitization mechanisms with strength and integrity commensurate with the security category or classification of the information.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="mp-6_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Information system media protection policy; procedures addressing media sanitization and disposal; applicable federal standards and policies addressing media sanitization; media sanitization records; audit records; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; other relevant documents or records.</p>

               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>defines entry/exit points to the facility where the information system resides;</li>
                  <li>enforces physical access authorizations at organization-defined entry/exit points to the facility where the information system resides by:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>verifying individual access authorizations before granting access to the facility;</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>enforces physical access authorizations at organization-defined entry/exit points to the facility where the information system resides by:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>defining physical access control systems/devices to be employed to control ingress/egress to the facility where the information system resides;</li>
                        <li>using one or more of the following ways to control ingress/egress to the facility:</li>
                        <li>
                           <ul>
                              <li>organization-defined physical access control systems/devices; and/or</li>
                              <li>guards;</li>
                           </ul>
                        </li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>defines entry/exit points for which physical access audit logs are to be maintained;</li>
                  <li>maintains physical access audit logs for organization-defined entry/exit points;</li>
                  <li>defines security safeguards to be employed to control access to areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible;</li>
                  <li>provides organization-defined security safeguards to control access to areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible;</li>
                  <li>defines circumstances requiring visitor:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>escorts; and</li>
                        <li>monitoring;</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>in accordance with organization-defined circumstances requiring visitor escorts and monitoring:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>escorts visitors; and</li>
                        <li>monitors visitor activities.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>secures keys;</li>
                  <li>secures combinations;</li>
                  <li>secures other physical access devices;</li>
                  <li>defines physical access devices to be inventoried;</li>
                  <li>defines the frequency to inventory organization-defined physical access devices;</li>
                  <li>inventories the organization-defined physical access devices with the organization-defined frequency;</li>
                  <li>defines the frequency to change combinations and keys; and</li>
                  <li>changes combinations and keys with the organization-defined frequency and/or when:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>keys are lost;</li>
                        <li>combinations are compromised; or</li>
                        <li>individuals are transferred or terminated.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>

               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>protects the information system from damage resulting from water leakage by providing master shutoff or isolation valves that are:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>accessible;</li>
                        <li>working properly; and</li>
                        <li>known to key personnel.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="pe-15_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Physical and environmental protection policy; procedures addressing physical access authorizations; security plan; authorized personnel access list; authorization credentials; physical access list reviews; physical access termination records and associated documentation; other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="pe-15_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with physical access authorization responsibilities; organizational personnel with physical access to information system facility; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="pe-15_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for physical access authorizations; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access authorizations.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Control is not inherited from a FedRAMP-authorized PaaS or IaaS.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PE-16 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="pe-16">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="pe-16_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="pe-16_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>defines types of information system components to be authorized, monitored, and controlled as such components are entering and exiting the facility;</li>
                  <li>authorizes organization-defined information system components entering the facility;</li>
                  <li>monitors organization-defined information system components entering the facility;</li>
                  <li>controls organization-defined information system components entering the facility;</li>
                  <li>authorizes organization-defined information system components exiting the facility;</li>
                  <li>monitors organization-defined information system components exiting the facility;</li>
                  <li>controls organization-defined information system components exiting the facility;</li>
                  <li>maintains records of information system components entering the facility; and</li>
                  <li>maintains records of information system components exiting the facility.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="pe-16_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Physical and environmental protection policy; procedures addressing physical access authorizations; security plan; authorized personnel access list; authorization credentials; physical access list reviews; physical access termination records and associated documentation; other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="pe-16_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with physical access authorization responsibilities; organizational personnel with physical access to information system facility; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="pe-16_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for physical access authorizations; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing physical access authorizations.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: Control is not inherited from a FedRAMP-authorized PaaS or IaaS.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PL-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="pl-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PL-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="pl-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="pl-2_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="pl-2_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Develops a security plan for the information system that:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Is consistent with the organization’s enterprise architecture;</li>
                        <li>Explicitly defines the authorization boundary for the system;</li>
                        <li>Describes the operational context of the information system in terms of missions and business processes;</li>
                        <li>Provides the security categorization of the information system including supporting rationale;</li>
                        <li>Describes the operational environment for the information system and relationships with or connections to other information systems;</li>
                        <li>Provides an overview of the security requirements for the system;</li>
                        <li>Identifies any relevant overlays, if applicable;</li>
                        <li>Describes the security controls in place or planned for meeting those requirements including a rationale for the tailoring decisions; and</li>
                        <li>Is reviewed and approved by the authorizing official or designated representative prior to plan implementation.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Defines personnel or roles to whom copies of the security plan are to be distributed and subsequent changes to the plan are to be communicated.</li>
                  <li>Distributes copies of the security plan and communicates subsequent changes to the plan to organization-defined personnel or roles.</li>
                  <li>Defines the frequency to review the security plan for the information system.</li>
                  <li>Reviews the security plan for the information system with the organization-defined frequency.</li>
                  <li>Updates the plan to address:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Changes to the information system/environment of operation;</li>
                        <li>Problems identified during plan implementation; and</li>
                        <li>Problems identified during security control assessments.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Protects the security plan from unauthorized:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Disclosure; and</li>
                        <li>Modification.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="pl-2_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Security planning policy; procedures addressing security plan development and implementation; procedures addressing security plan reviews and updates; enterprise architecture documentation; security plan for the information system; records of security plan reviews and updates; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="pl-2_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with security planning and plan implementation responsibilities; and organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="pl-2_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for security plan development/review/update/approval; automated mechanisms supporting the information system security plan.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PL-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="pl-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="FED"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-3 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-3">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ps-3_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ps-3_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Screens individuals prior to authorizing access to the information system.</li>
                  <li>Defines conditions requiring re-screening.</li>
                  <li>Defines the frequency of re-screening where it is so indicated.</li>
                  <li>Re-screens individuals in accordance with organization-defined conditions requiring re-screening and, where re-screening is so indicated, with the organization-defined frequency of such re-screening.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ps-3_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Personnel security policy; procedures addressing personnel screening; records of screened personnel; security plan; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ps-3_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with personnel security responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ps-3_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for personnel screening.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-6 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-6">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - PS-7 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-7">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Attestation - Specifically stating that any third-party security personnel are
                  treated as CSP employees.</p>
            </part>

      <!-- - - PS-8 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ps-8">
