         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - RA-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ra-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - RA-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ra-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ra-2_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ra-2_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Categorizes information and the information system in accordance with applicable Federal laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidance.</li>
                  <li>Documents the security categorization results (including supporting rationale) in the security plan for the information system.</li>
                  <li>Ensures the authorizing official or authorizing official designated representative reviews and approves the security categorization decision.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-2_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Risk assessment policy; security planning policy and procedures; procedures addressing security categorization of organizational information and information systems; security plan; security categorization documentation; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-2_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with security categorization and risk assessment responsibilities; and organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-2_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for security categorization.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - RA-3 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ra-3">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ra-3_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ra-3_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Conducts an assessment of risk, including the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from the unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>The information system.</li>
                     </ul>Conducts an assessment of risk, including the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from the unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>The information the system processes, stores, or transmits.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Defines a document in which risk assessment results are to be documented (if not documented in the security plan or risk assessment report).</li>
                  <li>Documents risk assessment results in one of the following:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>The security plan;</li>
                        <li>The risk assessment report; or</li>
                        <li>The organization-defined document.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Reviews risk assessment results with the organization-defined frequency.Defines the frequency to review risk assessment results.</li>
                  <li>Defines personnel or roles to whom risk assessment results are to be disseminated.</li>
                  <li>Disseminates risk assessment results to organization-defined personnel or roles.</li>
                  <li>Defines the frequency to update the risk assessment.</li>
                  <li>Updates the risk assessment:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>With the organization-defined frequency;</li>
                        <li>Whenever there are significant changes to the information system or environment of operation (including the identification of new threats and vulnerabilities); and</li>
                        <li>Whenever there are other conditions that may impact the security state of the system.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-3_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Risk assessment policy; security planning policy and procedures; procedures addressing organizational assessments of risk; security plan; risk assessment; risk assessment results; risk assessment reviews; risk assessment updates; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-3_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with risk assessment responsibilities; and organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-3_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for risk assessment; automated mechanisms supporting and/or for conducting, documenting, reviewing, disseminating, and updating the risk assessment.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
         <add by-id="ra-3_smt" position="ending">
            <part id="ra-3_fr" name="item">
               <title>RA-3 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ra-3_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Significant change is defined in NIST Special Publication 800-37 Revision 1,
                          Appendix F</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ra-3_fr_smt.d" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="RA-3 (d) Requirement:"/>
                  <p>Include all Authorizing Officials; for JAB authorizations to include
                          FedRAMP.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - RA-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="ra-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="ra-5_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="ra-5_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines the frequency for conducting vulnerability scans on the information system and hosted applications.</li>
                  <li>Defines the process for conducting random vulnerability scans on the information system and hosted applications.</li>
                  <li>In accordance with the organization-defined frequency and/or organization-defined process for conducting random scans, scans for vulnerabilities in:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>The information system; and</li>
                        <li>Hosted applications.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>When new vulnerabilities potentially affecting the system/applications are identified and reported, scans for vulnerabilities in:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>The information system; and</li>
                        <li>Hosted applications.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Employs vulnerability scanning tools and techniques that facilitate interoperability among tools and automate parts of the vulnerability management process by using standards for:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Enumerating platforms;</li>
                        <li>Enumerating software flaws; and</li>
                        <li>Enumerating improper configurations.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Employs vulnerability scanning tools and techniques that facilitate interoperability among tools and automate parts of the vulnerability management process by using standards for:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Formatting checklists; and</li>
                        <li>Formatting test procedures.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Employs vulnerability scanning tools and techniques that facilitate interoperability among tools and automate parts of the vulnerability management process by using standards for:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Measuring vulnerability impact.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Analyzes vulnerability scan reports.</li>
                  <li>Analyzes results from security control assessments.</li>
                  <li>Defines response times to remediate legitimate vulnerabilities in accordance with an organizational assessment of risk.</li>
                  <li>Remediates legitimate vulnerabilities within the organization-defined response times in accordance with an organizational assessment of risk.</li>
                  <li>Defines personnel or roles with whom information obtained from the vulnerability scanning process and security control assessments is to be shared.</li>
                  <li>Shares information obtained from the vulnerability scanning process with organization-defined personnel or roles to help eliminate similar vulnerabilities in other information systems (i.e., systemic weaknesses or deficiencies).</li>
                  <li>Shares information obtained from security control assessments with organization-defined personnel or roles to help eliminate similar vulnerabilities in other information systems (i.e., systemic weaknesses or deficiencies).</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-5_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Risk assessment policy; procedures addressing vulnerability scanning; risk assessment; security plan; security assessment report; vulnerability scanning tools and associated configuration documentation; vulnerability scanning results; patch and vulnerability management records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-5_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with risk assessment, security control assessment and vulnerability scanning responsibilities; organizational personnel with vulnerability scan analysis responsibilities; organizational personnel with vulnerability remediation responsibilities; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system/network administrators.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-5_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for vulnerability scanning, analysis, remediation, and information sharing; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing vulnerability scanning, analysis, remediation, and information sharing.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-5_fr_smt.a" name="item">
               <title>RA-5(a) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <prop name="label" value="RA-5 (a)Requirement:"/>
               <p>An accredited independent assessor scans operating systems/infrastructure, web
                  applications, and databases once annually.</p>
            </part>
            <part id="ra-5_fr_smt.e" name="item">
               <title>RA-5(e) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <prop name="label" value="RA-5 (e)Requirement:"/>
               <p>To include all Authorizing Officials; for JAB authorizations to include
                  FedRAMP.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
         <add by-id="ra-5_smt" position="ending">
            <part id="ra-5_fr" name="item">
               <title>RA-5 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ra-5_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>
                     <strong>See the FedRAMP Documents page under Key Cloud Service Provider (CSP)
                          Documents&gt; Vulnerability Scanning Requirements</strong> (<a href="https://www.FedRAMP.gov/documents/">https://www.FedRAMP.gov/documents/</a>)</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-3 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-3">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-4(10) - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-4.10">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SA-9 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sa-9">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="sa-9_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="sa-9_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines security controls to be employed by providers of external information system services.</li>
                  <li>Requires that providers of external information system services comply with organizational information security requirements.</li>
                  <li>Requires that providers of external information system services employ organization-defined security controls in accordance with applicable federal laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidance.</li>
                  <li>Defines and documents government oversight with regard to external information system services.</li>
                  <li>Defines and documents user roles and responsibilities with regard to external information system services.</li>
                  <li>Defines processes, methods, and techniques to be employed to monitor security control compliance by external service providers.</li>
                  <li>Employs organization-defined processes, methods, and techniques to monitor security control compliance by external service providers on an ongoing basis.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="sa-9_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and services acquisition policy; procedures addressing external information system services; procedures addressing methods and techniques for monitoring security control compliance by external service providers of information system services; acquisition contracts, service-level agreements; organizational security requirements and security specifications for external provider services; security control assessment evidence from external providers of information system services; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sa-9_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational personnel with system and services acquisition responsibilities; external providers of information system services; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sa-9_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for monitoring security control compliance by external service providers on an ongoing basis; automated mechanisms for monitoring security control compliance by external service providers on an ongoing basis.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SC-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SC-5 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-5">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="sc-5_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="sc-5_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines types of denial of service attacks or reference to source of such information for the information system to protect against or limit the effects.</li>
                  <li>Defines security safeguards to be employed by the information system to protect against or limit the effects of organization-defined types of denial of service attacks.</li>
                  <li>Protects against or limits the effects of the organization-defined denial or service attacks (or reference to source for such information) by employing organization-defined security safeguards.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-5_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and communications protection policy; procedures addressing denial of service protection; information system design documentation; security plan; list of denial of services attacks requiring employment of security safeguards to protect against or limit effects of such attacks; list of security safeguards protecting against or limiting the effects of denial of service attacks; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-5_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; organizational personnel with incident response responsibilities; system developer.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-5_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms protecting against or limiting the effects of denial of service attacks.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: If availability is a requirement, define protections in place as per
                  control requirement.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SC-7 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-7">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="sc-7_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="sc-7_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Monitors communications at the external boundary of the information system.</li>
                  <li>Monitors communications at key internal boundaries within the system.</li>
                  <li>Controls communications at the external boundary of the information system.</li>
                  <li>Controls communications at key internal boundaries within the system.</li>
                  <li>Implements subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are either:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Physically separated from internal organizational networks; and/or</li>
                        <li>Logically separated from internal organizational networks.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Connects to external networks or information systems only through managed interfaces consisting of boundary protection devices arranged in accordance with an organizational security architecture.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-7_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and communications protection policy; procedures addressing boundary protection; list of key internal boundaries of the information system; information system design documentation; boundary protection hardware and software; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; enterprise security architecture documentation; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-7_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; and organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system developer; organizational personnel with boundary protection responsibilities.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-7_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms implementing boundary protection capability.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SC-12 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-12">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="sc-12_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="sc-12_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines requirements for cryptographic key:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Generation;</li>
                        <li>Distribution;</li>
                        <li>Storage;</li>
                        <li>Access; and</li>
                        <li>Destruction.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Establishes and manages cryptographic keys for required cryptography employed within the information system in accordance with organization-defined requirements for key generation, distribution, storage, access, and destruction.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-12_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and communications protection policy; procedures addressing cryptographic key establishment and management; information system design documentation; cryptographic mechanisms; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-12_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; and organizational personnel with responsibilities for cryptographic key establishment and/or management.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-12_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing cryptographic key establishment and management.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-12_fr" name="item">
               <title>SC-12 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="sc-12_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Federally approved cryptography.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SC-13 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-13">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="sc-13_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="CONDITIONAL"/>
            <part id="sc-13_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines cryptographic uses.</li>
                  <li>Defines the type of cryptography required for each use.</li>
                  <li>Implements the organization-defined cryptographic uses and type of cryptography required for each use in accordance with applicable federal laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, regulations, and standards.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-13_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and communications protection policy; procedures addressing cryptographic protection; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; cryptographic module validation certificates; list of FIPS validated cryptographic modules; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-13_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; system developer; and organizational personnel with responsibilities for cryptographic protection.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="sc-13_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing cryptographic protection.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part name="guidance" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS">
               <p>Condition: If implementing need to detail how they meet it or don't meet it.</p>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SC-15 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-15">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>

               <p>NSO - Not directly related to the security of the SaaS.</p>

      <!-- - - SC-20 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-20">

      <!-- - - SC-39 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="sc-39">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SI-1 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="si-1">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ATTEST"/>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SI-2 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="si-2">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="si-2_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="si-2_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Identifies information system flaws.</li>
                  <li>Reports information system flaws.</li>
                  <li>Corrects information system flaws.</li>
                  <li>Tests software updates related to flaw remediation for effectiveness and potential side effects before installation.</li>
                  <li>Tests firmware updates related to flaw remediation for effectiveness and potential side effects before installation.</li>
                  <li>Defines the time period within which to install security-relevant software updates after the release of the updates.</li>
                  <li>Defines the time period within which to install security-relevant firmware updates after the release of the updates.</li>
                  <li>Installs software updates within the organization-defined time period of the release of the updates.</li>
                  <li>Installs firmware updates within the organization-defined time period of the release of the updates.</li>
                  <li>Incorporates flaw remediation into the organizational configuration management process.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="si-2_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and information integrity policy; procedures addressing flaw remediation; procedures addressing configuration management; list of flaws and vulnerabilities potentially affecting the information system; list of recent security flaw remediation actions performed on the information system (e.g., list of installed patches, service packs, hot fixes, and other software updates to correct information system flaws); test results from the installation of software and firmware updates to correct information system flaws; installation/change control records for security-relevant software and firmware updates; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="si-2_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the information system; organizational personnel with responsibility for flaw remediation; and organizational personnel with configuration management responsibility.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="si-2_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for identifying, reporting, and correcting information system flaws; organizational process for installing software and firmware updates; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing reporting, and correcting information system flaws; and automated mechanisms supporting an/or implementing testing software and firmware updates.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SI-3 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="si-3">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="si-3_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="si-3_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Employs malicious code protection mechanisms to detect and eradicate malicious code at information system:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Entry points; and</li>
                        <li>Exit points.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Updates malicious code protection mechanisms whenever new releases are available in accordance with organizational configuration management policy and procedures (as identified in CM-1).</li>
                  <li>Defines a frequency for malicious code protection mechanisms to perform periodic scans of the information system.</li>
                  <li>Defines action to be initiated by malicious protection mechanisms in response to malicious code detection.</li>
                  <li>Configures malicious code protection mechanisms to:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Perform periodic scans of the information system with the organization-defined frequency;</li>
                        <li>Perform real-time scans of files from external sources at endpoint and/or network entry/exit points as the files are downloaded, opened, or executed in accordance with organizational security policy.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Configures malicious code protection mechanisms to do one or more of the following:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Block malicious code in response to malicious code detection;</li>
                        <li>Quarantine malicious code in response to malicious code detection;</li>
                        <li>Send alert to administrator in response to malicious code detection; and/or</li>
                        <li>Initiate organization-defined action in response to malicious code detection.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Addresses the receipt of false positives during malicious code detection and eradication.</li>
                  <li>Addresses the resulting potential impact on the availability of the information system.</li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="si-3_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System and information integrity policy; configuration management policy and procedures; procedures addressing malicious code protection; malicious code protection mechanisms; records of malicious code protection updates; information system design documentation; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; scan results from malicious code protection mechanisms; record of actions initiated by malicious code protection mechanisms in response to malicious code detection; information system audit records; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="si-3_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the information system; organizational personnel with responsibility for malicious code protection; and organizational personnel with configuration management responsibility.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="si-3_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for employing, updating, and configuring malicious code protection mechanisms; organizational process for addressing false positives and resulting potential impact; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing employing, updating, and configuring malicious code protection mechanisms; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing malicious code scanning and subsequent act.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SI-4 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="si-4">
         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add by-id="si-4_smt" position="starting">
            <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
         </add>
         <add position="ending">
            <prop name="method" class="FedRAMP-Tailored-LI-SaaS" value="ASSESS"/>
            <part id="si-4_obj_fr" name="objective">
               <prop ns="https://fedramp.gov/ns/oscal" name="response-point" value="You must fill in this response point."/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <prop name="method" class="fedramp" value="TEST"/>
               <p>Determine if the organization:</p>
               <ul>
                  <li>Defines monitoring objectives to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks on the information system.</li>
                  <li>Monitors the information system to detect, in accordance with organization-defined monitoring objectives:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Attacks; and/or</li>
                        <li>Indicators of potential attacks.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Monitors the information system to detect unauthorized:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Local connections;</li>
                        <li>Network connections; and/or</li>
                        <li>Remote connections.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Defines techniques and methods to identify unauthorized use of the information system.</li>
                  <li>Identifies unauthorized use of the information system through organization-defined techniques and methods.</li>
                  <li>Deploys monitoring devices:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Strategically within the information system to collect organization-determined essential information.</li>
                        <li>At ad hoc locations within the system to track specific types of transactions of interest to the organization.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Protects information obtained from intrusion-monitoring tools from unauthorized:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>Access;</li>
                        <li>Modification; and/or</li>
                        <li>Deletion.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
                  <li>Heightens the level of information system monitoring activity whenever there is an indication of increased risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, or the Nation based on law enforcement information, intelligence information, or other credible sources of information.</li>
                  <li>Obtains legal opinion with regard to information system monitoring activities in accordance with applicable federal laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, or regulations.</li>
                  <li>Defines personnel or roles to whom information system monitoring information is to be provided.</li>
                  <li>Defines information system monitoring information to be provided to organization-defined personnel or roles.</li>
                  <li>Defines a frequency to provide organization-defined information system monitoring to organization-defined personnel or roles.</li>
                  <li>Provides organization-defined information system monitoring information to organization-defined personnel or roles one or more of the following:</li>
                  <li>
                     <ul>
                        <li>As needed; and/or</li>
                        <li>With the organization-defined frequency.</li>
                     </ul>
                  </li>
               </ul>
            </part>
            <part id="si-4_asmt_fr.1" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="EXAMINE"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Continuous monitoring strategy; system and information integrity policy; procedures addressing information system monitoring tools and techniques; facility diagram/layout; information system design documentation; information system monitoring tools and techniques documentation; locations within information system where monitoring devices are deployed; information system configuration settings and associated documentation; and other relevant documents or records.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="si-4_asmt_fr.2" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="INTERVIEW"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>System/network administrators; organizational personnel with information security responsibilities; organizational personnel installing, configuring, and/or maintaining the information system; and organizational personnel with responsibility monitoring the information system.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
            <part id="si-4_asmt_fr.3" name="assess">
               <prop name="method" value="TEST"/>
               <part name="objects">
                  <p>Organizational processes for information system monitoring; automated mechanisms supporting and/or implementing information system monitoring capability.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SI-5 - -  -->

         <remove by-name="objective"/>
         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">

         </add>
      </alter>
      <!-- - - SI-12 - -  -->
      <alter control-id="si-12">

         <remove by-name="assessment"/>
         <add position="ending">

      <alter control-id="ac-8">
         <add position="ending" by-id="ac-8_smt">
            <part id="ac-8_fr" name="item">
               <title>AC-8 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall determine elements of the cloud environment
							that require the System Use Notification control. The elements of the
							cloud environment that require System Use Notification are approved and
							accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_smt.2" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall determine how System Use Notification is going
							to be verified and provide appropriate periodicity of the check. The
							System Use Notification verification and periodicity are approved and
							accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>If performed as part of a Configuration Baseline
							check, then the % of items requiring setting that are checked and that
							pass (or fail) check can be provided.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_smt.3" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>If not performed as part of a Configuration Baseline check, then there
							must be documented agreement on how to provide results of verification
							and the necessary periodicity of the verification by the service
							provider. The documented agreement on how to provide verification of the
							results are approved and accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

               <part id="ca-6_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Significant change is defined in NIST Special Publication 800-37 Revision
							1, Appendix F. The service provider describes the types of changes to

							impact the risk posture. The types of changes are approved and accepted
							by the JAB/AO.</p>

               <title>CA-7 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ca-7_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>Operating System Scans: at least monthly. Database and Web Application
							Scans: at least monthly. All scans performed by Independent Assessor: at
							least annually.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ca-7_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>CSPs must provide evidence of closure and remediation of high
							vulnerabilities within the timeframe for standard POA&amp;M updates.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ca-7_fr_gdn.2" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>See the FedRAMP Documents page under Key Cloud Service Provider (CSP)
							Documents, Continuous Monitoring Strategy Guide <a href="https://www.fedramp.gov/documents/">https://www.fedramp.gov/documents/</a>
                  </p>
               </part>

      <alter control-id="cm-6">
         <add position="ending" by-id="cm-6_smt">
            <part id="cm-6_fr" name="item">
               <title>CM-6(a) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="cm-6_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement 1:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall use the Center for Internet Security
							guidelines (Level 1) to establish configuration settings or establishes
							its own configuration settings if USGCB is not available. </p>
               </part>
               <part id="cm-6_fr_smt.2" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement 2:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall ensure that checklists for configuration
							settings are Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) (<a href="http://scap.nist.gov/">http://scap.nist.gov/</a>) validated or
							SCAP compatible (if validated checklists are not available).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cm-6_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Information on the USGCB checklists can be found at: <a href="https://csrc.nist.gov/Projects/United-States-Government-Configuration-Baseline">https://csrc.nist.gov/Projects/United-States-Government-Configuration-Baseline</a>.</p>
               </part>
            </part>

      <alter control-id="cp-9">

            <part id="cp-9_fr" name="item">
               <title>CP-9 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall determine what elements of the cloud
							environment require the Information System Backup control. The service
							provider shall determine how Information System Backup is going to be
							verified and appropriate periodicity of the check.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.a" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="CP-9(a) Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider maintains at least three backup copies of user-level
							information (at least one of which is available online).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.b" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="CP-9(b)Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider maintains at least three backup copies of
							system-level information (at least one of which is available
							online).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.c" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="CP-9(c)Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider maintains at least three backup copies of
							information system documentation including security information (at
							least one of which is available online).</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

               <prop name="label" value="RA-5 (a)Requirement:"/>

						web applications, and databases once annually.</p>

      <alter control-id="sa-4">
         <add position="ending" by-id="sa-4_smt">
            <part id="sa-4_fr" name="item">
               <title>SA-4 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="sa-4_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider must comply with Federal Acquisition Regulation
                            (FAR) Subpart 7.103, and Section 889 of the John S. McCain National Defense
                            Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year 2019 (Pub. L. 115-232), and FAR Subpart 4.21,
                            which implements Section 889 (as well as any added updates related to FISMA to
                            address security concerns in the system acquisitions process).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="sa-4_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>The use of Common Criteria (ISO/IEC 15408) evaluated products is strongly
							preferred. See <a href="https://www.niap-ccevs.org/Product/">https://www.niap-ccevs.org/Product/</a>.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

      <alter control-id="ac-8">
         <add position="ending" by-id="ac-8_smt">
            <part id="ac-8_fr" name="item">
               <title>AC-8 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall determine elements of the cloud environment
							that require the System Use Notification control. The elements of the
							cloud environment that require System Use Notification are approved and
							accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_smt.2" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall determine how System Use Notification is going
							to be verified and provide appropriate periodicity of the check. The
							System Use Notification verification and periodicity are approved and
							accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>If performed as part of a Configuration Baseline
							check, then the % of items requiring setting that are checked and that
							pass (or fail) check can be provided.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="ac-8_fr_smt.3" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>If not performed as part of a Configuration Baseline check, then there
							must be documented agreement on how to provide results of verification
							and the necessary periodicity of the verification by the service
							provider. The documented agreement on how to provide verification of the
							results are approved and accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

      <alter control-id="au-3.1">
         <add position="ending" by-id="au-3.1_smt">
            <part id="au-3.1_fr" name="item">
               <title>AU-3 (1) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="au-3.1_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider defines audit record types <em>[FedRAMP Assignment:
								session, connection, transaction, or activity duration; for
								client-server transactions, the number of bytes received and bytes
								sent; additional informational messages to diagnose or identify the
								event; characteristics that describe or identify the object or
								resource being acted upon; individual identities of group account
								users; full-text of privileged commands]</em>. The audit record
							types are approved and accepted by the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="au-3.1_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>For client-server transactions, the number of bytes sent and received
							gives bidirectional transfer information that can be helpful during an
							investigation or inquiry.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

      <alter control-id="au-8.1">
         <add position="ending" by-id="au-8.1_smt">
            <part id="au-8.1_fr" name="item">
               <title>AU-8 (1) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="au-8.1_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider selects primary and secondary time servers used by
							the NIST Internet time service. The secondary server is selected from a
							different geographic region than the primary server.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="au-8.1_fr_smt.2" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider synchronizes the system clocks of network computers
							that run operating systems other than Windows to the Windows Server
							Domain Controller emulator or to the same time source for that
							server.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="au-8.1_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Synchronization of system clocks improves the accuracy of log
							analysis.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

            <part id="cm-3_fr" name="item">
               <title>CM-3 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="cm-3_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider establishes a central means of communicating major
							changes to or developments in the information system or environment of
							operations that may affect its services to the federal government and
							associated service consumers (e.g., electronic bulletin board, web
							status page). The means of communication are approved and accepted by
							the JAB/AO.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cm-3_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="(e) Guidance:"/>
                  <p>In accordance with record retention policies and procedures.</p>
               </part>
            </part>

         <add position="ending" by-id="cm-6_smt">
            <part id="cm-6_fr" name="item">
               <title>CM-6(a) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="cm-6_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement 1:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall use the Center for Internet Security
							guidelines (Level 1) to establish configuration settings or establishes
							its own configuration settings if USGCB is not available. </p>
               </part>
               <part id="cm-6_fr_smt.2" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement 2:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall ensure that checklists for configuration
							settings are Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) (<a href="http://scap.nist.gov/">http://scap.nist.gov/</a>) validated or
							SCAP compatible (if validated checklists are not available).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cm-6_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>Information on the USGCB checklists can be found at: <a href="https://csrc.nist.gov/Projects/United-States-Government-Configuration-Baseline">https://csrc.nist.gov/Projects/United-States-Government-Configuration-Baseline</a>.</p>
               </part>
            </part>

                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall use the Center for Internet Security
							guidelines (Level 1) to establish list of prohibited or restricted
							functions, ports, protocols, and/or services or establishes its own list
							of prohibited or restricted functions, ports, protocols, and/or services
							if USGCB is not available.</p>

               <title>CP-7 (1) Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="cp-7.1_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>The service provider may determine what is considered a sufficient degree
							of separation between the primary and alternate processing sites, based
							on the types of threats that are of concern. For one particular type of
							threat (i.e., hostile cyber attack), the degree of separation between
							sites will be less relevant.</p>

            <part id="cp-9_fr" name="item">
               <title>CP-9 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider shall determine what elements of the cloud
							environment require the Information System Backup control. The service
							provider shall determine how Information System Backup is going to be
							verified and appropriate periodicity of the check.</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.a" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="CP-9(a) Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider maintains at least three backup copies of user-level
							information (at least one of which is available online).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.b" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="CP-9(b)Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider maintains at least three backup copies of
							system-level information (at least one of which is available
							online).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="cp-9_fr_smt.c" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="CP-9(c)Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider maintains at least three backup copies of
							information system documentation including security information (at
							least one of which is available online).</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

      <alter control-id="ir-3">
         <add position="ending" by-id="ir-3_smt">
            <part id="ir-3_fr" name="item">
               <title>IR-3 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="ir-3_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="IR-3 Requirement 2:"/>
                  <p>The service provider defines tests and/or exercises in accordance with
							NIST Special Publication 800-61 (as amended). Functional Testing must occur prior to
							testing for initial authorization. Annual functional testing may be concurrent with
							required penetration tests (see CA-8). The service provider provides test plans to the
                     JAB/AO annually. Test plans are approved and accepted by the JAB/AO prior to test
                     commencing.</p>
               </part>
            </part>
         </add>

            <part id="sa-4_fr" name="item">
               <title>SA-4 Additional FedRAMP Requirements and Guidance</title>
               <part id="sa-4_fr_smt.1" name="item">
                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
                  <p>The service provider must comply with Federal Acquisition Regulation
                            (FAR) Subpart 7.103, and Section 889 of the John S. McCain National Defense
                            Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year 2019 (Pub. L. 115-232), and FAR Subpart 4.21,
                            which implements Section 889 (as well as any added updates related to FISMA to
                            address security concerns in the system acquisitions process).</p>
               </part>
               <part id="sa-4_fr_gdn.1" name="guidance">
                  <prop name="label" value="Guidance:"/>
                  <p>The use of Common Criteria (ISO/IEC 15408) evaluated products is strongly
							preferred. See <a href="https://www.niap-ccevs.org/Product/">https://www.niap-ccevs.org/Product/</a>.</p>
               </part>

                  <prop name="label" value="Requirement:"/>
